lines.en: I never asked about you. Let me ask now.
lines.zh: 我之前忘了问你的情况，现在补上吧。

lines.en: Oh! Hello again!
lines.zh: 哎呀，你好！

lines.en: A little ferry is sailing to Hello Island.
lines.zh: 一艘小渡轮正开往你好岛。

lines.en: Look! That green island is our new home!
lines.zh: 快看！那座绿绿的小岛就是我们的新家！

lines.en: People there talk with monsters in English.
lines.zh: 岛上的人用英语和怪兽说话。

lines.en: Before we get off, let's fill in your Island Pass.
lines.zh: 下船之前，我们先把你的「小岛通行证」填好吧。

lines.en: Which photo is you?
lines.zh: 通行证上贴哪张照片？选一张像你的。

lines.en: I'm a boy.
I'm a girl.
Now write your English name on it.
lines.zh: 再写上你的英文名。选一个，也可以自己起一个游戏昵称（不要用真名哦）。

lines.en: My name is {name}.
Read your pass out loud: "My name is {name}."
lines.zh: 把通行证大声念出来：My name is {name}.

lines.en: Great! Your Island Pass is ready.
lines.zh: 好啦！你的小岛通行证做好了。

lines.en: The ferry stops at Hello Island. You are home!
lines.zh: 渡轮在你好岛靠岸了。到家啦！

lines.en: Thank you, {name}! Good luck on your journey!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}！旅途加油！

lines.en: Good morning, {name}! Did you sleep well in our new home?
lines.zh: 早上好，{name}！在新家睡得好吗？

lines.en: Our neighbour is Professor Echo. Go and say hello!
lines.zh: 我们的邻居是回声博士，快去打个招呼吧！

lines.en: Walk to the red mat and go outside.
lines.zh: 走到门口的红地垫，就能出门啦。

lines.en: Professor Echo lives next door. Go and say hello!
lines.zh: 回声博士就住在隔壁，快去打个招呼吧！

lines.en: Welcome home, {name}! You look tired.
lines.zh: 欢迎回家，{name}！你看起来累了。

lines.en: Let your monsters have a good rest.
lines.zh: 让你的怪兽们好好休息一下吧。

lines.en: Don't forget to eat well and sleep early!
lines.zh: 记得好好吃饭，早点睡觉！

lines.en: Which shell will you open?
lines.zh: 你要打开哪个贝壳？

lines.en: Hi there! You must be {name}, my new neighbour!
lines.zh: 你好呀！你就是 {name} 吧，我的新邻居！

lines.en: I'm Professor Echo. I study how monsters learn English.
lines.zh: 我是回声博士，我在研究怪兽怎么学英语。

lines.en: This morning, three sleepy shells washed up on the beach.
lines.zh: 今天早上，海浪把三个睡着的贝壳冲上了沙滩。

lines.en: A young monster is sleeping in each one. They are looking for a friend.
lines.zh: 每个贝壳里都睡着一只小怪兽，它们在找朋友。

lines.en: Choose one shell and say hello in English!
lines.zh: 选一个贝壳，用英语跟它打个招呼吧！

lines.en: Let's see how you two work together. My Nibbler wants to play!
lines.zh: 来看看你们俩配合得怎么样。我的啃啃鼠想和你们玩一局！

lines.en: Great teamwork, {name}! You two are a good team.
lines.zh: 配合得真好，{name}！你们俩是好搭档。

lines.en: Practice together, and you will get better every day.
lines.zh: 一起多练练，你们会一天比一天棒。

lines.en: That's okay, {name}. You two just met!
lines.zh: 没关系，{name}。你们才刚认识嘛！

lines.en: Take these potions, too.
lines.zh: 这两瓶药水也拿着。

lines.en: First, visit the Challenge Hall and meet Captain Polly. Win her badge!
lines.zh: 先去挑战馆见见鹦鹉船长，赢下她的徽章！

lines.en: But Captain Polly only battles students who study hard.
lines.zh: 不过鹦鹉船长只和用功的学生对战：先在「📚 闯关练习」里打败课本前两个单元的 BOSS 吧！

lines.en: Then the guard will let you go north to Route 1. My child {rival} is there.
lines.zh: 有了徽章，守卫就会让你往北去 1 号路。我的孩子 {rival} 就在那里。

lines.en: Talk to people in town. They will teach you English!
lines.zh: 多和镇上的人说说话，他们会教你英语！

lines.en: Hi! You must be {name}! Mom told me about you.
lines.zh: 嗨！你就是 {name} 吧！妈妈跟我说过你。

lines.en: I'm {rival}. I want to be the English Champion!
lines.zh: 我叫 {rival}，我的梦想是当上英语冠军！

lines.en: Let's see how strong your monster is!
lines.zh: 来看看你的怪兽有多厉害吧！

lines.en: Yay, I won! Don't be sad. Let me heal your monster.
lines.zh: 耶，我赢了！别难过，我帮你的怪兽恢复体力。

lines.en: You will be strong soon!
lines.zh: 你很快就会变强的！

lines.en: I will train harder. See you on the next island!
lines.zh: 我也要更努力地训练。下个岛见！

lines.en: Wow, you are good! Your English is so clear!
lines.zh: 哇，你好厉害！你的英语说得真清楚！

lines.en: Are you ready? Here it comes!
lines.zh: 准备好了吗？它冲过来了！

lines.en: {name}! You won the first badge! Well done!
lines.zh: {name}！你拿到第一枚徽章了！真棒！

lines.en: Take this. It is a Team Headset.
lines.zh: 这个送给你，它叫共学耳机。

lines.en: With it, all the monsters in your team can listen and learn from every battle.
lines.zh: 戴着它，队伍里没出场的怪兽也在旁边听，也能分到经验。

lines.en: You can turn it on or off in your bag.
lines.zh: 在背包里可以打开或者关掉它。

lines.en: Look! All the colors are gone. Everything is grey!
lines.zh: 你看！颜色全不见了，到处都是灰色的！

lines.en: Red, yellow, blue and green. Colors, come back!
lines.zh: 红、黄、蓝、绿，颜色们，快回来！

lines.en: A little boy forgot the words for his mom and dad!
lines.zh: 一个小男孩连“妈妈”“爸爸”都说不出来了！

lines.en: My family is the best family in the world!
lines.zh: 我的家是世界上最好的家！

lines.en: They want to stop our English class!
lines.zh: 他们要取消我们的英语课！

lines.en: Let's learn English together!
lines.zh: 我们一起学英语吧！

lines.en: Doctor Octo's books are all mixed up!
lines.zh: 八爪博士的书全被弄乱了！

lines.en: I like English, math and science.
lines.zh: 我喜欢英语、数学和科学。

lines.en: They broke the speakers at the talent show!
lines.zh: 他们把才艺表演的音响弄坏了！

lines.en: We can sing and dance together!
lines.zh: 我们可以一起唱歌跳舞！

lines.en: The clock tower stopped. Nobody knows the time!
lines.zh: 钟楼停了，谁都不知道现在几点！

lines.en: It's seven o'clock. Time to get up!
lines.zh: 七点了，该起床了！

lines.en: They took the crystal from {rival}'s birthday cake!
lines.zh: 他们把 {rival} 生日蛋糕里的水晶抢走了！

lines.en: Happy birthday to you!
lines.zh: 祝你生日快乐！

lines.en: They are catching wild monsters and putting them in cages!
lines.zh: 他们在抓野生怪兽，把它们关进笼子！

lines.en: Animals are our friends.
lines.zh: 动物是我们的朋友。

lines.en: They are breaking all the rules in town!
lines.zh: 他们在镇上乱闯红灯、乱扔垃圾！

lines.en: Don't break the rules!
lines.zh: 不要破坏规则！

lines.en: Everyone is eating junk food and staying in bed!
lines.zh: 大家都在吃垃圾食品、躺在床上不动！

lines.en: Eat well and keep fit!
lines.zh: 好好吃饭，锻炼身体！

lines.en: Their weather machine made a storm that never stops!
lines.zh: 他们的天气机让暴风雨一直下个不停！

lines.en: Rain, rain, go away!
lines.zh: 雨呀雨，快走开！

lines.en: Mr. Mute is here! He wants to wake the Hush King!
lines.zh: 默先生来了！他要唤醒寂静之王！

lines.en: We remember! Echodrake, wake up!
lines.zh: 我们记得！回声龙，醒来吧！

lines.en: Shh! Words only make trouble!
lines.zh: 嘘！说话只会惹麻烦！

lines.en: Silence is peace!
lines.zh: 安静就是和平！

lines.en: You talk too much, kid!
lines.zh: 小朋友，你话太多了！

lines.en: Be quiet! This crystal is ours now!
lines.zh: 安静！这颗水晶现在是我们的了！

lines.en: Shh... go home, little trainer.
lines.zh: 嘘……回家去吧，小训练师。

lines.en: Shh... I am Whisper. I only need to whisper.
lines.zh: 嘘……我是低语。我说话只需要悄悄话。

lines.en: I'm Rumble! I don't talk, I fight!
lines.zh: 我是闷雷！我不说话，我只对战！

lines.en: So you are the child who talks to monsters.
lines.zh: 你就是那个和怪兽说话的孩子。

lines.en: Words make people fight. A quiet world is a happy world.
lines.zh: 话说多了，人们就会吵架。安静的世界才是快乐的世界。

lines.en: Oh, a trainer! Please help us!
lines.zh: 啊，是训练师！请帮帮我们！

lines.en: They are standing at the Challenge Hall door. Please get it back!
lines.zh: 他们就守在挑战馆门口。请你帮我们抢回来！

lines.en: How... how can words be so strong?
lines.zh: 怎么……话语怎么会这么有力量？

lines.en: Shh... You win this time!
lines.zh: 嘘……这次算你赢！

lines.en: Not so fast!
lines.zh: 别想走！

lines.en: Say the magic words to make it shine again!
lines.zh: 大声念出这句话，让水晶重新亮起来！

lines.en: The crystal is shining! Everyone remembers the words again!
lines.zh: 水晶亮起来了！大家又想起了这些英语！

lines.en: Now you can challenge the Isle Master!
lines.zh: 现在可以去挑战岛主了！

lines.en: The ground is shaking...
lines.zh: 大地在摇晃……

lines.en: The voices of thirteen islands woke up Echodrake!
lines.zh: 十三座岛的声音唤醒了回声龙！

lines.en: {name}! Echodrake wants to see how strong your voice is!
lines.zh: {name}！回声龙想看看你的声音有多强！

lines.en: The statue is shining.
lines.zh: 这座雕像已经亮了。

lines.en: The statue stays dark. Try again!
lines.zh: 雕像没有亮。再试一次吧！

lines.en: {name}! I got a new badge too. Let's battle again!
lines.zh: {name}！我也拿到新徽章了，再比一场吧！

lines.en: Show me your best!
lines.zh: 拿出你最强的本事吧！

lines.en: Team Hush is everywhere. We must get stronger!
lines.zh: 到处都是嘘声团，我们得变得更强！

lines.en: I won't lose this time!
lines.zh: 这次我可不会输！

lines.en: This is our last battle before the English Cup!
lines.zh: 这是英语冠军赛之前我们最后一场对战了！

lines.en: I won! But you're getting stronger. Let me heal your team.
lines.zh: 我赢了！不过你越来越强了。我帮你的队伍恢复一下。

lines.en: You beat me again! See you at the next island!
lines.zh: 又输给你了！下个岛见！

lines.en: Every word has power. Show me yours!
lines.zh: 每个词都有力量。让我看看你的！

lines.en: I am Sage, the master of words.
lines.zh: 我是智者，词语大师。

lines.en: In my room, every word is strong. Your small moves hit harder!
lines.zh: 在我的房间里，每个词都很有力量。你的小招伤害 ×1.5！

lines.en: I am Luna. I love stories in the dark.
lines.zh: 我是露娜，我喜欢在黑暗里讲故事。

lines.en: In the dark, you must listen fast. You have only eight seconds to defend!
lines.zh: 在黑暗里要听得快。防御只有 8 秒！

lines.en: Tell me your story with your monsters!
lines.zh: 用你的怪兽告诉我你的故事吧！

lines.en: Can you speak clearly in the cold?
lines.zh: 你在寒冷里也能说得清楚吗？

lines.en: Clear words hit hard. Unclear words are weak!
lines.zh: 说得清楚，招式就强；说得含糊，招式就弱（很准 ×1.6，一般 ×0.8）！

lines.en: I am Frost. My English is cool and clear.
lines.zh: 我是冰霜，我的英语又酷又清楚。

lines.en: I am Talon, the last master.
lines.zh: 我是利爪，最后一位擂主。

lines.en: Let's talk with our biggest moves! You start with full energy!
lines.zh: 让我们用最强的招式对话吧！你一上场就有 3 格能量！

lines.en: Only the bravest speakers can pass!
lines.zh: 只有最勇敢的说话者才能通过！

lines.en: Each of my monsters brings a different rule. Watch the top of the screen!
lines.zh: 我的每只怪兽都带着不同的规则。注意看屏幕上方的提示！

lines.en: Now, show me everything you have learned!
lines.zh: 现在，让我看看你学到的一切吧！

lines.en: Welcome, {name}. I am Aria, the English Champion.
lines.zh: 欢迎你，{name}。我是英语冠军阿丽娅。

lines.en: You came all the way from Hello Island.
lines.zh: 你从你好岛一路走到了这里。

lines.en: You are strong. The next room is waiting for you.
lines.zh: 你很强。下一个房间在等你。

lines.en: Amazing! You are the new English Champion!
lines.zh: 太棒了！你就是新的英语冠军！

lines.en: Congratulations, {name}! You are the Champion!
lines.zh: 恭喜你，{name}！你成为了英语冠军！

lines.en: Your monsters and your English made it happen.
lines.zh: 是你的怪兽和你的英语一起做到的。

lines.en: Wonderful, {name}! But the world is bigger than these islands...
lines.zh: 太棒了，{name}！不过世界比这些岛大得多……

lines.en: Far to the north, new islands are waiting. See you next year!
lines.zh: 在遥远的北方，还有新的群岛在等你。明年见！

lines.en: Oh, and one more thing! The Isle Masters want to battle you again.
lines.zh: 对了，还有一件事！各岛的岛主都想再和你比一场。

lines.en: They are much stronger now. And they will ask about your new English lessons!
lines.zh: 他们变得更强了，还会考你课本里最近学的英语！

lines.en: Some legendary monsters are watching you, too. Keep learning every day!
lines.zh: 还有几只传说中的怪兽在悄悄看着你。每天都要坚持学习哦！

lines.en: A little clockwork turtle heard about you. It is called Tickturtle.
lines.zh: 一只小发条龟听说了你，它叫发条龟。

lines.en: Its key turned once for every lesson you finished. Now it is awake!
lines.zh: 你每学完一课，它背上的钥匙就转一圈。现在它醒过来了！

lines.en: {name}! You beat all eight units of your first English book!
lines.zh: {name}！七年级上册 8 个单元的 BOSS，你全都打败了！

lines.en: Tick, tock, tick, tock... Something is walking up to you!
lines.zh: 嘀嗒、嘀嗒……有个小家伙朝你走过来了！

lines.en: Tickturtle is here, and its key is turning!
lines.zh: 发条龟来了，背上的钥匙还在转！

lines.en: Tickturtle, I am ready!
lines.zh: 对发条龟大声说：我准备好了！

lines.en: Your voice is loud and clear now. Skyecho heard it!
lines.zh: 你的声音现在又响亮又清楚，天响听见了！

lines.en: {name}! You finished thirty chats with the islanders in English!
lines.zh: {name}！你已经用英语和岛民聊天、完成了 30 次目标！

lines.en: Hello... hello... hello... Your words are coming back from the sky!
lines.zh: 你好……你好……你好……你说过的话从天上传回来了！

lines.en: Skyecho came down to see you!
lines.zh: 天响飞下来找你了！

lines.en: Skyecho, let's battle!
lines.zh: 对天响大声说：我们来对战吧！

lines.en: You grew a little every day, like a small tree. Daysprout saw it!
lines.zh: 你每天都长大一点点，就像一棵小树。日日芽看见了！

lines.en: {name}! You came back and learned for thirty days in a row!
lines.zh: {name}！你已经连续打卡 30 天了！

lines.en: Daysprout is looking at you!
lines.zh: 日日芽正看着你！

lines.en: Daysprout, I never give up!
lines.zh: 对日日芽大声说：我永不放弃！

lines.en: The leaves are singing... A little green friend is here!
lines.zh: 树叶在唱歌……一个绿色的小家伙来了！

lines.en: Lullaby is a shy monster. It only visits people with English in their hearts.
lines.zh: 摇篮灵是只害羞的怪兽，只会去找心里装满英语的人。

lines.en: {name}, I heard you can say three hundred sentences without looking!
lines.zh: {name}，听说你已经不看字说对了 300 句英语！

lines.en: Hello, Lullaby. Nice to meet you!
lines.zh: 对摇篮灵说：你好，很高兴认识你！

lines.en: Lullaby is here!
lines.zh: 摇篮灵来了！

lines.en: You hear a soft song... La, la, la...
lines.zh: 你听见一首轻轻的歌……啦，啦，啦……

lines.en: It's a new day! Let's study first.
lines.zh: 新的一天！先完成今天的小任务

lines.en: Let's study first!
lines.zh: 先完成今天的小任务，再来冒险吧

lines.en: The waterfall is too strong!
Look! The egg is shaking!
lines.zh: 看！蛋在晃！

lines.en: The sea is very deep here.
lines.zh: 这里的海很深。

lines.en: Light is shining from above. Swim up?
lines.zh: 上面有光照下来。要浮上去吗？

lines.en: It is a big waterfall.
lines.zh: 一道大瀑布。要先踏浪到瀑布下面。

lines.en: Welcome to the monster box!
The gate is closed.
lines.zh: 机关门关着。

lines.en: It is a big statue.
lines.zh: 一座高大的雕像。

lines.en: Talk to everyone. They will teach you English!
lines.zh: 和每个人说说话，他们会教你英语！

lines.en: Watch out! Wild monsters live in the tall grass.
lines.zh: 小心！草丛里住着野生怪兽。

lines.en: Echo Cave. It is dark inside!
lines.zh: 回声洞。里面很黑，怪兽也更强！

lines.en: Hello!
lines.zh: 你好！

lines.en: Good job!
lines.zh: 说得真好！

lines.en: Take this!
lines.zh: 这个送给你！

lines.en: Hello, dear! We are the daycare. We look after monsters.
lines.zh: 你好呀，孩子！我们开怪兽幼儿园，帮大家照顾怪兽。

lines.en: Leave two monsters with us. If they get along, you may find an egg!
lines.zh: 把两只怪兽寄养在这里。它们相处得好的话，说不定会有蛋哦！

lines.en: Oh! This egg was in our garden this morning. Take it, please!
lines.zh: 哦！今天早上花园里出现了一个蛋，你带走吧！

lines.en: Walk with it, and it will hatch.
lines.zh: 带着它多走走路，它就会孵出来。

lines.en: Welcome back!
Beat the Isle Master first!
lines.zh: 先去挑战馆打败岛主吧！

lines.en: Stop! You can't go north without this town's badge.
lines.zh: 站住！没有本镇的徽章不能往北走。

lines.en: Sorry, the boat is not ready yet.
lines.zh: 抱歉，船还不能开。

lines.en: All aboard! Do you want to go?
lines.zh: 上船啦！要出发吗？

lines.en: Where do you want to go?
Can you say it?
lines.zh: 你能跟我说一遍吗？

lines.en: Good job! Here are 10 coins.
lines.zh: 说得真好！送你 10 个金币。

lines.en: You are really strong! Let me train more.
lines.zh: 你真厉害！我要再多练练。

lines.en: Hi! This is the Rest Stop. Are your monsters tired?
lines.zh: 你好！这里是休息站。你的怪兽累了吗？

lines.en: Let them take a short nap and drink some warm milk.
lines.zh: 让它们睡个小觉、喝点热牛奶吧。

lines.en: Ding! They are full of energy again. Have fun!
lines.zh: 叮！它们又精神满满啦，去玩吧！

lines.en: You can use the computer to change your team.
lines.zh: 旁边的电脑可以把怪兽存进箱子、换队伍。

lines.en: Welcome! What would you like?
The road to the north is open now.
lines.zh: 现在北边的路已经为你打开了！

lines.en: You beat me! Here is my badge.
lines.zh: 你赢了！这枚徽章给你。

lines.en: What a battle! Come back tomorrow!
lines.zh: 好精彩的对战！明天再来吧！

lines.en: You are a true Champion! Take this.
lines.zh: 你真是名副其实的冠军！这个送给你。

lines.en: Hello! Can you answer my question?
Great answer! See you tomorrow.
lines.zh: 回答得真好！明天再来吧。

lines.en: Perfect! Here is an Echo Ball for you.
lines.zh: 太棒了！送你一个回声球。

lines.en: Hi! What is this in English?
Yes! You know it well.
lines.zh: 对！你记得真牢。

lines.en: Right! Take this potion.
lines.zh: 答对了！这瓶药水送给你。

lines.en: You can jump down a ledge, but you cannot climb up.
lines.zh: 台阶只能往下跳，不能往上爬哦。

lines.en: Use a Quiet Spray, and wild monsters will not hear you.
lines.zh: 用悄悄喷雾，草丛里的怪兽就听不见你，不会来打扰你。

lines.en: Caves are dark. The monsters there are stronger.
lines.zh: 洞穴里很黑，里面的怪兽更强。

lines.en: Your team can have six monsters.
lines.zh: 你的队伍最多可以带六只怪兽。

lines.en: Hello, young trainer!
lines.zh: 你好呀，小训练师！

lines.en: Well done! Here are 10 coins.
lines.zh: 说得真好！送你 10 个金币。

lines.en: Hello again, {name}! How is your monster?
lines.zh: 又见面了，{name}！你的怪兽还好吗？

lines.en: Monsters on these islands understand English.
lines.zh: 这些岛上的怪兽都听得懂英语。

lines.en: Speak clearly, and your monsters will be strong!
lines.zh: 英语说得越清楚，你的怪兽就越强！

lines.en: Wild monsters live in the tall grass on the road north.
lines.zh: 北边的路上有草丛，里面住着野生怪兽。

lines.en: Beat the Isle Master, and the guard will let you go north.
lines.zh: 打败岛主，守卫就会让你往北走。

lines.en: Now, can you say this to me?
lines.zh: 现在，你能对我说这句话吗？

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Professor!
Very good! Here are 10 coins.
lines.zh: 说得很好！送你 10 个金币。

lines.en: Hi there!
lines.zh: 你好呀！

lines.en: That's OK. Come back and try again any time!
lines.zh: 没关系，随时可以再来试一次！

lines.en: Not now. Please come back later.
lines.zh: 这个委托先留着，随时可以回来。

lines.en: You got a monster egg!
lines.zh: 得到了一个怪兽蛋！放在队伍里多走路就会孵出来（队伍满了就在电脑箱子里）。

lines.en: You got a shining monster egg!
lines.zh: 得到了一个闪闪发光的怪兽蛋！孵出来会是稀有色的，放在队伍里多走路就会孵出来。

lines.en: Here you are!
lines.zh: 给你！

lines.en: Our eyes met! Now we must battle!
lines.zh: 我们的眼神对上了！那就来对战吧！

lines.en: I trained here every day. Are you ready?
lines.zh: 我每天都在这里训练。你准备好了吗？

lines.en: Clear Way 2
lines.zh: 开路 2 级

lines.en: Clear Way 3
lines.zh: 开路 3 级

lines.en: Water Way 2
lines.zh: 水路 2 级

lines.en: Water Way 3
lines.zh: 水路 3 级

lines.en: Maybe a monster could help here...
Walk into the rock to push it.
lines.zh: 朝大石头走过去，就能把它推开。

lines.en: The water is calm. What do you want to do?
lines.zh: 水面很平静。要做什么？

lines.en: You cast your line...
lines.zh: 甩出鱼线……

lines.en: It got away...
You hooked a monster!
lines.zh: 钓上来了！是一只怪兽！

lines.en: Your monsters are tired. You hurried to the Rest Stop.
lines.zh: 你的怪兽都累倒了……你赶快跑回了休息站。

lines.en: Your monsters are full of energy again. Don't give up!
lines.zh: 怪兽们又精神满满了，别灰心，再去试试吧！

lines.en: Come with me!
Let's be friends!
Welcome to my team!
You are my new friend!
Here, take this potion!
Hello! Welcome to Echo Island. Let's learn English together!
Hello! How are you?
lines.zh: 你好！你好吗？

lines.en: Hi, {name}! I'm proud of you.
lines.zh: 嗨，{name}！爸爸为你骄傲。

lines.en: Speak English every day, and you will get better and better!
lines.zh: 每天说英语，你会越来越棒！

lines.en: Have fun, and be careful out there!
lines.zh: 玩得开心，出门注意安全！

lines.en: Hi, {name}! I love hearing you speak English.
lines.zh: 嗨，{name}！妈妈最喜欢听你说英语了。

lines.en: Go slowly and be careful on your journey!
lines.zh: 路上慢慢走，注意安全！

lines.en: Oh, {name}! Come and have some fruit.
lines.zh: 哎呀，{name}！快来吃点水果。

lines.en: Say hello to the monsters for me!
lines.zh: 替我向怪兽们问好！

lines.en: {name}, a little every day makes a big difference.
lines.zh: {name}，每天进步一点点，日积月累就很了不起。

lines.en: Don't forget to practice your English!
lines.zh: 别忘了练英语哦！

lines.en: Hey, {name}! Let's have a monster battle one day!
lines.zh: 嘿，{name}！哪天我们来一场怪兽对战吧！

lines.en: Good luck on your adventure!
lines.zh: 冒险加油！

lines.en: Hi, {name}! Can you teach me some English words?
lines.zh: 嗨，{name}！你能教我几个英语单词吗？

lines.en: I love you too, {name}!
lines.zh: 我也爱你，{name}！

lines.en: Look, {name}! That green island is our new home!
lines.zh: 快看，{name}！那座绿绿的小岛就是我们的新家！

lines.en: Here is your Island Pass. Read it out loud!
lines.zh: 这是你的小岛通行证，大声念出来吧！

lines.en: Read your pass: "My name is {name}."
lines.zh: 念一念通行证：My name is {name}.

lines.en: Great! Welcome to Hello Island, {name}!
lines.zh: 真棒！欢迎来到你好岛，{name}！

lines.en: A small white boat. Its name is "Hello".
lines.zh: 一艘白色的小船，船名叫「Hello」。

lines.en: Maybe one day it will take you across the sea.
lines.zh: 也许有一天，它会带你出海。

lines.en: Welcome to Hello Island! Say hello to everyone!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到你好岛！见到谁都要打招呼哦！

lines.en: Hello! I am the island guard. You need the Hello Badge to go north.
lines.zh: 你好！我是岛上的守卫。要有「你好徽章」才能往北走。

lines.en: Visit the Challenge Hall and beat Captain Polly first!
lines.zh: 先去挑战馆打败鹦鹉船长吧！

lines.en: Good morning, dear! Nice to meet you!
lines.zh: 早上好，孩子！很高兴认识你！

lines.en: Nice to meet you, too!
On this island, we always say hello.
lines.zh: 在这座岛上，我们见面总要打招呼。

lines.en: I am fine, thank you. And you?
lines.zh: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？

lines.en: I'm fine, thank you.
Hi! My name is Sam. What is your name?
lines.zh: 嗨！我叫 Sam。你叫什么名字？

lines.en: Wow, {name}! That is a cool name!
lines.zh: 哇，{name}！好酷的名字！

lines.en: Good afternoon! Do you like fishing?
lines.zh: 下午好！你喜欢钓鱼吗？

lines.en: Here, take my old fishing rod. Face the water and press A!
lines.zh: 给，这根旧钓竿送你。对着水按 A 就能钓鱼！

lines.en: Listen carefully when a fish bites!
lines.zh: 鱼咬钩的时候要仔细听哦！

lines.en: The sea is calm today. Good luck!
lines.zh: 今天海面很平静。祝你好运！

lines.en: Route 1. North: Crayon Island. East: Seaside Cliff.
lines.zh: 1 号路。往北是彩色文具岛，往东是海边悬崖。

lines.en: Goodbye! See you later!
lines.zh: 再见！回头见！

lines.en: Hello! I am Tim. Let us battle!
lines.zh: 你好！我叫 Tim，我们来对战吧！

lines.en: Good afternoon! My fish want to battle!
lines.zh: 下午好！我的鱼想对战！

lines.en: Oh no! Thank you for the battle.
lines.zh: 哎呀！谢谢你陪我对战。

lines.en: Hi! Nice to meet you! Now, battle!
lines.zh: 嗨！很高兴认识你！现在，对战吧！

lines.en: Nice to meet you, strong trainer!
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你，厉害的训练师！

lines.en: Good morning! Look at my bugs!
lines.zh: 早上好！看看我的虫子怪兽！

lines.en: Good night, my bugs...
lines.zh: 晚安，我的虫子们……

lines.en: Goodbye, and good luck!
lines.zh: 再见，祝你好运！

lines.en: Hello! What is your name? Mine is Kate!
lines.zh: 你好！你叫什么名字？我叫 Kate！

lines.en: Echo Cave. It is very dark inside!
lines.zh: 回声洞。里面非常黑！

lines.en: Good morning! I love the sea. Do you?
lines.zh: 早上好！我喜欢大海，你呢？

lines.en: What a nice morning!
lines.zh: 多美好的早晨！

lines.en: Hello there! Rocks are my friends!
lines.zh: 你好呀！石头是我的朋友！

lines.en: Thank you. You are very strong!
lines.zh: 谢谢。你很强！

lines.en: Hi! Nice to meet you on the beach!
lines.zh: 嗨！很高兴在沙滩上认识你！

lines.en: See you tomorrow!
lines.zh: 明天见！

lines.en: Good afternoon! The fish are biting today!
lines.zh: 下午好！今天鱼很爱咬钩！

lines.en: Good evening... time to go home.
lines.zh: 晚上好……该回家了。

lines.en: Hello! Can you swim? I can!
lines.zh: 你好！你会游泳吗？我会！

lines.en: You swim very well!
lines.zh: 你游得真好！

lines.en: "Words have power. Speak, and the world will listen."
lines.zh: 「话语有力量。开口说话，世界就会倾听。」

lines.en: Old words are cut into the stone:
lines.zh: 石头上刻着古老的字：

lines.en: "Long ago, the Hush King ate every sound."
lines.zh: 「很久以前，寂静之王吞掉了所有的声音。」

lines.en: "People spoke together, and Echodrake woke up."
lines.zh: 「人们一起大声说话，回声龙醒了过来。」

lines.en: Good job! Watch your step!
lines.zh: 干得好！小心脚下！

lines.en: Hello! It is dark in here, right?
lines.zh: 你好！这里很黑，对吧？

lines.en: Good evening! Oh wait, is it evening? I cannot see the sky!
lines.zh: 晚上好！等等，现在是晚上吗？在这儿看不到天空！

lines.en: Good night! I mean... goodbye!
lines.zh: 晚安！我是说……再见！

lines.en: Hello there! This cave is very dark.
lines.zh: 你好呀！这个洞里非常黑。

lines.en: Say "light up the cave!" to your monster.
lines.zh: 对你的怪兽说「light up the cave!」

lines.en: Take this. It is an Echo Shell. It teaches a monster Light Up.
lines.zh: 这个给你。它是回声贝，能教怪兽「点灯」。

lines.en: With two badges, a spark, mind or fire monster can light up the cave!
lines.zh: 有两枚徽章，电系、心灵系或火系的怪兽就能照亮洞穴！

lines.en: Fire beats grass. Water beats fire. Grass beats water.
lines.zh: 火克草，水克火，草克水。

lines.en: Hello! I help Professor Echo.
lines.zh: 你好！我是回声博士的助手。

lines.en: Monsters like clear words. Say their names loudly!
lines.zh: 怪兽喜欢清楚的话。大声叫它们的名字吧！

lines.en: Water beats fire.
Good afternoon! The computer is over there.
lines.zh: 下午好！电脑在那边。

lines.en: You can keep your monsters in the box.
lines.zh: 你可以把怪兽存进箱子里。

lines.en: Hi! {rival} is not here. {rival} left early this morning.
lines.zh: 嗨！{rival} 不在家，一大早就出门了。

lines.en: {rival} wants to be the English Champion!
lines.zh: {rival} 想当英语冠军！

lines.en: Good evening! Oh, it is still morning? Ha ha!
lines.zh: 晚上好！哦，现在还是早上？哈哈！

lines.en: My daughter is Professor Echo. She works too hard!
lines.zh: 回声博士是我的女儿。她工作太努力了！

lines.en: Good afternoon, young trainer! Ahoy!
lines.zh: 下午好，小训练师！啊嗬！

lines.en: Good job! The captain is waiting.
lines.zh: 干得好！船长在等你。

lines.en: Good evening! Do you know the right words?
lines.zh: 晚上好！你知道该说什么吗？

lines.en: You say hello very well!
lines.zh: 你打招呼打得真好！

lines.en: Good evening!
lines.zh: 晚上七点，太阳下山了。

lines.en: Squawk! It is seven p.m. now. Say the right greeting!
lines.zh: 嘎！现在是晚上七点，太阳下山了。选出正确的问候语，再大声说出来！

lines.en: Good afternoon!
lines.zh: 下午三点，太阳很大。

lines.en: Squawk! It is three p.m. now. Say the right greeting!
lines.zh: 嘎！现在是下午三点，太阳很大。选出正确的问候语，再大声说出来！

lines.en: Good morning!
lines.zh: 早上七点，太阳刚升起来。

lines.en: Squawk! It is seven a.m. now. Say the right greeting!
lines.zh: 嘎！现在是早上七点，太阳刚升起来。选出正确的问候语，再大声说出来！

lines.en: Good night!
Squawk! Look at the window. What time is it?
lines.zh: 嘎！看看窗外。现在是什么时候？

lines.en: Squawk! Wrong greeting! Back to the door!
lines.zh: 嘎！说错啦！回到门口重来！

lines.en: A giant red crayon. It is taller than you!
lines.zh: 一支巨大的红色蜡笔，比你还高！

lines.en: A giant blue crayon.
lines.zh: 一支巨大的蓝色蜡笔。

lines.en: A giant yellow crayon.
lines.zh: 一支巨大的黄色蜡笔。

lines.en: A giant green crayon. Someone wrote "Keep tidy!" on it.
lines.zh: 一支巨大的绿色蜡笔，上面有人写着「保持整洁！」

lines.en: Crayon Island. Keep your desk tidy!
lines.zh: 彩色文具岛：保持书桌整洁！

lines.en: Is this your pencil?
lines.zh: 这是你的铅笔吗？

lines.en: My pencil is yellow.
No, it is not. My pencil is yellow.
lines.zh: 不是。我的铅笔是黄色的。

lines.en: I have a ruler, two pens and an eraser.
lines.zh: 我有一把尺子、两支钢笔和一块橡皮。

lines.en: I keep them in my pencil box.
lines.zh: 我把它们放在铅笔盒里。

lines.en: My bag is pink.
My bag is pink. I love pink!
lines.zh: 我的书包是粉色的。我最喜欢粉色！

lines.en: What colour is your bag?
lines.zh: 你的书包是什么颜色的？

lines.en: A sand castle! A child built it with a blue bucket.
lines.zh: 一座沙堡！是一个小朋友用蓝色小桶堆的。

lines.en: Crayon Beach. Keep the beach tidy!
lines.zh: 蜡笔海滩：保持沙滩整洁！

lines.en: Green, yellow, red... so many colours!
lines.zh: 绿的、黄的、红的……好多颜色！

lines.en: What colour is my monster? It is green!
lines.zh: 我的怪兽是什么颜色？是绿色！

lines.en: My kite flew away!
lines.zh: 我的风筝飞走了！

lines.en: My kite is orange and blue!
lines.zh: 我的风筝是橙色和蓝色的！

lines.en: I will find my bucket...
lines.zh: 我去找我的小桶……

lines.en: Is this your bucket? No? Then battle!
lines.zh: 这是你的小桶吗？不是？那就对战吧！

lines.en: My fishing rod is brown. What colour is yours?
lines.zh: 我的钓竿是棕色的。你的是什么颜色？

lines.en: Nice! You are good!
lines.zh: 不错！你很厉害！

lines.en: I have a pink swim ring!
lines.zh: 我有一个粉色的游泳圈！

lines.en: Splash! You win!
lines.zh: 哗啦！你赢了！

lines.en: Someone painted a smiling sun on this crayon.
lines.zh: 有人在这支蜡笔上画了一个笑脸太阳。

lines.en: Someone painted a rainbow on this crayon.
lines.zh: 有人在这支蜡笔上画了一道彩虹。

lines.en: A crayon with graffiti: "Shh!" It must be Team Hush!
lines.zh: 一支蜡笔上涂着「嘘！」——一定是嘘声团干的！

lines.en: Graffiti Woods. Please don't paint on the trees!
lines.zh: 涂鸦森林：请不要在树上乱画！

lines.en: Black and yellow... and beaten!
lines.zh: 黑黄相间的……被打败了！

lines.en: My bug is black and yellow. Cool, right?
lines.zh: 我的虫子是黑黄相间的。酷吧？

lines.en: Only trainers with two badges can go. Beat the Crayon Hall first!
lines.zh: 只有两枚徽章的训练师才能过去。先去打赢彩色文具岛的挑战馆吧！

lines.en: Stop, please! The road north goes to Route 2.
lines.zh: 请停一下！往北是 2 号路。

lines.en: I lost my brushes! Are they blue?
lines.zh: 我的画笔丢了！是蓝色的吗？

lines.en: Oh, my brushes are in my bag!
lines.zh: 哦，画笔在我包里！

lines.en: I will give it to the lost and found.
lines.zh: 我把它交给失物招领处。

lines.en: Is this your eraser? I found it here!
lines.zh: 这是你的橡皮吗？我在这儿捡到的！

lines.en: Route 2. North: Family Island.
lines.zh: 2 号路。往北是温馨家庭岛。

lines.en: I have a new schoolbag. It is purple!
lines.zh: 我有一个新书包，是紫色的！

lines.en: Please keep your things tidy!
lines.zh: 请把你的东西收拾整齐！

lines.en: My fish swam away...
lines.zh: 我的鱼游走了……

lines.en: What is this? It is a fish! What colour? Silver!
lines.zh: 这是什么？是一条鱼！什么颜色？银色！

lines.en: Look! My bug has red and black spots!
lines.zh: 看！我的虫子有红黑色的斑点！

lines.en: My bug is tired now.
lines.zh: 我的虫子累了。

lines.en: I will clean my desk tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚我要把书桌收拾干净。

lines.en: Is that your pencil box? It is so tidy!
lines.zh: 那是你的铅笔盒吗？好整齐！

lines.en: Say hello to my grandma!
lines.zh: 替我向奶奶问好！

lines.en: The next island is Family Island. My grandma lives there!
lines.zh: 下一座岛是温馨家庭岛，我奶奶住在那里！

lines.en: What colour is the sky? Blue! What colour is my monster? Grey like a rock!
lines.zh: 天空是什么颜色？蓝色！我的怪兽呢？像石头一样灰！

lines.en: You know your colours!
lines.zh: 你的颜色学得真好！

lines.en: I like your colour: gold, like a badge!
lines.zh: 我喜欢你的颜色：金色，像徽章一样！

lines.en: Red, yellow, blue! Which one do you like?
lines.zh: 红、黄、蓝！你喜欢哪一个？

lines.en: Walk on red!
lines.zh: 红色

lines.en: Walk on blue!
lines.zh: 蓝色

lines.en: Walk on yellow!
lines.zh: 黄色

lines.en: Oh! A trainer! Look around you. What colour is my house?
lines.zh: 啊！是训练师！你看看周围。我的房子是什么颜色的？

lines.en: It was pink! But now it's grey. Everything is grey!
lines.zh: 它本来是粉色的！可现在是灰色。所有东西都变灰了！

lines.en: A man in a grey hoodie took our Color Crystal. He ran into the Graffiti Woods!
lines.zh: 一个穿灰色连帽衫的人偷走了我们的颜色水晶，跑进涂鸦森林了！

lines.en: People are forgetting the colour words... Do you still remember them?
lines.zh: 大家都快忘了颜色怎么说了……你还记得吗？

lines.en: It's black.
It's blue.
It's red.
What colour is an apple?
lines.zh: 苹果是什么颜色的？选出回答，再大声说出来。🍎

lines.en: It's brown.
It's pink.
What colour is the sea?
lines.zh: 大海是什么颜色的？🌊

lines.en: Yes! You remember! Please get our crystal back!
lines.zh: 对！你还记得！请把我们的水晶抢回来！

lines.en: The Graffiti Woods are north of the town.
lines.zh: 涂鸦森林就在小镇北边。

lines.en: Shh! You can't catch me!
lines.zh: 嘘！你抓不到我的！

lines.en: W-wait... please wait!
lines.zh: 等、等一下……请等一下！

lines.en: H-hi. I... I am Kai.
lines.zh: 你、你好。我……我叫小凯。

lines.en: I am staying with my uncle on this island. I am... not good at talking.
lines.zh: 我住在这座岛上的舅舅家。我……不太会说话。

lines.en: But I want a monster friend. Monsters listen to clear words, right?
lines.zh: 可是我想要一个怪兽朋友。怪兽喜欢听清楚的话，对吧？

lines.en: My uncle gave me an Echo Ball. Can you... come with me into the grass?
lines.zh: 舅舅给了我一个回声球。你能……陪我去草丛里吗？

lines.en: Oh! A monster! What do I say? What do I say?
lines.zh: 啊！一只怪兽！我该说什么？该说什么？

lines.en: Speak loudly, Kai! Your monster will hear you.
lines.zh: 给小凯打气：大声说，你的怪兽会听见的！

lines.en: O-okay! Echo Ball, fly!
lines.zh: 好、好的！回声球，飞吧！

lines.en: I did it! I caught Owlet! It came to me because I spoke clearly!
lines.zh: 我做到了！我收服了 Owlet！因为我说得很清楚，它才过来的！

lines.en: Thank you, {name}. I want to be strong, like you.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}。我想变得像你一样强。

lines.en: I will go home and tell my uncle. See you!
lines.zh: 我要回家告诉舅舅。回头见！

lines.en: Colours are too loud! Grey is quiet!
lines.zh: 颜色太吵了！灰色才安静！

lines.en: Shh! You followed me? This crystal is ours now!
lines.zh: 嘘！你跟过来了？这颗水晶现在是我们的了！

lines.en: Be quiet, kid! No more colour words!
lines.zh: 安静点，小鬼！不许再说颜色了！

lines.en: The other one still has the crystal!
lines.zh: 水晶还在另一个团员手上！

lines.en: Shh... Fine! Take your noisy crystal!
lines.zh: 嘘……好吧！拿走你们吵死人的水晶！

lines.en: Colours are coming back to Crayon Island!
lines.zh: 颜色回到彩色文具岛了！快回镇上看看吧！

lines.en: Look! My house is pink again! The sky is blue! Thank you, {name}!
lines.zh: 你看！我的房子又是粉色的了！天空是蓝色的！谢谢你，{name}！

lines.en: Can you say it with me? "Red, yellow, blue and green!"
lines.zh: 和我一起说：「红、黄、蓝、绿！」

lines.en: Red, yellow, blue and green!
lines.zh: 一起大声说！

lines.en: Take these. Now go and see the Rainbow Crab at the Challenge Hall!
lines.zh: 这些送给你。现在去挑战馆找彩虹蟹吧！

lines.en: Every colour is beautiful. Keep your world colourful!
lines.zh: 每种颜色都很美。让你的世界一直多彩吧！

lines.en: Welcome to my art studio! I paint every day.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的画室！我每天都画画。

lines.en: Great! Come back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 答对了！明天再来吧。

lines.en: Great! Here is a potion.
lines.zh: 答对了！送你一瓶药水。

lines.en: Look at my picture. What is it?
So you are {name}! Kai told me about you.
lines.zh: 你就是 {name} 吧！小凯跟我说起过你。

lines.en: Kai is shy. But today he spoke loudly! Thank you.
lines.zh: 小凯很害羞，可今天他大声说话了！谢谢你。

lines.en: Here, take these Gold Echo Balls.
lines.zh: 这些金回声球送给你。

lines.en: This is my family photo. This is my sister, and this is Kai.
lines.zh: 这是我的全家福。这是我妹妹，这是小凯。

lines.en: Owlet and I train every day. One day, I want to battle you!
lines.zh: 我和 Owlet 每天都在训练。总有一天，我要和你对战！

lines.en: Hello, dear! You look tired. Sit down and have a rest.
lines.zh: 你好呀，孩子！你看起来累了。坐下来歇一歇吧。

lines.en: Your monsters are fine now.
lines.zh: 你的怪兽们都恢复精神了。

lines.en: When you leave, what do you say?
lines.zh: 要走的时候，你会说什么？

lines.en: Goodbye! See you next time!
lines.zh: 和奶奶道别：大声说出来

lines.en: Goodbye, dear! Come back anytime.
lines.zh: 再见，孩子！随时回来。

lines.en: Oh? Hello. I did not hear you come in.
lines.zh: 哦？你好。我没听见你进来。

lines.en: My name is Orion. I study old words. These words on the stone are very old.
lines.zh: 我叫欧瑞，研究古老的词语。这石头上的字非常古老。

lines.en: They tell a story. Long ago, a giant monster ate every sound in the world.
lines.zh: 它们讲了一个故事：很久以前，一只巨兽吞掉了世界上所有的声音。

lines.en: People called it the Hush King. Then everyone spoke together, and Echodrake woke up.
lines.zh: 人们叫它寂静之王。后来大家一起大声说话，回声龙醒了过来。

lines.en: Some people want a quiet world again. Be careful on your journey, {name}.
lines.zh: 有些人又想要一个安静的世界。旅途中要小心，{name}。

lines.en: Can you read the stone for me? Read it loudly.
lines.zh: 你能帮我把石头上的字念出来吗？大声念。

lines.en: Words have power.
lines.zh: 大声念出石头上的字

lines.en: Well done. Your voice is clear. We will meet again.
lines.zh: 很好。你的声音很清楚。我们还会再见的。

lines.en: The Hush King... I must learn more about it.
lines.zh: 寂静之王……我得再多了解一些。

lines.en: Your monsters are tired. Heal them first, then come back!
lines.zh: 你的怪兽都累了。先去给它们恢复体力，再回来吧！

lines.en: Squawk! Hello! Hello! Talk to the gate!
lines.zh: 嘎！你好！你好！对着门说话！

lines.en: Our Color Crystal is gone! Everything is grey. I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 我们的颜色水晶不见了！到处都是灰色的，我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: Listen to the speaker. Walk only on that colour!
lines.zh: 听广播：只能踩广播说的那种颜色！

lines.en: A scarecrow in the field.
lines.zh: 田里的稻草人。

lines.en: It keeps the birds away.
lines.zh: 它能把鸟赶走。

lines.en: An old well. Tim's family meets here.
lines.zh: 一口老井。蒂姆一家常在这里碰头。

lines.en: Family Island. Family comes first!
lines.zh: 温馨家庭岛。家人最重要！

lines.en: North: Route 3. A small tree blocks the road.
lines.zh: 往北：3 号路。路口有一棵小树挡着。

lines.en: Team Hush took the Family Crystal! I can't find my son!
lines.zh: 嘘声团偷走了家庭水晶！我找不到我儿子了！

lines.en: Sorry, I'm not his mom. I have short hair.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我不是他妈妈。我是短头发。

lines.en: I have two daughters.
I have two daughters. They are at school now.
lines.zh: 我有两个女儿，她们现在在学校。

lines.en: No, I'm not. Look, my dress is blue, not red.
lines.zh: 不，我不是。你看，我的裙子是蓝色的，不是红色的。

lines.en: My family has five people.
This is my home. My family has five people.
lines.zh: 这是我家。我家有五口人。

lines.en: I was fishing, and my son ran away!
lines.zh: 我刚才在钓鱼，我儿子就跑不见了！

lines.en: No, I'm not. I have glasses, but I don't have a cap.
lines.zh: 不，我不是。我戴眼镜，可是我没戴帽子。

lines.en: My father is a doctor.
My father is a doctor. He works in the big city.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是一名医生，他在大城市工作。

lines.en: No, I'm not. I have a green cap, but no glasses.
lines.zh: 不，我不是。我戴绿帽子，可是不戴眼镜。

lines.en: I grow corn and carrots with my uncle.
lines.zh: 我和我叔叔一起种玉米和胡萝卜。

lines.en: I work with my uncle.
These flowers are so pretty. Where is my grandson?
lines.zh: 这些花真好看。我的小孙子去哪儿了？

lines.en: No, dear. I have white hair, but I love cats, not flowers.
lines.zh: 不是哦，孩子。我头发是白的，可我喜欢猫，不喜欢花。

lines.en: These are my grandchildren in the photo.
lines.zh: 照片里这些是我的孙子孙女。

lines.en: These are my grandchildren.
Ha ha! I love flowers, but I'm a grandpa, not a grandma!
lines.zh: 哈哈！我是喜欢花，可我是爷爷，不是奶奶！

lines.en: I love my garden.
I love my garden. My grandson helps me every day.
lines.zh: 我爱我的花园。我孙子每天都来帮我。

lines.en: Look at my windmill! My grandfather built it.
lines.zh: 看我的风车！是我爷爷建的。

lines.en: This is my family's farm.
lines.zh: 这是我们家的农场。

lines.en: Do you have a brother?
lines.zh: 你有兄弟吗？

lines.en: I have a little brother.
I have a little brother. He is a baby!
lines.zh: 我有一个弟弟，他还是个小宝宝！

lines.en: I'm the Tree Doctor. I take care of the trees on this island.
lines.zh: 我是树医生，我照顾这座岛上的树。

lines.en: Please help little Tim at the well first.
lines.zh: 请先去井边帮帮小蒂姆吧。

lines.en: Team Hush took the Family Crystal. Everyone is sad.
lines.zh: 嘘声团偷走了家庭水晶，大家都很难过。

lines.en: Take this. It is the Echo Shell for Clear Way.
lines.zh: 这个送给你，它是「开路」的回声贝。

lines.en: You saved the Family Crystal! Thank you!
lines.zh: 你夺回了家庭水晶！谢谢你！

lines.en: A small tree blocks the road to Route 3.
lines.zh: 去 3 号路的路口有一棵小树挡着。

lines.en: Beat Granny Turtle at the Challenge Hall first!
lines.zh: 先去挑战馆打败海龟奶奶吧！

lines.en: With three badges, your monster can cut it.
lines.zh: 有了三枚徽章，你的怪兽就能把它砍掉。

lines.en: Cut only the small trees on the road, OK?
lines.zh: 只砍路上的小树哦，好吗？

lines.en: Trees are like a family.
Trees are like a family. They grow up together.
lines.zh: 树就像一家人，它们一起长大。

lines.en: No, I'm not. I'm Granny's best friend. Look, I don't have glasses!
lines.zh: 不，我不是。我是奶奶最好的朋友。你看，我没戴眼镜！

lines.en: Are you looking for the grandma? I'm the aunt! I have glasses, but my hair is brown!
lines.zh: 你在找奶奶吗？我是阿姨！我戴眼镜，可是我的头发是棕色的！

lines.en: I'm the aunt. My mother is the grandma!
lines.zh: 我是阿姨。我妈妈就是奶奶！

lines.en: The grandma has white hair, dear.
lines.zh: 奶奶的头发是白的哦。

lines.en: No, I'm not the dad. I'm the brother! I don't have a cap.
lines.zh: 不，我不是爸爸，我是哥哥！我没有帽子。

lines.en: The dad? No, I'm the uncle! My jacket is green!
lines.zh: 爸爸？不，我是叔叔！我的外套是绿色的！

lines.en: I'm the uncle. The dad is my brother.
lines.zh: 我是叔叔，爸爸是我哥哥。

lines.en: The dad has a blue jacket.
lines.zh: 爸爸穿蓝外套。

lines.en: No, I'm the big sister. I have a ponytail, not pigtails!
lines.zh: 不，我是姐姐。我扎的是马尾，不是两条小辫子！

lines.en: I have pigtails too! But I'm the cousin, and my dress is yellow!
lines.zh: 我也扎两条小辫子！可我是表妹，我的裙子是黄色的！

lines.en: I'm the cousin. My mom is the aunt.
lines.zh: 我是表妹，我妈妈是阿姨。

lines.en: The little sister has a pink dress.
lines.zh: 妹妹穿粉色的裙子。

lines.en: Farm Loop. Apples, rice and happy farmers!
lines.zh: 农田环路：苹果、稻田和快乐的农夫！

lines.en: My brother and I pick apples every autumn.
lines.zh: 每年秋天我和哥哥一起摘苹果。

lines.en: My family grows apples. Let's battle!
lines.zh: 我们家种苹果。来对战吧！

lines.en: Wow! You're as strong as my big brother!
lines.zh: 哇！你和我哥哥一样厉害！

lines.en: My father is a farmer. My mother is a teacher.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是农民，我妈妈是老师。

lines.en: My father will laugh at me!
lines.zh: 我爸爸要笑话我了！

lines.en: Who is he? Oh, he's my father. And I'm a trainer!
lines.zh: 他是谁？哦，他是我爸爸。而我是训练师！

lines.en: I'll tell my cousins about you!
lines.zh: 我要告诉我的表兄弟姐妹们你有多厉害！

lines.en: My cousins and I play here every day!
lines.zh: 我和表兄弟姐妹们每天都在这里玩！

lines.en: Those are my cousins over there.
lines.zh: 那边那些是我的表兄弟姐妹。

lines.en: I'm Kim's uncle. Show me your monsters!
lines.zh: 我是小金的叔叔。给我看看你的怪兽！

lines.en: My brother has three children. I am their uncle.
lines.zh: 我哥哥有三个孩子，我是他们的叔叔。

lines.en: You are good! Is your father a trainer too?
lines.zh: 你真棒！你爸爸也是训练师吗？

lines.en: How many people are there in your family?
lines.zh: 你家有几口人？

lines.en: My sister is Kim's mother. I'm Kim's aunt.
lines.zh: 我姐姐是小金的妈妈，我是小金的阿姨。

lines.en: Tell me after our battle!
lines.zh: 对战完再告诉我吧！

lines.en: There are four people in my family. And you beat us all!
lines.zh: 我家有四口人，你把我们都打败了！

lines.en: Campus Island is just ahead!
lines.zh: 前面就是校园岛了！

lines.en: Route 3. North: Campus Island.
lines.zh: 3 号路。往北走是校园岛。

lines.en: I need to study more!
lines.zh: 我得多学习了！

lines.en: I'm going to Campus Island. My school is there!
lines.zh: 我要去校园岛，我的学校在那里！

lines.en: There is a big playground in our school.
lines.zh: 我们学校有一个大操场。

lines.en: I have a twin sister. Can you find her?
lines.zh: 我有一个双胞胎妹妹。你能找到她吗？

lines.en: My sister is better than me!
lines.zh: 我妹妹比我厉害！

lines.en: My sister is on the other side of the river.
lines.zh: 我妹妹在河的另一边。

lines.en: My son and I fish here every Sunday!
lines.zh: 我和我儿子每个星期天都在这里钓鱼！

lines.en: My son is twelve. He likes fishing too.
lines.zh: 我儿子十二岁，他也喜欢钓鱼。

lines.en: My son will laugh at me!
lines.zh: 我儿子要笑话我了！

lines.en: Ann is my sister. We are twelve.
lines.zh: 安是我姐姐，我们十二岁。

lines.en: I'm Ann's twin sister! We look the same!
lines.zh: 我是安的双胞胎妹妹！我们长得一模一样！

lines.en: You beat both of us!
lines.zh: 你把我们俩都打败了！

lines.en: Ho ho! You are a great trainer!
lines.zh: 呵呵！你是个了不起的训练师！

lines.en: I have five grandchildren. They all love monsters.
lines.zh: 我有五个孙子孙女，他们都喜欢怪兽。

lines.en: These are my grandchildren's monsters. Be careful!
lines.zh: 这些是我孙子孙女的怪兽。小心哦！

lines.en: It rings at eight every morning.
lines.zh: 每天早上八点它就会响。

lines.en: The school bell. Ding-dong!
lines.zh: 学校的钟。叮咚！

lines.en: Welcome to Campus Island! Welcome to my school!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到校园岛！欢迎来到我的学校！

lines.en: I can't work with Team Hush in the school!
lines.zh: 嘘声团在学校里捣乱，我没法干活！

lines.en: The tunnel to Subject Island is full of cracked rocks.
lines.zh: 去学科岛的隧道里全是裂开的大石头。

lines.en: Take this Echo Shell. Now Clear Way can break rocks!
lines.zh: 这个回声贝送给你。有了它，「开路」升到 2 级，能敲碎裂石了贝。

lines.en: You saved the school! You are a hero!
lines.zh: 你救了学校！你是个英雄！

lines.en: The tunnel is right behind me. Good luck!
lines.zh: 隧道就在我身后。祝你好运！

lines.en: With four badges, your monster can smash cracked rocks.
lines.zh: 有了四枚徽章，你的怪兽就能打碎有裂缝的岩石。

lines.en: Smash the cracked rocks in the tunnel, and go north!
lines.zh: 打碎隧道里的裂石，一直往北走！

lines.en: Smash the rock!
I'm Ms Bell, the English teacher.
lines.zh: 我是贝尔老师，教英语的。

lines.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
lines.zh: 我们的教室在二楼。

lines.en: Run on the track every morning!
lines.zh: 每天早上都来跑道上跑步吧！

lines.en: The gym is across from the library.
lines.zh: 体育馆在图书馆对面。

lines.en: How many desks are there in your classroom?
lines.zh: 你的教室里有多少张课桌？

lines.en: There are forty desks in my classroom.
lines.zh: 我的教室里有四十张课桌。

lines.en: LIBRARY
DINING
HALL
OFFICE
CLASS
EXIT
COMPUTER
The library is next to the dining hall.
lines.zh: 图书馆就在食堂旁边。

lines.en: Welcome to the dining hall! Lunch is at twelve.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到食堂！十二点开饭。

lines.en: Is there a lab in your school?
lines.zh: 你的学校有实验室吗？

lines.en: Ours is on the second floor.
lines.zh: 我们的在二楼。

lines.en: This is the office. I'm Mr Grey.
lines.zh: 这里是办公室。我是格雷老师。

lines.en: This is Class 1A. I sit next to the window.
lines.zh: 这是 1A 班。我坐在窗户旁边。

lines.en: This is my classroom.
There are six computers.
This is the computer room. There are six computers.
lines.zh: 这是电脑室，这里有六台电脑。

lines.en: LAB
MUSIC
The lab is next to the music room.
lines.zh: 实验室就在音乐教室旁边。

lines.en: This is the music room. Let's sing!
lines.zh: 这是音乐教室。我们来唱歌吧！

lines.en: No talking in class! Unless it's a battle!
lines.zh: 上课不许说话！除非是对战！

lines.en: Oh no, I'll be late for class!
lines.zh: 糟了，我上课要迟到了！

lines.en: The answer is on the blackboard. Listen carefully!
lines.zh: 题目在黑板上，仔细听！

lines.en: Our school has a big library. Do you like reading?
lines.zh: 我们学校有个大图书馆。你喜欢读书吗？

lines.en: You must read a lot!
lines.zh: 你一定读了很多书！

lines.en: I'm the class monitor. Sit down, please!
lines.zh: 我是班长。请坐好！

lines.en: OK, OK. You can go!
lines.zh: 好吧好吧，你可以过去了！

lines.en: The principal's office is behind this door.
lines.zh: 校长室就在这扇门后面。

lines.en: An old stone. It says: "Knowledge is power."
lines.zh: 一块古老的石碑，上面写着：“知识就是力量。”

lines.en: People say a monster that reads minds lives here.
lines.zh: 听说这里住着一只能读懂人心的怪兽。

lines.en: Book Mountain. Watch your step!
lines.zh: 书山小道。小心脚下！

lines.en: I climb this mountain after school every day!
lines.zh: 我每天放学后都来爬这座山！

lines.en: My legs are tired now!
lines.zh: 我的腿都累了！

lines.en: The top of the mountain is up there. It is very quiet.
lines.zh: 山顶就在上面，那里很安静。

lines.en: I'm in the hiking club at school. Let's battle!
lines.zh: 我是学校登山社的。来对战吧！

lines.en: Our club meets in the gym on Friday.
lines.zh: 我们社团每周五在体育馆集合。

lines.en: Our club needs a trainer like you!
lines.zh: 我们社团需要你这样的训练师！

lines.en: I will find my way. Bye!
lines.zh: 我自己会找到路的。再见！

lines.en: Jump down the ledges. It's faster!
lines.zh: 从台阶上跳下去，比较快！

lines.en: Where is the top? I'm lost!
lines.zh: 山顶在哪儿？我迷路了！

lines.en: I lost my map of the school. Did you see it?
lines.zh: 我把学校地图弄丢了。你看见了吗？

lines.en: Never mind the map!
lines.zh: 地图就算了吧！

lines.en: Our school has a big library.
lines.zh: 我们学校有一个大图书馆。

lines.en: I dig here every day. Where is my map?
lines.zh: 我每天都在这里挖。我的地图去哪儿了？

lines.en: My map says: "The exit is north."
lines.zh: 我的地图上写着：“出口在北边。”

lines.en: The exit is north. Keep going!
lines.zh: 出口在北边，继续走！

lines.en: Cracked rocks? Only Clear Way 2 can open them.
lines.zh: 裂开的岩石？只有「开路 2 级」才能敲碎它们。

lines.en: This tunnel goes from the school to the lab!
lines.zh: 这条隧道从学校一直通到实验室！

lines.en: You are strong like a rock!
lines.zh: 你像石头一样坚强！

lines.en: I'm on a school trip! Our teacher is lost!
lines.zh: 我在春游！我们老师迷路了！

lines.en: My teacher is in the library, I think.
lines.zh: 我觉得我的老师在图书馆。

lines.en: Where is my teacher?
lines.zh: 我的老师在哪儿？

lines.en: Route 4. South: Crack Tunnel.
lines.zh: 4 号路。往南是裂石隧道。

lines.en: Subject Island is just ahead!
lines.zh: 前面就是学科岛了！

lines.en: I teach science on Subject Island. Science is fun!
lines.zh: 我在学科岛教科学。科学很有趣！

lines.en: My favourite subject is science.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是科学。

lines.en: That was a good experiment!
lines.zh: 这真是一次不错的实验！

lines.en: I like music more than battles!
lines.zh: 比起对战，我更喜欢音乐！

lines.en: We have music on Wednesday. I can't wait!
lines.zh: 我们星期三有音乐课，我等不及了！

lines.en: Why do I like music? Because it's relaxing.
lines.zh: 我为什么喜欢音乐？因为它让人放松。

lines.en: Art is my favourite subject.
lines.zh: 美术是我最喜欢的科目。

lines.en: We have art on Friday. Let me draw your monster!
lines.zh: 我们周五有美术课。让我画画你的怪兽！

lines.en: What a beautiful battle!
lines.zh: 多美的一场对战！

lines.en: I like PE best! Let's go!
lines.zh: 我最喜欢体育课！开始吧！

lines.en: We have PE on Monday and Thursday.
lines.zh: 我们周一和周四有体育课。

lines.en: You are faster than me!
lines.zh: 你比我还快！

lines.en: Hmm, battles are difficult too!
lines.zh: 嗯，对战也挺难的！

lines.en: How many subjects do you have? We have nine.
lines.zh: 你们有几门课？我们有九门。

lines.en: I think maths is difficult. But battles are easy!
lines.zh: 我觉得数学很难，可对战很简单！

lines.en: A small telescope. You can see the sea.
lines.zh: 一架小望远镜，可以看到大海。

lines.en: A big satellite dish. It listens to the sky.
lines.zh: 一个大卫星天线，它在“听”天空的声音。

lines.en: Another satellite dish. It is pointing at the stars.
lines.zh: 另一个卫星天线，它对着星星。

lines.en: Subject Island. Which subject do you like best?
lines.zh: 学科岛。你最喜欢哪一科？

lines.en: Ahoy! I'm Captain Gale. My ferry goes to Club Island.
lines.zh: 你好呀！我是盖尔船长，我的渡轮开往社团岛。

lines.en: You have five badges. Welcome aboard!
lines.zh: 你有五枚徽章了，欢迎上船！

lines.en: Ahoy! I'm Captain Gale.
lines.zh: 你好呀！我是盖尔船长。

lines.en: Come back with five badges. Then I can take you!
lines.zh: 等你有了五枚徽章再来，我就带你过去！

lines.en: My ferry goes to Club Island. But the sea is rough.
lines.zh: 我的渡轮开往社团岛，可是海上风浪很大。

lines.en: Geography is interesting!
The ferry goes to Club Island. It takes one hour.
lines.zh: 渡轮开往社团岛，要坐一个小时。

lines.en: We have geography on the ship every day!
lines.zh: 我们每天在船上上地理课！

lines.en: But my maths teacher is very kind.
lines.zh: 可是我的数学老师很和蔼。

lines.en: I think maths is difficult.
lines.zh: 我觉得数学很难。

lines.en: History is interesting.
History is interesting. Biology is interesting too!
lines.zh: 历史很有趣，生物也很有趣！

lines.en: Who is your English teacher?
lines.zh: 你的英语老师是谁？

lines.en: Doctor Octo is waiting for you at the Challenge Hall!
lines.zh: 八爪博士在挑战馆等你！

lines.en: His favourite subject? All of them!
lines.zh: 他最喜欢哪一科？全都喜欢！

lines.en: Doctor Octo is not here. He is in his lab.
lines.zh: 八爪博士不在，他在自己的实验室里。

lines.en: Team Hush mixed up all his books!
lines.zh: 嘘声团把他的书全弄乱了！

lines.en: My experiment failed!
lines.zh: 我的实验失败了！

lines.en: Science first? Or maths first? Listen to the timetable!
lines.zh: 先上科学？还是先上数学？听课程表！

lines.en: When do you have science? We have it every day!
lines.zh: 你们什么时候上科学课？我们天天都上！

lines.en: History is still interesting!
lines.zh: 历史还是很有趣！

lines.en: I think history is interesting. What do you think?
lines.zh: 我觉得历史很有趣。你觉得呢？

lines.en: Why do you like art? Because it's fun!
lines.zh: 你为什么喜欢美术？因为它很好玩！

lines.en: I teach geography. The world is big!
lines.zh: 我教地理。世界很大！

lines.en: We have nine subjects on this island.
lines.zh: 我们岛上一共有九门课。

lines.en: You know a lot about the world!
lines.zh: 你懂的真多！

lines.en: Seaside Path. Look at the sea and the lighthouse!
lines.zh: 海岸路。看看大海和灯塔吧！

lines.en: Biology is still my favourite!
lines.zh: 生物还是我最喜欢的科目！

lines.en: Birds fly south in winter. That's biology!
lines.zh: 冬天鸟儿往南飞。这就是生物学！

lines.en: We have biology on Tuesday. I study birds!
lines.zh: 我们星期二有生物课。我研究鸟！

lines.en: Geography teaches you about the sea.
lines.zh: 地理课会教你关于大海的知识。

lines.en: I don't like school. I like fishing!
lines.zh: 我不喜欢上学，我喜欢钓鱼！

lines.en: Maybe I should go to geography class...
lines.zh: 也许我该去上地理课了……

lines.en: PE is my favourite subject. I swim every day!
lines.zh: 体育是我最喜欢的科目。我每天都游泳！

lines.en: When do you have PE? We have it on Monday.
lines.zh: 你们什么时候上体育课？我们周一上。

lines.en: You swim faster than me!
lines.zh: 你游得比我还快！

lines.en: Art is relaxing. That's why I like it.
lines.zh: 美术让人放松，所以我喜欢它。

lines.en: I'm painting the sea for my art class.
lines.zh: 我在为美术课画大海。

lines.en: My painting is ruined!
lines.zh: 我的画被弄坏了！

lines.en: My mom has long hair. She has a red dress.
lines.zh: 我妈妈留着长头发，穿一条红裙子。

lines.en: She has long hair and a blue dress.
She has long hair and a red dress.
She has short hair and a red dress.
What does his mom look like?
lines.zh: 他妈妈长什么样？

lines.en: My dad is tall. He has glasses and a green cap.
lines.zh: 我爸爸个子高高的，戴着眼镜和一顶绿帽子。

lines.en: He has a green cap. No glasses.
He has glasses and a green cap.
He has glasses and a red cap.
What does his dad have?
lines.zh: 他爸爸戴着什么？

lines.en: My grandma has white hair. She loves flowers.
lines.zh: 我奶奶头发白白的，她特别喜欢花。

lines.en: She loves cats.
She loves flowers.
She loves music.
What does his grandma love?
lines.zh: 他奶奶喜欢什么？

lines.en: Ring, ring! Mom is calling!
lines.zh: 叮铃铃！妈妈打电话来了！

lines.en: Hello, {name}! It's Mom. How are you?
lines.zh: 喂，{name}！我是妈妈。你好吗？

lines.en: How are you, dear?
lines.zh: 你好吗，宝贝？（选一句回答妈妈，再说出来）

lines.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
I'm twelve.
It's a phone.
I'm fine, too. Are you on Family Island now?
lines.zh: 我也很好。你现在到温馨家庭岛了吗？

lines.en: Granny Turtle lives there. She loves big families.
lines.zh: 海龟奶奶住在那里，她最喜欢热热闹闹的一大家子了。

lines.en: Don't forget to eat breakfast every day!
lines.zh: 别忘了每天都要吃早饭！

lines.en: OK, Mom. I love you!
lines.zh: 对妈妈说：好的妈妈，我爱你！

lines.en: I love you, too! Call me soon. Bye-bye!
lines.zh: 我也爱你！记得常给我打电话。拜拜！

lines.en: Wait... you hear a little boy crying near the well.
lines.zh: 咦……你听到井边有个小男孩在哭。

lines.en: Thank you, {name}! This is my family!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}！这是我的家人！

lines.en: This is my family.
lines.zh: 跟蒂姆一起说：这是我的家人。

lines.en: Wah... I can't find my family!
lines.zh: 呜哇……我找不到我的家人了！

lines.en: Team Hush took the Family Crystal. Now I can't even say... m... m...
lines.zh: 嘘声团偷走了家庭水晶。现在我连……妈……妈……都说不出来了。

lines.en: Help Tim! Say the family words for him.
lines.zh: 帮帮蒂姆！替他把家人的称呼说出来。

lines.en: Mom, Dad and Grandma!
lines.zh: 大声说：Mom, Dad and Grandma!

lines.en: Yes! Mom, Dad and Grandma! Thank you!
lines.zh: 对！妈妈、爸爸和奶奶！谢谢你！

lines.en: We were at the well. Then Team Hush came, and everyone ran away!
lines.zh: 我们本来在井边，嘘声团一来，大家都跑散了！

lines.en: Listen. I will tell you what they look like.
lines.zh: 听好，我告诉你他们长什么样。

lines.en: I will wait here by the well.
lines.zh: 我就在井边等着。

lines.en: Please find them! Ask them: "Are you Tim's mom?"
lines.zh: 请帮我找到他们！问他们：“您是蒂姆的妈妈吗？”

lines.en: Did you find my family?
lines.zh: 你找到我的家人了吗？

lines.en: Is it Team Hush?
lines.zh: 难道是嘘声团？

lines.en: Look! That scarecrow in the windmill field is moving!
lines.zh: 快看！风车田里那个稻草人在动！

lines.en: Yes, I am! Where is he? Is he OK?
lines.zh: 是的，就是我！他在哪儿？他还好吗？

lines.en: He's at school.
He's at the well.
He's in the gym.
Where is Tim now?
lines.zh: 蒂姆现在在哪儿？

lines.en: Thank you so much! I'm going to him now!
lines.zh: 太谢谢你了！我这就去找他！

lines.en: Tim's family is together again!
lines.zh: 蒂姆一家终于团聚了！

lines.en: Mom! Dad! Grandma!
lines.zh: 妈妈！爸爸！奶奶！

lines.en: Thank you, young trainer!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，小训练师！

lines.en: Oh! Look at the windmill field. That scarecrow is moving!
lines.zh: 哎呀！看风车田，那个稻草人在动！

lines.en: That is not our scarecrow. It must be Team Hush!
lines.zh: 那不是我们家的稻草人，肯定是嘘声团！

lines.en: Thank you for finding Tim!
lines.zh: 谢谢你找到了蒂姆！

lines.en: Who is she? She's my mother, Tim's grandma.
lines.zh: 她是谁？她是我妈妈，也就是蒂姆的奶奶。

lines.en: Family is the most important thing.
lines.zh: 家人是最重要的。

lines.en: My father is a doctor, and I'm a farmer.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是医生，我是农民。

lines.en: I love flowers. Here, smell this one!
lines.zh: 我喜欢花。来，闻闻这朵！

lines.en: These are my grandchildren. Tim is the youngest.
lines.zh: 这些都是我的孙子孙女，蒂姆是最小的。

lines.en: It looks like a scarecrow... but it is shaking!
lines.zh: 看起来像个稻草人……可它在发抖！

lines.en: Hey! You're not a scarecrow!
lines.zh: 大声说：嘿！你根本不是稻草人！

lines.en: Shh! How did you know?!
lines.zh: 嘘！你怎么知道的？！

lines.en: A quiet home is a good home!
lines.zh: 安安静静的家才是好家！

lines.en: I took the Family Crystal. Families talk too much!
lines.zh: 家庭水晶是我偷的。一家人话太多了！

lines.en: Shh... Fine! Take your silly crystal!
lines.zh: 嘘……好吧！把你们的破水晶拿回去！

lines.en: The Tree Doctor wants to see you. His hut is near the north road.
lines.zh: 树医生想见你。他的小屋在北边路口旁边。

lines.en: The grandma has white hair and glasses.
lines.zh: 奶奶头发白白的，戴着眼镜。

lines.en: She has brown hair and glasses.
She has white hair and glasses.
She has white hair. No glasses.
What does the grandma look like?
lines.zh: 奶奶长什么样？

lines.en: The dad has a black cap and a blue jacket.
lines.zh: 爸爸戴黑帽子，穿蓝外套。

lines.en: A black cap and a blue jacket.
A black cap and a green jacket.
A blue jacket. No cap.
What does the dad wear?
lines.zh: 爸爸穿戴着什么？

lines.en: The little sister has pigtails and a pink dress.
lines.zh: 妹妹扎着两条小辫子，穿粉色的裙子。

lines.en: She has a ponytail and a pink dress.
She has pigtails and a pink dress.
She has pigtails and a yellow dress.
What does the little sister look like?
lines.zh: 妹妹长什么样？

lines.en: Welcome to my Family Tree, dear!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的家族树，孩子！

lines.en: Find my family: the grandma, the dad and the little sister.
lines.zh: 找到我的家人：奶奶、爸爸和妹妹。

lines.en: Ask them: "Are you the grandma?" If you ask the wrong one... back you go!
lines.zh: 问他们：“您是奶奶吗？”问错了人……就回到这间屋子的起点！

lines.en: Go on, dear! Granny is waiting.
lines.zh: 去吧，孩子！奶奶在等你。

lines.en: Good luck!
lines.zh: 加油！

lines.en: Yes, I am! You found me!
lines.zh: 是的，就是我！你找到我了！

lines.en: Well done! The next door is open.
lines.zh: 真棒！下一扇门打开了。

lines.en: You found my whole family! Come and see me, dear.
lines.zh: 你把我的家人都找齐了！来见我吧，孩子。

lines.en: Wrong person! Back to the start of this room.
lines.zh: 找错人啦！回到这间屋子的起点。

lines.en: {name}! Wait for me!
lines.zh: {name}！等等我！

lines.en: I called my mom and dad this morning. They say hi!
lines.zh: 我今天早上给爸爸妈妈打了电话，他们向你问好！

lines.en: It's my family.
There are four.
Cool! Now let's battle! I got stronger!
lines.zh: 酷！现在来对战吧！我变强了！

lines.en: I'm going to Campus Island. See you at school!
lines.zh: 我要去校园岛了，学校见！

lines.en: Wow! Your monsters love you like a family!
lines.zh: 哇！你的怪兽像家人一样爱你！

lines.en: See you at school on Campus Island!
lines.zh: 校园岛的学校见！

lines.en: The Family Crystal is gone, dear. I can't think about battles now.
lines.zh: 孩子，家庭水晶不见了，我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: A family photo. Granny wrote under it:
lines.zh: 一张全家福，奶奶在下面写着字：

lines.en: A photo of Granny Turtle's big family. Everyone is smiling.
lines.zh: 海龟奶奶一大家子的合照，每个人都在笑。

lines.en: Ding-dong! Ding-dong! The school bell is ringing.
lines.zh: 叮咚！叮咚！学校的钟声响了。

lines.en: Oh, hello! Are you a new student?
lines.zh: 哦，你好！你是新同学吗？

lines.en: Team Hush is in our school! They want to stop our English class!
lines.zh: 嘘声团闯进我们学校了！他们要取消我们的英语课！

lines.en: {name}! I saw a woman in a purple coat. She ran into the school building!
lines.zh: {name}！我看见一个穿紫色外套的女人，她跑进教学楼了！

lines.en: That is Whisper, a leader of Team Hush. She took our School Crystal!
lines.zh: 她是嘘声团的干部低语，她偷走了我们的校园水晶！

lines.en: Can you help us?
lines.zh: 你能帮帮我们吗？

lines.en: No, it isn't.
Yes, I am.
Yes, I can.
Thank you! The school building is the big red one with the clock.
lines.zh: 谢谢你！教学楼就是那栋有钟楼的红砖大楼。

lines.en: Let's find her together!
lines.zh: 我们一起去找她吧！

lines.en: Let's go to the school building!
lines.zh: 大声说：我们去教学楼吧！

lines.en: {name}! Look, Whisper dropped a note!
lines.zh: {name}！快看，低语掉了一张纸条！

lines.en: The note says: "Meet me in the library. — W"
lines.zh: 纸条上写着：“图书馆见。——W”

lines.en: The library? Where is the library? Let's ask someone.
lines.zh: 图书馆？图书馆在哪儿呢？我们找人问问吧。

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the library?
lines.zh: 有礼貌地问：请问图书馆在哪儿？

lines.en: It's next to the dining hall.
lines.zh: （仔细听她怎么说）

lines.en: It's next to the office.
It's on the second floor.
Where is the library?
lines.zh: 图书馆在哪儿？

lines.en: Yes! It's next to the dining hall. Go up the hall and look for the sign.
lines.zh: 对！它在食堂旁边。沿着走廊往里走，看地上的牌子。

lines.en: Welcome to my school!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的学校！

lines.en: Shh! This is a library. Please be quiet.
lines.zh: 嘘！这里是图书馆，请安静。

lines.en: A woman in a purple coat? Yes, she was here.
lines.zh: 穿紫色外套的女人？对，她来过。

lines.en: She took a map of the school and went to the lab.
lines.zh: 她拿走了一张学校地图，去实验室了。

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the lab?
lines.zh: 问一问：请问实验室在哪儿？

lines.en: It's on the second floor, next to the music room.
lines.zh: （仔细听）

lines.en: It's behind the gym.
It's next to the library.
Where is the lab?
lines.zh: 实验室在哪儿？

lines.en: Right. Take the stairs at the end of the hall.
lines.zh: 对。走廊尽头有楼梯。

lines.en: Shh! This is a library.
lines.zh: 嘘！这里是图书馆。

lines.en: We have many English books. Do you like reading?
lines.zh: 我们有很多英语书。你喜欢读书吗？

lines.en: No more English class! No more talking!
lines.zh: 不许上英语课！不许说话！

lines.en: Shh! This lab is ours now!
lines.zh: 嘘！这间实验室现在归我们了！

lines.en: Shh... Fine! Whisper is in Class Five. She is going to erase all the English lessons!
lines.zh: 嘘……好吧！低语在五班，她要把英语课的内容全擦掉！

lines.en: Excuse me, where is Class Five?
lines.zh: 问一问：请问五班在哪儿？

lines.en: It's at the end of the hall, next to the lab.
lines.zh: （仔细听）

lines.en: It's next to the lab.
It's next to the music room.
It's on the first floor.
Where is Class Five?
lines.zh: 五班在哪儿？

lines.en: Yes! Go left. A woman in a purple coat just went in. Hurry!
lines.zh: 对！往左走。刚才有个穿紫色外套的女人进去了。快！

lines.en: I like English class. The teacher is fun!
lines.zh: 我喜欢英语课，老师很有趣！

lines.en: Shh... You found me, little trainer.
lines.zh: 嘘……你找到我了，小训练师。

lines.en: English class is so noisy. I will erase every word on this blackboard.
lines.zh: 英语课太吵了。我要把黑板上的每个词都擦掉。

lines.en: No way! We love English class!
lines.zh: 休想！我们最喜欢英语课了！

lines.en: Give back the School Crystal!
lines.zh: 大声说：把校园水晶还回来！

lines.en: Shh... then let's see how loud you are.
lines.zh: 嘘……那就让我看看你有多大声。

lines.en: Shh... You're loud. Too loud.
lines.zh: 嘘……你太吵了，真的太吵了。

lines.en: ...and the whole world will be quiet. Shh...
lines.zh: ……到时候整个世界都会安静下来。嘘……

lines.en: Remember my name: Whisper. One day the Hush King will wake up...
lines.zh: 记住我的名字：低语。总有一天，寂静之王会醒来……

lines.en: We did it! English class is saved!
lines.zh: 我们成功了！英语课保住了！

lines.en: I heard a miner is waiting at the tunnel. See you, {name}!
lines.zh: 听说有个矿工在隧道口等着。回头见，{name}！

lines.en: {name}! Hi! It's me, Kai!
lines.zh: {name}！嗨！是我，小凯！

lines.en: I came to see your school. It's so big!
lines.zh: 我来看看你的学校，好大呀！

lines.en: Is there a library in your school?
lines.zh: 你们学校有图书馆吗？

lines.en: Yes, it is.
Yes, there is.
Cool! I'm training hard, too. My monsters are getting stronger.
lines.zh: 真棒！我也在努力训练，我的怪兽越来越强了。

lines.en: Can we have a small battle? Just a little one...
lines.zh: 我们可以来一场小小的对战吗？就一小场……

lines.en: OK! I'll wait here on the playground.
lines.zh: 好！我就在操场这儿等你。

lines.en: I... I won? Really? Thank you for the battle!
lines.zh: 我……我赢了？真的吗？谢谢你陪我对战！

lines.en: Wow, you are so strong! I lost, but I learned a lot.
lines.zh: 哇，你好强！我输了，但是学到了好多。

lines.en: I'm going to Clock Island next. See you there!
lines.zh: 我接下来要去作息岛，到时候见！

lines.en: See you, Kai!
lines.zh: 跟小凯说再见：See you, Kai!

lines.en: Classroom 1. Listen to the teacher.
lines.zh: 第一间教室。听老师提问。

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the office?
lines.zh: （听老师的问题，选出合适的回答，再大声说出来）

lines.en: It's next to the hall.
It's nine o'clock.
You're welcome.
Classroom 2. Look at the picture on the blackboard.
lines.zh: 第二间教室。看黑板上的图。

lines.en: It's a gym.
It's a lab.
It's a library.
What's this room?
lines.zh: 这是什么教室？

lines.en: Classroom 3. The blackboard says: "Our classroom is on the third floor."
lines.zh: 第三间教室。黑板上写着：“我们的教室在三楼。”

lines.en: It's clean.
Room three.
The third floor.
Which floor is our classroom on?
lines.zh: 我们的教室在几楼？

lines.en: Welcome to my school! Take your seat, please.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的学校！请坐好。

lines.en: Each classroom has a question on the blackboard.
lines.zh: 每间教室的黑板上都有一道题。

lines.en: Answer it, and the door opens. A wrong answer? Back to your seat!
lines.zh: 答对了门就会开；答错了？回到座位上去！

lines.en: The door is open. Go to the next classroom!
lines.zh: 门已经开了，去下一间教室吧！

lines.en: Correct! The door is open.
lines.zh: 答对了！门开了。

lines.en: Wrong answer! Please go back to your seat.
lines.zh: 答错了！请回到座位上。

lines.en: Team Hush is in my school! No battles until the School Crystal is back!
lines.zh: 嘘声团闯进了我的学校！校园水晶回来之前不对战！

lines.en: The blackboard says: "English class today!"
lines.zh: 黑板上写着：“今天有英语课！”

lines.en: The blackboard says: "Let's learn English together!"
lines.zh: 黑板上写着：“我们一起学英语吧！”

lines.en: On Monday we have maths, English and science.
lines.zh: 星期一我们有数学、英语和科学。

lines.en: On Tuesday we have Chinese, music and PE.
lines.zh: 星期二我们有语文、音乐和体育。

lines.en: first
lines.zh: 第一

lines.en: second
lines.zh: 第二

lines.en: third
lines.zh: 第三

lines.en: Oh! A trainer! Please help us!
lines.zh: 啊！是训练师！请帮帮我们！

lines.en: I'm Nova, Doctor Octo's assistant.
lines.zh: 我是诺娃，八爪博士的助手。

lines.en: Team Hush broke into Doctor Octo's lab. All his books are mixed up!
lines.zh: 嘘声团闯进了八爪博士的实验室，他的书全被弄乱了！

lines.en: And they took our Subject Crystal!
lines.zh: 他们还偷走了我们的学科水晶！

lines.en: Can you help Doctor Octo?
lines.zh: 你能帮帮八爪博士吗？

lines.en: Yes, I do.
Thank you! The lab is the big glass dome in the middle of the town.
lines.zh: 谢谢你！实验室就是镇子中间那座玻璃圆顶的大楼。

lines.en: Oops! That is not the right order. Listen again!
lines.zh: 哎呀，顺序不对。再听一遍！

lines.en: Please stop Team Hush at the satellite dish!
lines.zh: 请去卫星天线那儿阻止嘘声团！

lines.en: Oh, hello! I'm Doctor Octo. I teach eight subjects at the same time!
lines.zh: 哦，你好！我是八爪博士，我能同时教八门课！

lines.en: But look at my bookshelf! Team Hush mixed up all my books!
lines.zh: 可是你看我的书架！嘘声团把我的书全弄乱了！

lines.en: I keep my books in the order of my timetable.
lines.zh: 我的书是按课程表的顺序摆的。

lines.en: Listen to the timetable, and put the books back in order. OK?
lines.zh: 听课程表，按顺序把书放回去，好吗？

lines.en: Wonderful! My books are back in order!
lines.zh: 太好了！我的书都回到原位了！

lines.en: I like PE best.
It's Monday.
My teacher is Mr Li.
What's your favourite subject?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢哪一科？

lines.en: Ha ha! I like all of them!
lines.zh: 哈哈！我每一科都喜欢！

lines.en: Hmm? What is this grey stone behind my books?
lines.zh: 嗯？书后面这块灰色的石头是什么？

lines.en: The room is suddenly very quiet. The stone is eating all the sounds!
lines.zh: 屋子里一下子变得特别安静——石头把声音都吸走了！

lines.en: It's a Hush Stone! Team Hush is collecting these stones.
lines.zh: 这是一块“静音石”！嘘声团在收集这种石头。

lines.en: With many Hush Stones, a whole island can go quiet!
lines.zh: 静音石多了，整座岛都会变得鸦雀无声！

lines.en: Nova saw them at the big satellite dish in the east. Please stop them!
lines.zh: 诺娃看见他们在东边的大卫星天线那儿。请你去阻止他们！

lines.en: Shh! Look at all our Hush Stones!
lines.zh: 嘘！看看我们这么多的静音石！

lines.en: We put them on the satellite dish. Soon the whole island will be quiet!
lines.zh: 我们把它们放在卫星天线上，很快整座岛都会安静下来！

lines.en: Your voice feels very small here...
lines.zh: 在这里，你的声音变得好小……

lines.en: Speak loudly to break the silence!
lines.zh: 大声说话，打破这片寂静！

lines.en: Give back the Subject Crystal!
lines.zh: 大声说：把学科水晶还回来！

lines.en: Crack! The Hush Stones are breaking!
lines.zh: 咔嚓！静音石裂开了！

lines.en: What?! Our stones! You will pay for this!
lines.zh: 什么？！我们的石头！你要付出代价！

lines.en: My turn! Maths, English, science... they're all boring!
lines.zh: 轮到我了！数学、英语、科学……全都无聊透了！

lines.en: Shh... The crystal is yours. Run, run!
lines.zh: 嘘……水晶还你们。快跑，快跑！

lines.en: Find the crystals, {name}. And keep talking!
lines.zh: 去把水晶找回来吧，{name}。一直说下去！

lines.en: The stars remember every word we say.
lines.zh: 星星记得我们说过的每一句话。

lines.en: Oh, a visitor. Hello! I'm Orion. I study old words.
lines.zh: 哦，有客人。你好！我叫欧瑞，我研究古老的词语。

lines.en: Look at the stars with me. Let me tell you an old story.
lines.zh: 和我一起看看星星吧，我给你讲一个古老的故事。

lines.en: Long, long ago, the Hush King wanted a world with no words.
lines.zh: 很久很久以前，寂静之王想要一个没有语言的世界。

lines.en: He took every word from every island. The world went silent.
lines.zh: 他从每座岛上拿走了所有的词语，整个世界都沉默了。

lines.en: Then Echodrake, the dragon of voices, began to sing.
lines.zh: 这时，声音之龙——回声龙开始歌唱。

lines.en: Its song woke up the words. People could talk and laugh again.
lines.zh: 它的歌声唤醒了词语，人们又能说话、又能欢笑了。

lines.en: The words were kept in thirteen crystals, one on each island.
lines.zh: 这些词语被收进了十三颗水晶，每座岛一颗。

lines.en: Team Hush is stealing the crystals. They want to wake the Hush King!
lines.zh: 嘘声团在偷水晶，他们想唤醒寂静之王！

lines.en: I think so.
It's interesting.
It's on Friday.
What do you think of history?
lines.zh: 你觉得历史课怎么样？

lines.en: Yes! History is full of stories. Take these for your journey.
lines.zh: 没错！历史里全是故事。这些拿着，路上用得到。

lines.en: Thank you, Orion!
lines.zh: 对欧瑞说：谢谢你，欧瑞！

lines.en: We will meet again. The stars will guide you.
lines.zh: 我们还会再见的。星星会为你指路。

lines.en: First maths, then English, then science, then music.
lines.zh: 先数学，再英语，然后科学，最后音乐。

lines.en: Maths is first.
Music is first.
Science is first.
Which subject is first?
lines.zh: 第一门是什么课？

lines.en: First history, then geography, then art, then Chinese.
lines.zh: 先历史，再地理，然后美术，最后语文。

lines.en: Art is last.
Chinese is last.
History is last.
Which subject is last?
lines.zh: 最后一门是什么课？

lines.en: Listen to the timetable. Step on the subjects in the right order.
lines.zh: 听课程表，按正确的顺序踩地上的学科开关。

lines.en: Welcome to the Timetable Hall!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到课程表挑战馆！

lines.en: Wrong order? Everything goes back to the start!
lines.zh: 顺序错了？一切从头再来！

lines.en: Doctor Octo is waiting for you!
lines.zh: 八爪博士在等你！

lines.en: Here is the next timetable. Listen carefully!
lines.zh: 下一张课程表来了，仔细听！

lines.en: Well done! The door is open!
lines.zh: 太棒了！门开了！

lines.en: Beep! Wrong order! Back to the start.
lines.zh: 哔——顺序错了！回到起点。

lines.en: My lab is a mess! I must fix my books first.
lines.zh: 我的实验室一团糟！我得先把书整理好。

lines.en: The timetable is done. Good job!
lines.zh: 课程表都完成了，干得好！

lines.en: But I can't sing. Can you?
lines.zh: 可是我不会唱歌。你会吗？

lines.en: I can juggle five balls!
I can juggle five balls! Look!
lines.zh: 我会同时抛五个球！看！

lines.en: Ahoy! My ferry goes back to Subject Island.
lines.zh: 啊嗬！我的渡轮开回学科岛。

lines.en: The sea is calm today. Hop on!
lines.zh: 今天海上风平浪静，上船吧！

lines.en: Can you swim? Swimming is fun in summer!
lines.zh: 你会游泳吗？夏天游泳可好玩了！

lines.en: I teach the swimming club.
lines.zh: 我是游泳社的教练。

lines.en: Yes, I can swim.
Hey! I saw your show. You and your friend can really sing!
lines.zh: 嘿！我看了你们的表演，你和你的朋友真能唱！

lines.en: I can't sing. But I can lift big rocks!
lines.zh: 我不会唱歌，可是我能举起大石头！

lines.en: Take this. Now your monsters can push rocks, too!
lines.zh: 这个送给你。你的怪兽也能推大石头了！

lines.en: On Dune Road, a big rock is in the way. Push it!
lines.zh: 沙丘道上有块大石头挡路，把它推开吧！

lines.en: You need six badges to use Clear Way 3.
lines.zh: 要有 6 枚徽章才能用「开路 3 级」。

lines.en: I can push big rocks!
Push the rock into a little hole. If it gets stuck, leave the road and come back!
lines.zh: 把石头推进小凹洞里。要是推错卡住了，离开这条路再回来，石头就会回到原位！

lines.en: Strong body, strong voice!
lines.zh: 身体棒，声音也要响亮！

lines.en: I can play chess, but I can't dance.
lines.zh: 我会下国际象棋，可是不会跳舞。

lines.en: Join our chess club!
Join our chess club! We play every Tuesday.
lines.zh: 加入我们的国际象棋社吧！我们每周二下棋。

lines.en: Ferry to Subject Island. Captain Gale is on the pier.
lines.zh: 开往学科岛的渡轮。盖尔船长在栈桥上。

lines.en: Welcome to Club Island! Join a club and have fun!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到社团岛！加入一个社团，玩得开心！

lines.en: A balloon for the Talent Show.
lines.zh: 才艺表演的气球。

lines.en: Colorful balloons! Everyone can fly a balloon here.
lines.zh: 五颜六色的气球！

lines.en: A big red balloon.
lines.zh: 一个大红气球。

lines.en: Balloons for the clubs.
lines.zh: 社团的气球。

lines.en: Balloons on the stage.
lines.zh: 舞台上的气球。

lines.en: The Open-Air Stage. "We can sing and dance!"
lines.zh: 露天舞台。“我们会唱歌跳舞！”

lines.en: Can you? No? Then let's battle!
lines.zh: 你能吗？不能？那就来对战吧！

lines.en: I can read the old words on these stones!
lines.zh: 我能读懂这些石头上的古老文字！

lines.en: The stones say: "Speak, and the world will hear you."
lines.zh: 石头上写着：“开口说话，世界就会听见你。”

lines.en: You can't read them, but you can battle!
lines.zh: 你不会读，可是你会对战！

lines.en: I can juggle, and my monsters can dance!
lines.zh: 我会抛球，我的怪兽会跳舞！

lines.en: I can't win, but I can juggle!
lines.zh: 我赢不了，可是我会抛球！

lines.en: Oh no, I dropped all my balls!
lines.zh: 哎呀，球全掉了！

lines.en: Can you dance? My fire monsters can!
lines.zh: 你会跳舞吗？我的火系怪兽会！

lines.en: The big rock is in the canyon. Can your monster push it?
lines.zh: 峡谷里有块大石头。你的怪兽推得动吗？

lines.en: You can battle very well!
lines.zh: 你对战真厉害！

lines.en: Boom, boom! I can play the drums!
lines.zh: 咚咚！我会打鼓！

lines.en: My brother can't play the drums. I can!
lines.zh: 我哥哥不会打鼓，我会！

lines.en: My drums are quiet now...
lines.zh: 我的鼓没声音了……

lines.en: Clock Island is just to the east.
lines.zh: 往东走就是作息岛了。

lines.en: La la la! I want to join the music club!
lines.zh: 啦啦啦！我想加入音乐社！

lines.en: Your voice is so clear!
lines.zh: 你的声音好清楚！

lines.en: A big rock is in the canyon. A strong monster can push it.
lines.zh: 峡谷里有块大石头，力气大的怪兽能推开它。

lines.en: A strong monster can push it.
If it gets stuck, go back to Club Island. The rock will go back, too.
lines.zh: 要是卡住了，就先回社团岛，石头也会回到原来的地方。

lines.en: Push it into the little hole on the wide spot!
lines.zh: 把它推到宽一点的地方那个小凹洞里！

lines.en: I can't swim, but I can walk on the sand all day!
lines.zh: 我不会游泳，可是我能在沙地上走一整天！

lines.en: I need some water...
lines.zh: 我要喝口水……

lines.en: There is an item on the little island in the oasis.
lines.zh: 绿洲中间的小岛上有个道具。

lines.en: Clock Island is just ahead!
lines.zh: 前面就是作息岛了！

lines.en: Danger! A big rock is in the canyon.
lines.zh: 注意！峡谷里有块大石头。

lines.en: Route 6: Dune Road. West: Club Island. East: Clock Island.
lines.zh: 6 号路：沙丘道。西：社团岛；东：作息岛。

lines.en: A broken old stone. It looks very old.
lines.zh: 一块断了的石头，看起来很古老。

lines.en: An old standing stone. "Can you hear me?"
lines.zh: 古老的石柱。上面刻着：“你听得见我吗？”

lines.en: An old stone with a picture of a guitar.
lines.zh: 刻着吉他的古老石头。

lines.en: An old stone: "We can sing together."
lines.zh: 古老的石头：“我们可以一起唱歌。”

lines.en: Only trainers with seven badges can go up.
lines.zh: 只有 7 枚徽章的训练师才能上山。

lines.en: Stop! Clock Mountain is a volcano. It is not safe.
lines.zh: 站住！钟山是座火山，很危险。

lines.en: I always get up at six and have a cup of tea.
lines.zh: 我总是六点起床，先喝一杯茶。

lines.en: I usually get up at seven.
What time do you usually get up?
lines.zh: 你通常几点起床？

lines.en: Clock Mountain is a volcano.
Clock Mountain smokes every day at noon.
lines.zh: 钟山每天中午都会冒烟。

lines.en: Inside, there is lava. Do not swim in it!
lines.zh: 山里面有岩浆，可千万别下去游泳！

lines.en: Clock Mountain. Seven badges only.
lines.zh: 钟山登山口。只有 7 枚徽章的训练师可以上山。

lines.en: Welcome to Clock Island! Be on time!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到作息岛！要守时哦！

lines.en: A street clock with a bird on top.
lines.zh: 顶上站着一只小鸟的街钟。

lines.en: A street clock with big numbers.
lines.zh: 数字很大的街钟。

lines.en: A street clock. "Time is money!"
lines.zh: 街钟。上面写着：“时间就是金钱！”

lines.en: A street clock. It stopped at three o'clock.
lines.zh: 街边的钟。它停在了三点。

lines.en: I get up at five every day to climb this mountain!
lines.zh: 我每天五点起床爬这座山！

lines.en: It's hot in here. Drink water every hour!
lines.zh: 这里很热，每个小时都要喝水！

lines.en: Time for a break...
lines.zh: 该休息一下了……

lines.en: I check the lava at nine o'clock every morning.
lines.zh: 我每天早上九点检查岩浆。

lines.en: My notes say: you win!
lines.zh: 我的笔记写着：你赢了！

lines.en: The volcano is getting hotter. Something is wrong at the top!
lines.zh: 火山越来越热了。山顶一定出事了！

lines.en: I go to bed at eight in the morning!
lines.zh: 我早上八点才睡觉！

lines.en: I work at night and sleep in the day. Good morning... or good night?
lines.zh: 我晚上工作白天睡觉。早上好……还是晚安？

lines.en: Zzz... I need to go to bed.
lines.zh: 呼……我得去睡觉了。

lines.en: Push the lower rock to the side first!
lines.zh: 先把下面那块推到旁边去！

lines.en: Push the rock to the side.
Two big rocks block a room in the west.
lines.zh: 西边有个小房间被两块大石头挡住了。

lines.en: I got up at four to see the sunrise from the top!
lines.zh: 我四点就起床，到山顶看日出！

lines.en: The sun is up, and I am down!
lines.zh: 太阳升起来了，我却输了！

lines.en: The view is great at six in the morning.
lines.zh: 早上六点，这里的风景最美。

lines.en: Go north, and you will see a candy beach.
lines.zh: 往北走，能看到糖果色的海滩。

lines.en: My monsters and I train every afternoon!
lines.zh: 我和我的怪兽每天下午都训练！

lines.en: Too hot! I need a rest.
lines.zh: 太热了！我要休息一下。

lines.en: I always get up early. The early bird catches the worm!
lines.zh: 我总是早起。早起的鸟儿有虫吃！

lines.en: I go to bed at nine every night.
lines.zh: 我每晚九点睡觉。

lines.en: Maybe I should sleep more...
lines.zh: 也许我该多睡一会儿……

lines.en: Clock Mountain Summit. Hot! Do not go near the lava.
lines.zh: 钟山山顶。很热！不要靠近岩浆。

lines.en: A strange machine. It is very hot. A timer says 8:50.
lines.zh: 一台奇怪的机器，非常烫。计时器上显示 8:50。

lines.en: I climb down the mountain at three every afternoon.
lines.zh: 我每天下午三点下山。

lines.en: It is time to go home.
lines.zh: 该回家了。

lines.en: Jump down the steps. It is faster!
lines.zh: 从台阶跳下去，更快！

lines.en: Don't stay up late!
lines.zh: 别熬夜哦！

lines.en: I get up at seven and go to bed at nine. Every day!
lines.zh: 我七点起床，九点睡觉，天天如此！

lines.en: It is my bedtime now...
lines.zh: 到我睡觉的时间了……

lines.en: I'm late for the party! It's already four o'clock!
lines.zh: 派对我要迟到了！已经四点了！

lines.en: Now I am really late!
lines.zh: 这下真的迟到了！

lines.en: The party is on Party Island, just to the north.
lines.zh: 派对就在北边的生日派对岛。

lines.en: I need to swim more!
lines.zh: 我得多游几圈！

lines.en: I swim at six every morning!
lines.zh: 我每天早上六点游泳！

lines.en: With Water Way, you can go to the little island.
lines.zh: 学会踏浪，就能去那个小沙洲。

lines.en: A birthday cake needs candles!
lines.zh: 生日蛋糕要插蜡烛！

lines.en: I bake cakes from six to eleven every morning!
lines.zh: 我每天早上六点到十一点烤蛋糕！

lines.en: My cake is burning!
lines.zh: 我的蛋糕烤焦了！

lines.en: I fish from morning to night!
lines.zh: 我从早到晚都在钓鱼！

lines.en: The best time to fish is five in the morning.
lines.zh: 钓鱼最好的时间是早上五点。

lines.en: The fish got away... and so did I.
lines.zh: 鱼跑了……我也输了。

lines.en: Party Island is just ahead! Don't be late!
lines.zh: 前面就是生日派对岛！别迟到！

lines.en: Route 7. North: Party Island.
lines.zh: 7 号路。往北是生日派对岛。

lines.en: Happy birthday... to everyone! Take a balloon!
lines.zh: 祝大家……生日快乐！拿个气球吧！

lines.en: How old are you? I'm thirty years old!
lines.zh: 你几岁了？我三十岁啦！

lines.en: Animal Island is far to the east.
lines.zh: 动物岛在东边很远的地方。

lines.en: Animal Island is to the east.
You need to surf across the sea.
lines.zh: 要踏浪才能过海。

lines.en: The harbor. East: Sea Route 8.
lines.zh: 港口。往东是 8 号水路。

lines.en: Welcome to Party Island! Every day is somebody's birthday!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到生日派对岛！每天都是某个人的生日！

lines.en: A big balloon. "Happy Birthday!"
lines.zh: 一个大气球，上面写着“生日快乐！”

lines.en: A giant gift box. What is inside?
lines.zh: 一个巨大的礼物盒。里面是什么呢？

lines.en: Balloons for the party!
lines.zh: 派对的气球！

lines.en: Dad's ship, the Sea Star.
lines.zh: 爸爸的船：海星号。

lines.en: Glub, glub...
lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜……

lines.en: My birthday is in July. I swim on my birthday!
lines.zh: 我的生日在七月，我过生日也游泳！

lines.en: When is your birthday?
lines.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？

lines.en: I got a new swimsuit for my birthday.
lines.zh: 我生日收到了一件新泳衣。

lines.en: It's my birthday today! Let's battle!
lines.zh: 今天是我的生日！来对战吧！

lines.en: What a birthday present!
lines.zh: 真是一份特别的生日礼物！

lines.en: Animal Island is just to the east!
lines.zh: 往东就是动物岛了！

lines.en: I am thirteen. How old are you?
lines.zh: 我十三岁了。你几岁了？

lines.en: You are strong for your age!
lines.zh: 你这个年纪就这么厉害！

lines.en: People say there is a garden under the sea.
lines.zh: 听说海底有一座花园。

lines.en: The water is very deep over there. Can you dive?
lines.zh: 那边的水很深。你会潜海吗？

lines.en: You swim like a fish!
lines.zh: 你游得像条鱼！

lines.en: I fish here every January. And every May, and every October!
lines.zh: 我每年一月都在这里钓鱼，五月、十月也来！

lines.en: My birthday is in October. I want a new rod!
lines.zh: 我的生日在十月，我想要一根新钓竿！

lines.en: That was a big fish!
lines.zh: 真是条大鱼！

lines.en: Sea Route 8. East: Animal Island.
lines.zh: 8 号水路。往东是动物岛。

lines.en: Bubbles, bubbles!
lines.zh: 咕嘟咕嘟！

lines.en: I dive here on my birthday every year. It is on June 1st!
lines.zh: 我每年生日都来这里潜海。我的生日是 6 月 1 日！

lines.en: The coral here is older than my grandpa!
lines.zh: 这里的珊瑚比我爷爷的年纪还大！

lines.en: I can play the piano.
I love the Talent Show! Can you play the piano?
lines.zh: 我最爱才艺表演了！你会弹钢琴吗？

lines.en: My sister can sing very well.
lines.zh: 我姐姐唱歌唱得很好。

lines.en: She can sing very well.
I can't dance now, but I could dance when I was young!
lines.zh: 我现在跳不动了，可是年轻的时候可会跳了！

lines.en: This is a great party! Would you like some cake?
lines.zh: 这个派对真棒！你要来块蛋糕吗？

lines.en: Yes, please.
My gift is a new ball. What is your gift?
lines.zh: 我的礼物是一个新球。你的礼物是什么？

lines.en: This gift is for you.
Let's sing "Happy Birthday" together!
lines.zh: 我们一起唱《生日快乐》吧！

lines.en: Do
Mi
Sol
Can you hear the drums? Boom, boom!
lines.zh: 你听见鼓声了吗？咚咚！

lines.en: Listen first, then step!
lines.zh: 先听，再踩！

lines.en: My drums lost the beat!
lines.zh: 我的鼓乱了节奏！

lines.en: A wrong note!
lines.zh: 弹错了一个音！

lines.en: Guitar, drum, piano... remember the order!
lines.zh: 吉他、鼓、钢琴……记住顺序！

lines.en: I can play the piano with ten fingers!
lines.zh: 我能用十根手指弹钢琴！

lines.en: Do, mi, sol! Can you sing like me?
lines.zh: 哆、咪、嗦！你能像我这样唱吗？

lines.en: Flo can sing, dance and play the drums!
lines.zh: 火烈鸟乐手又会唱、又会跳、还会打鼓！

lines.en: Your voice is louder than mine!
lines.zh: 你的声音比我还响亮！

lines.en: Half past six means six thirty.
lines.zh: half past six 就是六点半。

lines.en: I get up at five thirty every day!
lines.zh: 我每天五点半起床！

lines.en: I need more sleep...
lines.zh: 我需要多睡一会儿……

lines.en: A quarter past four is four fifteen.
lines.zh: a quarter past four 就是四点十五分。

lines.en: I go to bed at twelve. Too late, right?
lines.zh: 我十二点才睡觉。太晚了，对吧？

lines.en: Yawn... I should go to bed early.
lines.zh: 哈欠……我该早点睡。

lines.en: My birthday is on May 2nd. When is yours?
lines.zh: 我的生日是 5 月 2 日。你的呢？

lines.en: Oh! My cake fell down!
lines.zh: 哎呀！我的蛋糕掉了！

lines.en: I have thirteen balloons, one for every year!
lines.zh: 我有十三个气球，一岁一个！

lines.en: Pop! Pop! Pop!
lines.zh: 砰！砰！砰！

lines.en: Thirteen and thirty sound different. Listen for "-teen"!
lines.zh: thirteen 和 thirty 听起来不一样，注意听 “-teen”！

lines.en: Hi! I'm Lily from the music club.
lines.zh: 嗨！我是音乐社的莉莉。

lines.en: We sing and play the guitar every Friday.
lines.zh: 我们每周五唱歌、弹吉他。

lines.en: Can you sing?
Great! Here is a music club sticker.
lines.zh: 太好了！这是音乐社的贴纸。

lines.en: See you at the show! We can sing together!
lines.zh: 表演时见！我们可以一起唱！

lines.en: Hello! I'm Rosa. I'm in the dance club.
lines.zh: 你好！我是罗莎，我在舞蹈社。

lines.en: My monster can dance, too. Look! One, two, three!
lines.zh: 我的怪兽也会跳舞。看！一、二、三！

lines.en: Can your monster dance?
Wow! Take a dance club sticker.
lines.zh: 哇！拿一张舞蹈社的贴纸吧。

lines.en: Yes, it can.
Let's dance at the show!
lines.zh: 表演的时候一起跳舞吧！

lines.en: Hi! I'm Ken. I can draw animals and flowers.
lines.zh: 嗨！我是肯。我会画动物和花。

lines.en: We have fun in the art club.
lines.zh: 我们在美术社玩得很开心。

lines.en: Do you want to join the art club?
I'm Tom.
It's an art club.
Sure! I love drawing.
Welcome! Here is an art club sticker.
lines.zh: 欢迎！这是美术社的贴纸。

lines.en: I will draw a picture of your show!
lines.zh: 我要把你的表演画下来！

lines.en: Hello! Welcome to Club Island!
lines.zh: 你好！欢迎来到社团岛！

lines.en: I'm Bobo, the host of the Talent Show.
lines.zh: 我是波波，才艺表演的主持人。

lines.en: Tonight, everyone can show what they can do!
lines.zh: 今晚，大家都可以秀一秀自己的本领！

lines.en: I can sing.
I'm fine, thanks.
It's a club.
What can you do?
lines.zh: 波波问你会做什么。选一个回答，再大声说出来。

lines.en: You can sing? Wonderful!
lines.zh: 你会唱歌？太棒了！

lines.en: Hmm? You can say: "I can sing."
lines.zh: 嗯？你可以说：“I can sing.”（我会唱歌。）

lines.en: To be in the show, you need three club stickers.
lines.zh: 想参加表演，要先集齐三个社团的贴纸。

lines.en: Visit the music club, the dance club and the art club.
lines.zh: 去找音乐社、舞蹈社和美术社的人。

lines.en: Then come to the big tent. See you there!
lines.zh: 然后到大帐篷来找我。一会儿见！

lines.en: You have three club stickers! Go to the big tent.
lines.zh: 三个社团贴纸都集齐了！去中间的大帐篷参加才艺表演吧。

lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome to the Talent Show!
lines.zh: 女士们、先生们！欢迎来到才艺表演！

lines.en: Our next singer is... {name}!
lines.zh: 下一位歌手是……{name}！

lines.en: {name}! You are in the show, too? Let's sing together!
lines.zh: {name}！你也来表演？我们一起唱吧！

lines.en: Can you sing, {name}?
lines.zh: {rival} 问你会不会唱歌。

lines.en: No, I don't.
Yes, I can!
Me too! We can be a great team!
lines.zh: 我也会！我们会是很棒的组合！

lines.en: Ha ha, just say "Yes, I can!"
lines.zh: 哈哈，就说 “Yes, I can!” 嘛！

lines.en: Music, please!
lines.zh: 音乐，起！
