lines.en: BANG! The music stopped. Someone broke the speakers!
lines.zh: 砰！音乐停了，有人把音响弄坏了！

lines.en: Shh! No more noise on this island!
lines.zh: 嘘！这座岛上不许再吵了！

lines.en: And the Club Crystal is ours now! Hee hee!
lines.zh: 社团水晶现在归我们了！嘻嘻！

lines.en: Hey! Give it back! I will stop her. {name}, you stop him!
lines.zh: 喂！还回来！我去拦住她。{name}，你对付他！

lines.en: Singing is too loud! Shh!
lines.zh: 唱歌太吵了！嘘！

lines.en: The grunts dropped the Club Crystal and ran away!
lines.zh: 团员们丢下社团水晶逃跑了！

lines.en: Oh no... The speakers are still broken. No music, no show...
lines.zh: 哎呀……音响还是坏的。没有音乐，表演开不成了……

lines.en: Wait! We don't need speakers. We can sing without music!
lines.zh: 等等！我们不需要音响，我们可以清唱！

lines.en: Sing with me, {name}! Say every word loud and clear!
lines.zh: 跟我一起唱，{name}！每个词都要唱得响亮清楚！

lines.en: I can sing, you can dance!
lines.zh: 唱第一句：我会唱歌，你会跳舞！

lines.en: We can play the drums! Boom, boom, boom!
lines.zh: 我们会打鼓！咚、咚、咚！

lines.en: Come on, everyone! Join the club!
lines.zh: 唱第二句：大家快来，加入社团吧！

lines.en: Everyone is clapping and singing along!
lines.zh: 全场都在鼓掌，大家一起跟着唱！

lines.en: What a show! You and {rival} are the stars tonight!
lines.zh: 多精彩的表演！你和 {rival} 是今晚的明星！

lines.en: That was fun! I will go to Clock Island next. See you, {name}!
lines.zh: 真好玩！我接下来要去作息岛。回头见，{name}！

lines.en: Oh, the strongman on the beach wants to meet you. He saw your show!
lines.zh: 对了，沙滩边的大力士想见你，他看了你们的表演！

lines.en: Can you say it with me? "We can sing and dance together!"
lines.zh: 跟我说一遍：“We can sing and dance together!”

lines.en: What a great show! Come back any time!
lines.zh: 多棒的表演！欢迎随时再来！

lines.en: Get three club stickers, and you can be in the show!
lines.zh: 集齐三个社团贴纸，就能参加表演！

lines.en: Music, dance and art. Good luck!
lines.zh: 音乐社、舞蹈社、美术社。加油！

lines.en: A big speaker. It is ready for the show.
lines.zh: 一个大音响，为表演准备好了。

lines.en: The speaker is broken. Nothing comes out.
lines.zh: 音响坏了，一点声音都没有。

lines.en: The speaker is playing happy music.
lines.zh: 音响在放欢快的音乐。

lines.en: Drum, piano!
Guitar, drum, piano!
Do, mi, sol, do!
Here comes the next song!
lines.zh: 下一首歌来了！这一首更长。

lines.en: Welcome to the Music Hall! Listen to the speaker, then step on the notes in order.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到音乐挑战馆！仔细听广播，再按顺序踩地上的格子。踩错了就回到起点。

lines.en: Bravo! All the gates are open. Go and meet Flo!
lines.zh: 太棒了！所有的门都开了，去挑战火烈鸟乐手吧！

lines.en: Perfect! The gate is open.
lines.zh: 完美！门打开了。

lines.en: A golden music note statue.
lines.zh: 一座金色的音符雕像。

lines.en: The song is over. The gate is open.
lines.zh: 这一首已经唱完了，门开着。

lines.en: The Club Crystal is gone! No music, no fun. I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 社团水晶不见了！没有音乐，一点都不好玩，我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: I get up at five o'clock every day.
lines.zh: 面包师

lines.en: Good morning! Or is it good evening? My bread is late!
lines.zh: 早上好！还是晚上好？我的面包都做晚了！

lines.en: I make bread for the whole town before six!
lines.zh: 六点以前我要为全镇做好面包！

lines.en: Zzz... Is it night? Is it morning? I don't know!
lines.zh: 呼……现在是晚上？还是早上？我也不知道！

lines.en: I usually get up at half past six.
lines.zh: 学生

lines.en: Hi! School starts at eight. But what time is it now?
lines.zh: 嗨！学校八点上课。可现在几点了？

lines.en: Then I have breakfast and go to school.
lines.zh: 然后我吃早饭、去上学。

lines.en: It's time for dinner... or breakfast? I'm so confused!
lines.zh: 现在该吃晚饭……还是早饭？我都糊涂了！

lines.en: I always get up at seven o'clock.
lines.zh: 镇长

lines.en: I am the mayor. I am never late!
lines.zh: 我是镇长，我从不迟到！

lines.en: Then I open the town hall at eight.
lines.zh: 然后八点打开镇政府的大门。

lines.en: Our clock tower stopped! Please go to the tower!
lines.zh: 我们的钟楼停了！请快去钟楼看看！

lines.en: Hi, {name}! It's Mom. How are you?
lines.zh: 喂，{name}！我是妈妈。你还好吗？

lines.en: Are you sleeping well on your trip?
lines.zh: 出门在外，睡得好吗？

lines.en: At half past nine.
By bus.
What time do you go to bed?
lines.zh: 妈妈问你几点睡觉。选一个回答，再大声说出来。

lines.en: Good! Early to bed, early to rise!
lines.zh: 很好！早睡早起身体好！

lines.en: Hmm? Tell me a time, like "At half past nine."
lines.zh: 嗯？要说一个时间，比如 “At half past nine.”（九点半。）

lines.en: Don't forget to eat breakfast every day. Love you!
lines.zh: 别忘了每天吃早饭哦。妈妈爱你！

lines.en: Wait... Listen. The big clock in the square is not ticking!
lines.zh: 等等……你听，广场上的大钟不走了！

lines.en: Oh, a trainer! Help! Our clock tower stopped!
lines.zh: 啊，是训练师！救命！我们的钟楼停了！

lines.en: Nobody knows the time. The baker is sleeping at noon!
lines.zh: 谁都不知道现在几点。面包师大中午的还在睡觉！

lines.en: And the students are eating dinner at breakfast time!
lines.zh: 学生们在早饭时间吃晚饭！

lines.en: I saw Team Hush go into the clock tower. Please help us!
lines.zh: 我看见嘘声团进了钟楼。请你帮帮我们！

lines.en: Nobody gets up, nobody talks. Perfect!
lines.zh: 谁都不起床，谁都不说话。完美！

lines.en: Shh! I stopped the clock. No time, no bells, no noise!
lines.zh: 嘘！钟是我弄停的。没有时间，没有钟声，也就没有吵闹！

lines.en: Shh... fine! But I mixed up the bells. Nobody knows the right time now!
lines.zh: 嘘……算你赢！不过钟声已经被我弄乱了，现在谁都不知道正确的时间！

lines.en: Thank you, young trainer! I am Tock, the clock keeper.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，小训练师！我叫托克，是钟楼的管理员。

lines.en: Every morning, the tower rings a bell to wake people up.
lines.zh: 每天早上，钟楼都会敲钟叫大家起床。

lines.en: The baker, the students and the mayor all get up at different times.
lines.zh: 面包师、学生和镇长起床的时间都不一样。

lines.en: But that grunt mixed up my bells, and I forgot the times!
lines.zh: 可是那个团员把钟声弄乱了，我连时间都忘了！

lines.en: Please ask them: "What time do you get up?"
lines.zh: 请你去问问他们：“What time do you get up?”（你几点起床？）

lines.en: Remember their answers. Then come back and set the big clock.
lines.zh: 记住他们的回答，再回来把大钟拨好。

lines.en: Thank you for fixing the clock!
lines.zh: 谢谢你修好了钟楼！

lines.en: What time do you get up?
You asked everyone! Go back to the clock tower and set the big clock.
lines.zh: 三个人都问过了！回钟楼把大钟拨好吧。

lines.en: You are back! Now, let's set the bells.
lines.zh: 你回来了！我们来调钟声吧。

lines.en: Hmm, that's not right. Go and ask again!
Tick, tock! The clock tower is working again!
lines.zh: 滴答滴答！钟楼又走起来了！

lines.en: Ding, dong! Ding, dong! It's seven o'clock!
lines.zh: 叮咚！叮咚！七点了！

lines.en: Listen! People are getting up. The town is waking up!
lines.zh: 听！大家都起床了，小镇醒过来了！

lines.en: Look! Something is shining in the gears... It is the Clock Crystal!
lines.zh: 看！齿轮里有东西在发光……是时钟水晶！

lines.en: Thank you so much! Oh, and a boy with green hair was looking for you.
lines.zh: 太感谢你了！对了，有个绿头发的男孩在找你。

lines.en: He is at the foot of Clock Mountain.
lines.zh: 他就在钟山脚下。

lines.en: Remember: early to bed, early to rise!
lines.zh: 记住：早睡早起！

lines.en: The clock is right on time. Tick, tock!
lines.zh: 钟走得准准的。滴答，滴答！

lines.en: Please ask the baker, the student and the mayor: "What time do you get up?"
lines.zh: 请你去问面包师、学生和镇长：“What time do you get up?”

lines.en: Then come back and set the big clock.
lines.zh: 然后回来把大钟拨好。

lines.en: The big clock has stopped.
lines.zh: 大钟停住了，一动也不动。

lines.en: The big clock is ticking. It is on time!
lines.zh: 大钟滴答滴答地走着，时间正好！

lines.en: Big gears. Click, clack!
lines.zh: 好大的齿轮。咔嗒，咔嗒！

lines.en: I train every day now. I get up at six!
lines.zh: 我现在每天都训练，六点就起床！

lines.en: One day, I will climb Clock Mountain, too!
lines.zh: 总有一天，我也要爬上钟山！

lines.en: {name}! It's me, Kai! Remember?
lines.zh: {name}！是我，小凯！还记得我吗？

lines.en: I get up at six every day and train with my monsters.
lines.zh: 我每天六点起床，和怪兽们一起训练。

lines.en: I want to climb Clock Mountain, too. But I need seven badges...
lines.zh: 我也想爬钟山，可是要 7 枚徽章……

lines.en: Can we have a battle? I want to see how strong I am now!
lines.zh: 小凯想和你比一场。你怎么回答？

lines.en: It's seven o'clock.
No, I can't swim.
Sure! Let's battle!
Ha ha, what? OK, maybe next time!
lines.zh: 哈哈，你说什么呀？好吧，下次再比！

lines.en: I won? I really won!
lines.zh: 我赢了？我真的赢了！

lines.en: Wow... You are still so strong!
lines.zh: 哇……你还是这么厉害！

lines.en: I will keep training. One day, I will be as strong as you!
lines.zh: 我会继续训练。总有一天，我会和你一样强！

lines.en: {name}! Wait!
lines.zh: {name}！等一下！

lines.en: It's me, Orion. I study old words and old legends.
lines.zh: 是我，欧瑞。我研究古老的词语和传说。

lines.en: Look over there. That is Rumble, a Team Hush admin!
lines.zh: 你看那边，那是嘘声团的干部——闷雷！

lines.en: Ha ha! The heat of Clock Mountain is perfect!
lines.zh: 哈哈！钟山的热量正合适！

lines.en: My Silence Machine starts at nine o'clock. Then every island will be quiet!
lines.zh: 我的静音机九点整启动，到时候每座岛都会安静下来！

lines.en: Look at my watch. It's eight fifty now!
lines.zh: （听欧瑞说现在几点）

lines.en: It's eight fifteen.
It's eight fifty.
What time is it now?
lines.zh: 现在几点？选出来，再说一遍。

lines.en: No, it's eight fifty! We have only ten minutes!
lines.zh: 不对，是八点五十！只剩十分钟了！

lines.en: We have ten minutes. Tell him to stop!
lines.zh: 只剩十分钟了。快叫他停下！

lines.en: Stop, Rumble! Turn off the machine!
lines.zh: 对闷雷大喊：住手，闷雷！把机器关掉！

lines.en: But this is not over. See you on Party Island!
lines.zh: 不过这事没完。生日派对岛见！

lines.en: Grr... My machine! Fine, I'm going!
lines.zh: 可恶……我的机器！好吧，我走！

lines.en: The mountain is shaking...
lines.zh: 山在摇晃……

lines.en: The machine made the volcano angry. Look at the crater!
lines.zh: 那台机器惹火山生气了。快看火山口！

lines.en: It's Drumlion! It dances to the drums at every festival.
lines.zh: 是醒狮！每个节日它都跟着鼓声跳舞。

lines.en: The noisy machine woke it up from its nap.
lines.zh: 吵闹的机器把它从午睡里吵醒了。

lines.en: It wants to see your power. Talk to it when you are ready.
lines.zh: 它想看看你的力量。准备好了，就去和它说话。

lines.en: I must go now. The story of Echodrake is not over... See you again!
lines.zh: 我得走了。回声龙的故事还没有结束……后会有期！

lines.en: It's three o'clock.
It's half past six.
It's a quarter past four.
Cock-a-doodle-doo! Listen to the time!
lines.zh: 喔喔喔！听好时间！

lines.en: Oh no! Wrong time! The gates turned back.
lines.zh: 哎呀，时间拨错了！门全都转回了原位，回到起点重新来。

lines.en: Ding, dong! All the gates are open! Go and meet Rex!
lines.zh: 叮咚！所有的门都打开了！去挑战闹钟公鸡吧！

lines.en: Tick, tock! The gates are turning...
lines.zh: 滴答滴答！机关门转动了……去找下一座钟。

lines.en: A big golden clock. Tick, tock!
lines.zh: 一座金色的大钟。滴答，滴答！

lines.en: The clock is ticking happily.
lines.zh: 钟在开心地走着。门都开着。

lines.en: You already set this clock.
lines.zh: 这座钟已经拨好了。去找下一座钟！

lines.en: This clock is not ticking yet.
lines.zh: 这座钟还没有动起来。先去拨前面那座钟。

lines.en: Cock-a-doodle... Nobody knows the time! I can't battle now!
lines.zh: 喔喔……谁都不知道现在几点！我现在没法对战！

lines.en: My birthday is on October 1st.
lines.zh: 罗丝奶奶

lines.en: I am eighty years old this year!
lines.zh: 我今年八十岁啦！

lines.en: Oh, hello, dear! Are you going to the party?
lines.zh: 哎呀，你好呀，孩子！你也去参加派对吗？

lines.en: My birthday is on May 2nd.
lines.zh: 艾米

lines.en: Hi! I made a card for the party!
lines.zh: 嗨！我给派对做了一张贺卡！

lines.en: I want a new bike for my birthday!
lines.zh: 我生日想要一辆新自行车！

lines.en: It's on June 12th. I make my own cake!
lines.zh: 蛋糕师

lines.en: I made a big cake for the party. It has thirteen candles!
lines.zh: 我为派对做了个大蛋糕，插了十三根蜡烛！

lines.en: Would you like some cake later?
lines.zh: 等会儿要来块蛋糕吗？

lines.en: {name}! You came to Party Island!
lines.zh: {name}！你来生日派对岛啦！

lines.en: Guess what? Today is my birthday! I'm thirteen today!
lines.zh: 你猜怎么着？今天是我的生日！我今天十三岁了！

lines.en: Happy birthday!
Me too!
Today is my birthday!
lines.zh: {rival} 今天过生日，你该说什么？

lines.en: Thank you!
lines.zh: 谢谢你！

lines.en: Ha ha! You can say "Happy birthday!"
lines.zh: 哈哈！你可以说 “Happy birthday!”（生日快乐！）

lines.en: We are having a party at the Cake House. Can you help me?
lines.zh: 我们在蛋糕房子开派对。你能帮我个忙吗？

lines.en: I want to make a birthday calendar for my friends.
lines.zh: 我想给朋友们做一本生日日历。

lines.en: Ask Granny Rose, Amy and the cake baker: "When is your birthday?"
lines.zh: 去问罗丝奶奶、艾米和蛋糕师：“When is your birthday?”（你的生日是什么时候？）

lines.en: Then come to the party!
lines.zh: 问完就来参加派对吧！

lines.en: No, no! Ask me again and listen carefully.
lines.zh: 不对不对！再问我一次，仔细听。

lines.en: Yes! That's my birthday!
lines.zh: 对！那就是我的生日！

lines.en: The birthday calendar is ready! Go to the Cake House.
lines.zh: 生日日历做好了！去蛋糕房子参加派对吧。

lines.en: {name}! Welcome to my party!
lines.zh: {name}！欢迎来参加我的派对！

lines.en: Thank you for the birthday calendar. It looks great!
lines.zh: 谢谢你的生日日历，真漂亮！

lines.en: Now, let's light the candles on the cake!
lines.zh: 现在，我们来点蛋糕上的蜡烛吧！

lines.en: CRASH! Someone ran into the party!
lines.zh: 哐当！有人冲进了派对！

lines.en: Ha! I told you. See you on Party Island!
lines.zh: 哈！我说过的——生日派对岛见！

lines.en: The Party Crystal is inside that cake. Give it to me!
lines.zh: 派对水晶就藏在那个蛋糕里。交出来！

lines.en: No way! This is my birthday cake!
lines.zh: 想都别想！这是我的生日蛋糕！

lines.en: Go away, Rumble! This is our party!
lines.zh: 对闷雷说：走开，闷雷！这是我们的派对！

lines.en: Birthdays are too noisy! No more songs!
lines.zh: 过生日太吵了！不许再唱歌！

lines.en: Mr. Mute... I am sorry...
lines.zh: 默先生……对不起……

lines.en: Not again! The boss will be so angry...
lines.zh: 又输了！老大会气坏的……

lines.en: Thank you, {name}! Now it's a real party!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}！现在才是真正的派对！

lines.en: Everyone sings "Happy Birthday". Now it is your turn!
lines.zh: 大家一起唱《生日快乐》。轮到你祝福了！

lines.en: Happy birthday, {rival}!
lines.zh: 祝 {rival} 生日快乐！

lines.en: Thank you! Now I'll make a wish...
lines.zh: 谢谢！现在我要许个愿……

lines.en: I wish... to have a battle with you! Right now!
lines.zh: 我的愿望是……和你对战一场！就现在！

lines.en: Yay! A birthday win!
lines.zh: 耶！生日这天赢了！

lines.en: You are so strong! Best birthday ever!
lines.zh: 你太强了！这是我过得最棒的生日！

lines.en: Toot, toot! A big ship is coming into the harbor!
lines.zh: 呜——呜——！一艘大船开进了港口！

lines.en: Look at the captain... {name}, isn't that your dad?!
lines.zh: 你看那个船长……{name}，那不是你爸爸吗？！

lines.en: Go and see him! I'll save some cake for you.
lines.zh: 快去见他吧！我给你留一块蛋糕。

lines.en: Let's surf!
lines.zh: 我们去踏浪吧！

lines.en: The sea is big, {name}. Be brave and have fun!
lines.zh: 大海很大，{name}。勇敢一点，玩得开心！

lines.en: With eight badges, you can surf east to Animal Island.
lines.zh: 有了 8 枚徽章，就能往东踏浪去动物岛。

lines.en: {name}? Is that you? Wow, you are so tall now!
lines.zh: {name}？是你吗？哇，你长这么高了！

lines.en: I was at sea for a long, long time. I missed you so much!
lines.zh: 我在海上跑了好久好久的船，好想你！

lines.en: How old are you now?
lines.zh: 爸爸问你现在几岁了。

lines.en: I'm fine.
I'm thirteen.
In May.
Thirteen! Time flies!
lines.zh: 十三岁了！时间过得真快！

lines.en: Ha ha! You can say "I'm thirteen."
lines.zh: 哈哈！你可以说 “I'm thirteen.”（我十三岁。）

lines.en: And you have so many badges. I am proud of you!
lines.zh: 你还拿了这么多徽章。爸爸真为你骄傲！

lines.en: I have a present for you. It's from the sea.
lines.zh: 我给你带了一份礼物，是从海上带回来的。

lines.en: You got the Echo Shell for Water Way from Dad!
lines.zh: 你从爸爸那里得到了「水路」回声贝！

lines.en: With eight badges, your water monster can carry you on the sea.
lines.zh: 有了 8 枚徽章，你的水系怪兽就能载着你在海上走。

lines.en: Say it with me: "Let's surf!"
lines.zh: 跟我一起说：“Let's surf!”

lines.en: Animal Island is to the east. I will stay here at the harbor for a while. Good luck!
lines.zh: 动物岛在东边。我会在港口待一阵子。加油！

lines.en: My birthday is January 21st.
My birthday is May 5th.
My birthday is October 13th.
Welcome to my Birthday Hall! It's party time!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的生日挑战馆！派对时间到！

lines.en: Listen to my friends. Step on the gift box with their birthday on it!
lines.zh: 听我的朋友说自己的生日，踩上写着那天的礼物盒。开错了会跳出训练师哦！

lines.en: Surprise! This is the right box!
lines.zh: 惊喜！就是这个盒子！

lines.en: Three right boxes! The gate is open. Go and meet Puffy!
lines.zh: 三个盒子都找对了！门打开了，去挑战河豚派对王吧！

lines.en: Surprise! It's the right box! There is a party hat inside.
lines.zh: 惊喜！就是这个盒子！里面有一顶派对帽。

lines.en: POP! It's the wrong box! A trainer jumps out!
lines.zh: 砰！盒子开错了！里面跳出一个训练师！

lines.en: You win! Listen carefully and find the right box!
lines.zh: 你赢了！仔细听，找对的盒子！

lines.en: A big golden gift box statue.
lines.zh: 一座金色的礼物盒雕像。

lines.en: The party can't start without the Party Crystal!
lines.zh: 没有派对水晶，派对开不起来！

lines.en: Pandas eat bamboo every day.
lines.zh: 熊猫每天都吃竹子。

lines.en: Pandas eat bamboo.
lines.zh: （仔细听！她说的口令是什么？）

lines.en: They eat for twelve hours a day!
lines.zh: 它们一天要吃十二个小时！

lines.en: Dolphins can swim very fast.
lines.zh: 海豚能游得非常快。

lines.en: Look at the sea! Sometimes I see dolphins.
lines.zh: 看那片海！有时候能看到海豚。

lines.en: Because they're very cute!
lines.zh: 因为它们非常可爱！

lines.en: Because they're very cute.
I love koalas! Why do I like them?
lines.zh: 我最喜欢考拉！为什么呢？

lines.en: Route 9 is east of here. It is on the sea.
lines.zh: 9 号水路在东边，是一条海路。

lines.en: Route 9 is on the sea.
The Sea Patrol only lets strong trainers pass. You need nine badges.
lines.zh: 海上巡逻员只让厉害的训练师过去，要有 9 枚徽章。

lines.en: They're from Africa.
They're from Africa. Lions are strong, but they are also in danger.
lines.zh: 它们来自非洲。狮子很强壮，可它们也有危险。

lines.en: Where are lions from?
lines.zh: 狮子来自哪里？

lines.en: Ranger Station. We help wild animals.
lines.zh: 巡林站：我们帮助野生动物。

lines.en: Welcome to Animal Island! We must save the animals.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到动物岛！我们必须保护动物。

lines.en: Animal Park. Please be kind to the animals.
lines.zh: 动物公园：请善待动物。

lines.en: East: Route 9 (sea road). North: Jungle Path.
lines.zh: 往东：9 号水路（海路）。往北：丛林小径。

lines.en: A tall totem. There is an elephant, a monkey and a tiger on it.
lines.zh: 一根高高的图腾柱，上面刻着大象、猴子和老虎。

lines.en: A totem with a big giraffe on the top.
lines.zh: 顶上刻着一只大长颈鹿的图腾柱。

lines.en: "Animals are our friends." — Animal Park
lines.zh: “动物是我们的朋友。”——动物公园

lines.en: Elephants are smart animals.
lines.zh: 大象是聪明的动物。

lines.en: I protect the jungle. Show me your monsters!
lines.zh: 我保护这片丛林。让我看看你的怪兽！

lines.en: You're strong! Please be kind to the animals.
lines.zh: 你真厉害！请善待动物。

lines.en: I catch bugs in the jungle every day!
lines.zh: 我每天都在丛林里抓虫子！

lines.en: Monkeys like bananas. Bugs like leaves!
lines.zh: 猴子喜欢香蕉，虫子喜欢树叶！

lines.en: My bugs lost...
lines.zh: 我的虫子输了……

lines.en: Let's see the pandas first... Oh, a battle!
lines.zh: 我们先去看熊猫吧……哦，要对战了！

lines.en: Pandas are black and white.
lines.zh: 熊猫是黑白相间的。

lines.en: You are a good explorer!
lines.zh: 你是个好探险家！

lines.en: Tigers are from Asia.
lines.zh: 老虎来自亚洲。

lines.en: Why do you like tigers? Because they are strong. Like me!
lines.zh: 你为什么喜欢老虎？因为它们很强壮。就像我！

lines.en: Wow, your monsters are strong too!
lines.zh: 哇，你的怪兽也很强壮！

lines.en: Koalas sleep in trees.
lines.zh: 考拉睡在树上。

lines.en: They're from Australia! I know now.
lines.zh: 它们来自澳大利亚！我知道了。

lines.en: Where are koalas from? Answer with a battle!
lines.zh: 考拉来自哪里？用对战回答我！

lines.en: I help sick animals. My monsters help me!
lines.zh: 我给生病的动物看病，我的怪兽是我的帮手！

lines.en: We must save the animals.
lines.zh: 我们必须保护动物。

lines.en: Your monsters look very healthy.
lines.zh: 你的怪兽看起来非常健康。

lines.en: Shh! Animals are noisy. We put them in cages!
lines.zh: 嘘！动物太吵了，我们把它们关进笼子！

lines.en: Shh... You win.
lines.zh: 嘘……你赢了。

lines.en: The boss is upstairs. Shh!
lines.zh: 老大在楼上。嘘！

lines.en: How did you find our base?
lines.zh: 你是怎么找到我们基地的？

lines.en: Only we know the password. Shh!
lines.zh: 只有我们知道口令。嘘！

lines.en: Shh... Nobody can pass the locked door anyway!
lines.zh: 嘘……反正没人能通过那扇锁着的门！

lines.en: I forgot the password again...
lines.zh: 我又把口令忘了……

lines.en: Quiet, kid! Monsters in cages are quiet monsters.
lines.zh: 安静，小孩！关在笼子里的怪兽才安静。

lines.en: Shh... not so loud!
lines.zh: 嘘……别那么大声！

lines.en: Don't push the red button!
lines.zh: 别按那个红色按钮！

lines.en: Shh... there is a red button somewhere...
lines.zh: 嘘……某个地方有个红色按钮……

lines.en: The storage room is ours! Go away!
lines.zh: 仓库是我们的！走开！

lines.en: A machine with a big red button.
lines.zh: 一台机器，上面有个大大的红色按钮。

lines.en: Admin Whisper is in the cage room.
lines.zh: 低语大人在关笼子的房间里。

lines.en: Shh... Admin Whisper will stop you.
lines.zh: 嘘……低语大人会阻止你的。

lines.en: You got past the password? Impossible!
lines.zh: 你居然过了口令门？不可能！

lines.en: It has a long nose and big ears.
lines.zh: 它有长长的鼻子和大大的耳朵。

lines.en: It has a long tail. It likes bananas and climbing trees.
lines.zh: 它有长尾巴，喜欢香蕉和爬树。

lines.en: It has a very long neck. It is very tall.
lines.zh: 它的脖子很长很长，个子非常高。

lines.en: It's from Australia. It sleeps in trees all day.
lines.zh: 它来自澳大利亚，整天在树上睡觉。

lines.en: It's orange with black stripes. It's very strong.
lines.zh: 它是橙色的，有黑色条纹，非常强壮。

lines.en: It's black and white. It eats bamboo.
lines.zh: 它是黑白相间的，吃竹子。

lines.en: It looks like a horse. It's black and white.
lines.zh: 它长得像马，身上黑白相间。

lines.en: It can't fly, but it can swim. It lives in a cold place.
lines.zh: 它不会飞，但是会游泳，住在寒冷的地方。

lines.en: penguin
It's from Africa. It's the king of animals.
lines.zh: 它来自非洲，是百兽之王。

lines.en: Listen to the speaker. Then follow the paw prints.
lines.zh: 听广播，再跟着脚印走。

lines.en: Snap snap! Croc taught me everything.
lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓！鳄鱼巡查员教会了我一切。

lines.en: Your ears are good!
lines.zh: 你的耳朵真灵！

lines.en: Pandas eat bamboo. Koalas eat leaves.
lines.zh: 熊猫吃竹子，考拉吃树叶。

lines.en: What do pandas eat? They eat bamboo!
lines.zh: 熊猫吃什么？它们吃竹子！

lines.en: You know animals well!
lines.zh: 你很了解动物！

lines.en: Are giraffes tall? Yes, they are!
lines.zh: 长颈鹿高吗？是的，很高！

lines.en: The first path is easy. The last one is hard!
lines.zh: 第一段路很简单，最后一段很难！

lines.en: You win! You can go on.
lines.zh: 你赢了！可以往前走了。

lines.en: A crocodile statue. "Snap snap!"
lines.zh: 一座鳄鱼雕像：“咔嚓咔嚓！”

lines.en: A speaker.
lines.zh: 一个广播喇叭。

lines.en: A speaker. Press A to hear it again.
lines.zh: 一个广播喇叭。

lines.en: Dolphins can swim very fast. So can I!
lines.zh: 海豚游得很快，我也是！

lines.en: I want to swim with dolphins one day.
lines.zh: 有一天我想和海豚一起游泳。

lines.en: Brr... I lost!
lines.zh: 呜……我输了！

lines.en: Penguins can swim, too. Did you know?
lines.zh: 企鹅也会游泳，你知道吗？

lines.en: Penguins can't fly, but they can swim.
lines.zh: 企鹅不会飞，但是会游泳。

lines.en: Fish live in the sea. Monkeys live in trees.
lines.zh: 鱼住在海里，猴子住在树上。

lines.en: I caught a big fish today! Want to battle?
lines.zh: 我今天钓到一条大鱼！要对战吗？

lines.en: The big one got away...
lines.zh: 大家伙跑掉了……

lines.en: Stop! This is the Sea Patrol.
lines.zh: 停一下！这里是海上巡逻队。

lines.en: The sea to Rule City is dangerous. Only trainers with nine badges can go.
lines.zh: 去规则城的海路很危险，只有 9 枚徽章的训练师才能过去。

lines.en: Win the badge on Animal Island first!
lines.zh: 先去赢下动物岛的徽章吧！

lines.en: Do you like dolphins? I love them!
lines.zh: 你喜欢海豚吗？我超爱它们！

lines.en: Dolphins are smart and cute.
lines.zh: 海豚又聪明又可爱。

lines.en: You're a strong swimmer!
lines.zh: 你游泳真厉害！

lines.en: Don't swim too far from the island.
lines.zh: 别游得离岛太远。

lines.en: OK, OK, you can go!
lines.zh: 好啦好啦，你过去吧！

lines.en: Rule City is just ahead. Its rules are strict!
lines.zh: 前面就是规则城，那里的规矩很严！

lines.en: Route 9 (sea). West: Animal Island.
lines.zh: 9 号水路（海上）。往西：动物岛。

lines.en: Route 9 (sea). East: Rule City.
lines.zh: 9 号水路（海上）。往东：规则城。

lines.en: This monster is big. It has leaves on its back, but it doesn't have a long tail.
lines.zh: 这只怪兽很大，背上长着叶子，可是没有长尾巴。

lines.en: This monster is a bird. It has wings, but it doesn't have a long tail.
lines.zh: 这只怪兽是只鸟，有翅膀，可是没有长尾巴。

lines.en: It's small and it has a long tail. It has long whiskers, too.
lines.zh: （仔细听描述！）

lines.en: Hello! Are you a trainer? I am Rosa, a ranger on Animal Island.
lines.zh: 你好！你是训练师吗？我是罗莎，动物岛的巡林员。

lines.en: Team Hush is catching wild monsters and putting them in cages!
lines.zh: 嘘声团在抓野生怪兽，把它们关进笼子！

lines.en: Some monsters ran away from them. One of them is hiding in our Animal Park.
lines.zh: 有几只怪兽从他们那里逃了出来，其中一只躲进了我们的动物公园。

lines.en: Can you find it for me? Listen carefully.
lines.zh: 你能帮我找到它吗？仔细听。

lines.en: OK! I will find it!
lines.zh: 对罗莎说：好的！我会找到它的！

lines.en: Thank you! I will wait at the Ranger Station.
lines.zh: 谢谢你！我在巡林站等你。

lines.en: It's small and it has a long tail. This is the one!
lines.zh: 它很小，有一条长尾巴——就是它！

lines.en: Don't be afraid. Come with me!
lines.zh: 温柔地对它说：别怕，跟我来！

lines.en: Nibbler squeaks happily and follows you.
lines.zh: 啃啃鼠开心地吱吱叫，跟在你后面。

lines.en: You found Nibbler! Thank you!
lines.zh: 你找到啃啃鼠了！谢谢你！

lines.en: The other monsters ran into the jungle, north of town.
lines.zh: 其他怪兽跑进了镇子北边的丛林。

lines.en: Team Hush's base is somewhere in that jungle. Please be careful!
lines.zh: 嘘声团的基地就藏在那片丛林里。千万小心！

lines.en: A monster is shaking in the grass. It looks scared.
lines.zh: 一只怪兽在草丛里发抖，看起来很害怕。

lines.en: Did you find another monster? What does it look like?
lines.zh: 罗莎在对讲机里问你：它长什么样？看一看，选出正确的描述，再说出来。

lines.en: It's orange with black stripes.
It's small and it has a long tail.
It's white and fluffy, like a cloud.
Hmm... Look at it again, please.
lines.zh: 嗯……请再仔细看看它。

lines.en: White and fluffy... That's Cloudsheep! Thank you, {name}!
lines.zh: 白白的、毛茸茸的……是云朵羊！谢谢你，{name}！

lines.en: Cloudsheep says "Baa!" and looks at a strange bush near the rocks.
lines.zh: 云朵羊“咩”了一声，一直盯着岩壁旁边一丛奇怪的灌木。

lines.en: A strange bush? Maybe Team Hush is hiding there!
lines.zh: 奇怪的灌木？说不定嘘声团就躲在那里！

lines.en: Cloudsheep runs back to the Ranger Station.
lines.zh: 云朵羊跑回巡林站去了。

lines.en: It's just a bush... Did it move?
lines.zh: 只是一丛灌木……它是不是动了一下？

lines.en: The bush is shaking!
lines.zh: 灌木在发抖！

lines.en: Who are you? Come out!
lines.zh: 大声说：你是谁？出来！

lines.en: Shh! I'm a bush! Bushes can't talk!
lines.zh: 嘘！我是一丛灌木！灌木不会说话！

lines.en: Oh no, you found me! I'm a Hush Crew. Our base is right here!
lines.zh: 糟了，被你发现了！我是嘘声团团员，我们的基地就在这里！

lines.en: The grunt ran into the base. There is a cave door behind the bush!
lines.zh: 团员逃进了基地。灌木后面有一扇洞门！

lines.en: You hear two voices behind the locked door...
lines.zh: 锁着的门后面传来两个人说话的声音……

lines.en: Hey, what's the password for this door again?
lines.zh: 喂，这扇门的口令是什么来着？

lines.en: Shh! Not so loud! The password is...
lines.zh: 嘘！小声点！口令是……

lines.en: Pandas eat bamboo. OK, I will remember it!
lines.zh: 熊猫吃竹子。好，我记住了！

lines.en: Koalas eat leaves.
Password, please!
lines.zh: 门在问口令。选出你听到的那句话，再大声说出来。

lines.en: Wrong password! Beep beep!
lines.zh: 口令不对！哔哔！

lines.en: Password OK. The door is open.
lines.zh: 口令正确，门开了。

lines.en: The button is already pushed.
lines.zh: 按钮已经按下去了。

lines.en: A machine with a big red button. Push it?
lines.zh: 一台机器，上面有个大大的红色按钮。要按吗？

lines.en: Click! The door of the storage room opened.
lines.zh: 咔嗒！仓库的门打开了。

lines.en: Shh... Who let you in, little trainer?
lines.zh: 嘘……谁让你进来的，小训练师？

lines.en: These monsters are ours now. Nobody can hear them in here.
lines.zh: 这些怪兽现在是我们的了。在这里，没人听得见它们的叫声。

lines.en: Let the animals go!
lines.zh: 大声说：放了这些动物！

lines.en: My cages... Fine. Take your little friends.
lines.zh: 我的笼子……算了，把你的小朋友们带走吧。

lines.en: Shh... Then show me how strong your voice is.
lines.zh: 嘘……那就让我看看你的声音有多强。

lines.en: Click, click, click! All the cages are open!
lines.zh: 咔嗒、咔嗒、咔嗒！所有的笼子都打开了！

lines.en: You are free now! Go home!
lines.zh: 对怪兽们说：你们自由了！回家吧！

lines.en: The big cage is open, too. Plugmane is looking at you!
lines.zh: 最大的笼子也打开了。插头狮正盯着你！

lines.en: Kai is waiting for you at the Ranger Station.
lines.zh: 小凯在巡林站等你。

lines.en: Please find the lost monster in the Animal Park.
lines.zh: 请去动物公园找到走丢的那只怪兽。

lines.en: Please be careful. The animals need you!
lines.zh: 千万小心，动物们需要你！

lines.en: Team Hush's base is deep in the jungle, north of town.
lines.zh: 嘘声团的基地在镇子北边的丛林深处。

lines.en: Thank you, {name}! All the monsters are free now.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}！所有的怪兽都自由了。

lines.en: We must save the animals. Can you say it with me?
lines.zh: 我们必须保护动物。你能和我一起说吗？

lines.en: H-hi, {name}... It's me, Kai.
lines.zh: 你、你好，{name}……是我，小凯。

lines.en: I'm helping Rosa look after the monsters here.
lines.zh: 我在这里帮罗莎照顾怪兽。

lines.en: My bird monster is learning to fly. We practice every day!
lines.zh: 我的鸟怪兽在学飞，我们每天都在练习！

lines.en: Please save the monsters in the jungle. I believe in you!
lines.zh: 请你去救丛林里的怪兽吧，我相信你！

lines.en: I'm training every day. One day, I want to battle you!
lines.zh: 我每天都在训练。总有一天，我要和你对战！

lines.en: {name}! You did it! The monsters are free!
lines.zh: {name}！你做到了！怪兽们都自由了！

lines.en: Look! My bird monster can fly now. It flew all the way here!
lines.zh: 你看！我的鸟怪兽会飞了，它一路飞到了这里！

lines.en: I want you to have this. It is the Echo Shell for Sky Ride.
lines.zh: 这个送给你，是「乘风」的回声贝。

lines.en: With nine badges, a flying monster can fly you to any town you visited.
lines.zh: 有了 9 枚徽章，会飞的怪兽就能带你飞到去过的任何一个镇子。

lines.en: Thank you, Kai! You're a great friend.
lines.zh: 对小凯说：谢谢你，小凯！你是我的好朋友。

lines.en: Hee hee... I'll get stronger, too. See you, {name}!
lines.zh: 嘿嘿……我也会变得更强的。再见，{name}！

lines.en: Next path! Listen again.
lines.zh: 下一个路口！再仔细听。

lines.en: Welcome to the Paw Print Path!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到脚印小路！

lines.en: You followed all the right paw prints! The gate to Croc is open.
lines.zh: 三段脚印都走对了！通往鳄鱼巡查员的门打开了。

lines.en: The speaker is quiet now.
lines.zh: 广播已经安静了。

lines.en: Some wild monsters are still in cages! I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 还有野生怪兽被关在笼子里！我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: The monster is scared in the cage. You need the key...
lines.zh: 怪兽在笼子里瑟瑟发抖。要找到开笼子的办法……

lines.en: Cloudsheep is sleeping. "Baa... zzz..."
lines.zh: 云朵羊睡着了。“咩……呼……”

lines.en: Nibbler squeaks happily. "Squeak!"
lines.zh: 啃啃鼠开心地吱吱叫。

lines.en: The storage room is locked. Maybe there is a switch somewhere.
lines.zh: 仓库锁着。也许哪里有个开关。

lines.en: He doesn't have glasses.
lines.zh: 他没戴眼镜。

lines.en: His cap is blue, not red.
lines.zh: 他的帽子是蓝色的，不是红色的。

lines.en: He doesn't have a bag.
lines.zh: 他没有背包。

lines.en: No rules, no order.
lines.zh: 一起说：没有规矩，不成方圆。

lines.en: Walk on the zebra crossing. Wait for the green light.
lines.zh: 走斑马线，等绿灯。

lines.en: Welcome to Rule City. No rules, no order!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到规则城。没有规矩，不成方圆！

lines.en: And we can't eat in the classroom!
lines.zh: 而且不能在教室里吃东西！

lines.en: In our city, we must keep quiet in the library.
lines.zh: 在我们城里，图书馆里必须保持安静。

lines.en: Keep quiet in the library.
Don't be late for class!
lines.zh: 上课不要迟到！

lines.en: We must wear a uniform at school.
lines.zh: 我们上学必须穿校服。

lines.en: We must wear a uniform.
Do you have to clean your room at home?
lines.zh: 你在家要打扫房间吗？

lines.en: I have to wash the dishes every day.
lines.zh: 我每天都要洗碗。

lines.en: I have to wash the dishes.
Rule City Hall. Isle Master: Sharky.
lines.zh: 规则城挑战馆。岛主：鲨鱼纪律官。

lines.en: Welcome to Rule City! Walk on the zebra crossing.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到规则城！过马路请走斑马线。

lines.en: City rules: Don't throw rubbish. Don't run across the road.
lines.zh: 城市守则：不要乱扔垃圾，不要横穿马路。

lines.en: An old stone. There are ancient letters on it.
lines.zh: 一块古老的石头，上面刻着古代的文字。

lines.en: A traffic light. Red means stop. Green means go.
lines.zh: 红绿灯：红灯停，绿灯行。

lines.en: A fountain. "Keep the city clean."
lines.zh: 一座喷泉。“保持城市清洁。”

lines.en: Don't be late for work, too!
lines.zh: 上班也不能迟到！

lines.en: Don't be late.
We have to wear our uniforms every day.
lines.zh: 我们每天都必须穿制服。

lines.en: OK, you know the rules.
lines.zh: 好吧，你懂规矩。

lines.en: Red means stop. Green means go.
lines.zh: 红灯停，绿灯行。

lines.en: Stop! You must wait for the green light!
lines.zh: 站住！你必须等绿灯！

lines.en: Don't run in the hallways! Let's battle!
lines.zh: 不要在走廊里奔跑！来对战吧！

lines.en: Rules keep us safe.
lines.zh: 规则保护我们的安全。

lines.en: You follow the rules well!
lines.zh: 你很守规矩！

lines.en: Don't run across the road!
lines.zh: 不要横穿马路！

lines.en: You must wait for the green light.
lines.zh: 你必须等绿灯。

lines.en: Don't walk on the road. Use the zebra crossing.
lines.zh: 不要走在马路上，请走斑马线。

lines.en: A shark statue. "Rules first!"
lines.zh: 一座鲨鱼雕像：“规则第一！”

lines.en: Tweet! Don't walk on the road! Use the zebra crossing.
lines.zh: 哔——！不要走在马路上！请走斑马线。

lines.en: Tweet! Stop! The light is red. You must wait for the green light.
lines.zh: 哔——！站住！现在是红灯，你必须等绿灯。

lines.en: You crossed all the roads safely! The gate to Sharky is open.
lines.zh: 你安全地过了所有马路！通往鲨鱼纪律官的门打开了。

lines.en: Don't swim alone! Let's battle together!
lines.zh: 不要一个人游泳！我们一起对战吧！

lines.en: We must wear a life jacket on a boat.
lines.zh: 坐船时必须穿救生衣。

lines.en: You are a good swimmer.
lines.zh: 你游得真好。

lines.en: Dark blue water is very deep.
lines.zh: 深蓝色的海水非常深。

lines.en: Glub glub... I lost.
lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜……我输了。

lines.en: The sea is deep here. Be careful!
lines.zh: 这里的海很深，小心！

lines.en: Don't forget to warm up before you swim.
lines.zh: 游泳前别忘了热身。

lines.en: Rule number one: have fun!
lines.zh: 第一条规则：玩得开心！

lines.en: Rule number two: lose with a smile!
lines.zh: 第二条规则：输了也要笑！

lines.en: Maybe you can go under the sea...
lines.zh: 也许你可以从海底过去……

lines.en: People say there is a tunnel under the sea.
lines.zh: 听说海底有一条隧道。

lines.en: Sports Island is behind the reefs. You can't swim there!
lines.zh: 运动美食岛在礁石后面，游不过去的！

lines.en: Exercise every day and you will be strong.
lines.zh: 每天锻炼，你就会变强。

lines.en: I need more practice.
lines.zh: 我还得多练练。

lines.en: I swim here three times a week!
lines.zh: 我每周来这儿游三次！

lines.en: Route 10. Sports Island is behind the reefs. Only divers can get there.
lines.zh: 10 号水路。运动美食岛在礁石后面，只有会潜海的人才能到达。

lines.en: Blub blub... you win.
lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜……你赢了。

lines.en: Blub! I found an old road under the sea!
lines.zh: 咕噜！我在海底发现了一条古老的路！

lines.en: The light at the end goes up to Sports Island.
lines.zh: 尽头的光圈可以浮上去，那边就是运动美食岛。

lines.en: Seaweed is where wild monsters hide.
lines.zh: 野生怪兽喜欢躲在海草里。

lines.en: Shh... the sea is so quiet down here.
lines.zh: 嘘……海底好安静。

lines.en: Your monsters are strong even under the sea!
lines.zh: 你的怪兽在海底也这么强！

lines.en: Hey! You there! Are you a trainer?
lines.zh: 嘿！那边的！你是训练师吗？

lines.en: I'm Officer Lee. Team Hush is breaking all the rules in our city!
lines.zh: 我是李警官。嘘声团在我们城里乱闯红灯、乱扔垃圾，什么规矩都不守！

lines.en: Now other people are breaking the rules, too. The Rule Crystal is gone!
lines.zh: 现在别人也跟着不守规矩了——规则水晶不见了！

lines.en: Can you be a Junior Traffic Officer for one day?
lines.zh: 你能当一天小交警吗？

lines.en: Yes! I can help!
lines.zh: 回答李警官：好的！我能帮忙！

lines.en: Great! Here is your whistle. 🎖️
lines.zh: 太好了！这是你的哨子。🎖️

lines.en: Find three people who are breaking the rules. Tell them the rules in English!
lines.zh: 找到三个不守规矩的人，用英语告诉他们规则！

lines.en: Look on the roads. Our Police Station is the big building in the north-west.
lines.zh: 去马路上找找。我们的警察局是西北边那栋大楼。

lines.en: A boy is running across the road! There are cars coming!
lines.zh: 一个男孩正跑着横穿马路！车子开过来了！

lines.en: Hey! I'm in a hurry! I'm late for school!
lines.zh: 嘿！我赶时间！我上学要迟到了！

lines.en: Oh... you're right. Sorry! I will use the zebra crossing.
lines.zh: 哦……你说得对。对不起！我会走斑马线的。

lines.en: I finished my juice. I'll just drop the bottle here. It's OK, right?
lines.zh: 我果汁喝完了，瓶子就扔这儿吧。没关系的吧？

lines.en: Don't throw rubbish! Put it in the bin.
Nice to meet you.
What do you say to her?
lines.zh: 她要乱扔垃圾。选出你该对她说的话，再大声说出来。

lines.en: Yes, you can.
Hmm, that is not right. Try again!
lines.zh: 嗯，这样说不对。再试一次！

lines.en: OK, OK... Sorry! I'll put it in the bin.
lines.zh: 好啦好啦……对不起！我把它扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: The light is red, but a man is walking and looking at his phone!
lines.zh: 红灯亮着，一个男人却一边看手机一边过马路！

lines.en: La la la... My phone is so interesting...
lines.zh: 啦啦啦……手机真好玩……

lines.en: You must wait for the green light!
lines.zh: 提醒他：你必须等绿灯！

lines.en: Oh! It's red! You're right. I must wait. Thank you!
lines.zh: 哎呀！是红灯！你说得对，我必须等。谢谢你！

lines.en: Great job, {name}! Everyone follows the rules again.
lines.zh: 太棒了，{name}！大家又开始守规矩了。

lines.en: But wait... A Hush Crew is hiding near the fountain. He looks like a normal tourist!
lines.zh: 等等……有个嘘声团团员躲在喷泉旁边，他打扮得像个普通游客！

lines.en: Me? I'm just visiting the city!
lines.zh: 我？我只是来城里玩的！

lines.en: Red cap, glasses and a bag... It's him!
lines.zh: 红帽子、眼镜、背包……就是他！

lines.en: You are a Hush Crew! Stop!
lines.zh: 大声说：你就是嘘声团团员！站住！

lines.en: Rules are boring! Red lights, green lights... Shh!
lines.zh: 规矩真无聊！红灯、绿灯……嘘！

lines.en: Thank you, Junior Officer! Oh, a man at the seaside wants to see you. He's reading an old stone.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，小交警！对了，海边有个人想见你，他在研究一块古老的石头。

lines.en: Hello, {name}. Do you remember me? I am Orion.
lines.zh: 你好，{name}。还记得我吗？我是欧瑞。

lines.en: I am reading the ancient letters on this stone.
lines.zh: 我在研究这块石头上的古代文字。

lines.en: But the city is too noisy with Team Hush. Please help Officer Lee first.
lines.zh: 可是嘘声团把城里弄得太吵了。请先去帮帮李警官吧。

lines.en: Dark blue water means deep water. Surf on it and press A to dive.
lines.zh: 深蓝色的海水就是深水。踏浪到上面，按 A 就能潜下去。

lines.en: The road under the sea goes to Sports Island.
lines.zh: 海底的路通往运动美食岛。

lines.en: Thank you, {name}. The city has order again. Now I can read the stone.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}。城里又恢复秩序了，我终于能读这块石头了。

lines.en: It says: "Under the sea there is a road. It goes to the island of sports and food."
lines.zh: 上面写着：“海底有一条路，通往运动与美食之岛。”

lines.en: It goes to Animal Island.
It goes to Sports Island.
It goes to the Police Station.
Where does the road under the sea go?
lines.zh: 欧瑞问你：海底的路通往哪里？选出正确的回答，再说出来。

lines.en: Listen again: the island of sports and food. That is Sports Island!
lines.zh: 再听一遍：运动与美食之岛——就是运动美食岛！

lines.en: Yes. Sports Island has reefs all around it. Boats and surfers cannot get there.
lines.zh: 没错。运动美食岛四周都是礁石，船和踏浪都过不去。

lines.en: You can only go under the sea. Take this. Now Water Way can dive!
lines.zh: 只能从海底过去。这个回声贝给你，「水路」升到 2 级，能潜下去了。

lines.en: Win the badge here, and your water monster can dive into deep water.
lines.zh: 赢下这里的徽章，你的水系怪兽就能潜进深水。

lines.en: Find the dark blue water on Route 10, east of the city. Then dive!
lines.zh: 去城东的 10 号水路找深蓝色的水，潜下去！

lines.en: Thank you, Junior Officer! Our city has order again.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，小交警！我们的城市又恢复秩序了。

lines.en: Find the people who are breaking the rules. They are on the roads!
lines.zh: 去找那些不守规矩的人，他们就在马路上！

lines.en: Tell them the rules in English. You can do it!
lines.zh: 用英语告诉他们规则。你能行的！

lines.en: Team Hush broke all the rules in my city! I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 嘘声团把城里的规矩全破坏了！我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: Walk on the zebra crossing, and only when the light is green!
lines.zh: 只能走斑马线，而且只有绿灯才能走！

lines.en: Welcome to the Traffic Hall! Cross three roads to reach Sharky.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到红绿灯挑战馆！穿过三条马路才能见到鲨鱼纪律官。

lines.en: "Under the sea there is a road."
lines.zh: “海底有一条路。”

lines.en: An old stone with ancient letters.
lines.zh: 一块刻着古代文字的石头。

lines.en: You cannot read the letters.
lines.zh: 你看不懂上面的字。

lines.en: I exercise three times a week.
lines.zh: 我每周锻炼三次。

lines.en: I swim every morning. How often do you exercise?
lines.zh: 我每天早上都游泳。你多久锻炼一次？

lines.en: You must exercise a lot!
lines.zh: 你一定经常锻炼！

lines.en: After this battle, let's have some dumplings!
lines.zh: 打完这场，我们去吃饺子吧！

lines.en: I'd like some dumplings, please.
lines.zh: 请给我来些饺子。

lines.en: I'm hungry now...
lines.zh: 我现在饿了……

lines.en: Eat more vegetables and fruit.
lines.zh: 多吃蔬菜和水果。

lines.en: Fruit gives me energy for swimming!
lines.zh: 水果给我游泳的力气！

lines.en: I need another banana...
lines.zh: 我还需要一根香蕉……

lines.en: Drink milk every day.
lines.zh: 每天喝牛奶。

lines.en: Good race!
lines.zh: 比得好！

lines.en: Welcome to the reef sea! Sports Island is north.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到礁石海！运动美食岛就在北边。

lines.en: Let's play ping-pong on the island later!
lines.zh: 等会儿去岛上打乒乓球吧！

lines.en: Ready, steady, go!
lines.zh: 预备——开始！

lines.en: You are fast!
lines.zh: 你真快！

lines.en: North: Sports Island. Keep fit, eat well!
lines.zh: 往北：运动美食岛。锻炼身体，好好吃饭！

lines.en: Only trainers with eleven badges can go in.
lines.zh: 只有 11 枚徽章的训练师才能进去。

lines.en: Stop! The Ice Cave is very cold and slippery.
lines.zh: 站住！冰洞里又冷又滑。

lines.en: Win the badge from Coach Seal first!
lines.zh: 先去赢下海狮教练的徽章吧！

lines.en: I'd like some beef noodles, please.
I'd like some beef noodles, please. That's my favourite!
lines.zh: 请给我来些牛肉面——我最喜欢吃！

lines.en: What would you like to eat?
lines.zh: 你想吃点什么？

lines.en: How often do you exercise?
lines.zh: 你多久锻炼一次？

lines.en: I exercise every day! Running is good for you.
lines.zh: 我每天都锻炼！跑步对身体好。

lines.en: Let's play basketball after school!
lines.zh: 放学后我们打篮球吧！

lines.en: Let's play basketball after school.
Or football! I like all sports.
lines.zh: 或者踢足球！我什么运动都喜欢。

lines.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away!
lines.zh: 一天一苹果，医生远离我！

lines.en: These fruit trees are my friends.
lines.zh: 这些果树是我的朋友。

lines.en: Welcome to Sports Island! Keep fit, eat well.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到运动美食岛！锻炼身体，好好吃饭。

lines.en: Sports Island Stadium (Challenge Hall). Isle Master: Coach Seal.
lines.zh: 运动美食岛体育场（挑战馆）。岛主：海狮教练。

lines.en: Food Festival! Try our dumplings and noodles.
lines.zh: 美食节！快来尝尝饺子和面条。

lines.en: The Sports Day trophy. "Healthy body, happy mind!"
lines.zh: 运动会的奖杯：“身体健康，心情快乐！”

lines.en: Slide, stop, eat healthy food! Easy, right?
lines.zh: 滑、停、吃健康食物！很简单，对吧？

lines.en: Stop on the apple, not the chips!
lines.zh: 要停在苹果上，别停在薯条上！

lines.en: You have good balance!
lines.zh: 你的平衡感真好！

lines.en: Hamburgers are not healthy.
lines.zh: 汉堡不健康。

lines.en: I eat vegetables every day. That is why I am strong!
lines.zh: 我每天都吃蔬菜，所以我这么强壮！

lines.en: I need more broccoli...
lines.zh: 我得多吃点西兰花……

lines.en: A sea lion statue holding a ball.
lines.zh: 一座顶着球的海狮雕像。

lines.en: You ate three healthy foods! The gate to Coach Seal is open.
lines.zh: 你吃到了三种健康食物！通往海狮教练的门打开了。

lines.en: I slipped...
lines.zh: 我滑倒了……

lines.en: Think before you slide!
lines.zh: 滑之前先想好路线！

lines.en: This ice is perfect for skiing!
lines.zh: 这冰面最适合滑雪了！

lines.en: Brr! It is cold in here. A battle will warm us up!
lines.zh: 呜，这里好冷！打一场就暖和了！

lines.en: I feel warm now. Thanks!
lines.zh: 现在暖和了，谢谢！

lines.en: Slide up, then left, then up. That is how I got out!
lines.zh: 往上滑，再往左，再往上——我就是这样出去的！

lines.en: I ski here every weekend!
lines.zh: 我每个周末都来这里滑雪！

lines.en: Skiing is great exercise.
lines.zh: 滑雪是很好的锻炼。

lines.en: You are faster than the wind!
lines.zh: 你比风还快！

lines.en: Hot soup and dumplings after skiing. Yum!
lines.zh: 滑完雪喝热汤吃饺子，好香！

lines.en: Time for soup...
lines.zh: 该去喝汤了……

lines.en: Weather Island is north of here.
lines.zh: 天气岛就在北边。

lines.en: Always warm up before sports.
lines.zh: 运动前一定要热身。

lines.en: I should warm up more.
lines.zh: 我应该多热热身。

lines.en: Warm up first, then play!
lines.zh: 先热身，再玩！

lines.en: Brr... I lost.
lines.zh: 呜……我输了。

lines.en: Don't eat snow. Drink warm milk!
lines.zh: 别吃雪，喝热牛奶！

lines.en: Snowballs are my favourite food! Just kidding!
lines.zh: 雪球是我最爱的食物！开玩笑的！

lines.en: Snowfield. North: Weather Island. The frozen lake is slippery!
lines.zh: 雪原。往北：天气岛。结冰的湖面很滑！

lines.en: Ring ring! Mom is calling!
lines.zh: 叮铃铃！妈妈打来电话了！

lines.en: Hi, {name}! It's Mom. Are you on Sports Island now?
lines.zh: 喂，{name}！是妈妈。你现在到运动美食岛了吗？

lines.en: I heard there is a Sports Day and a Food Festival there!
lines.zh: 听说那里正在开运动会和美食节！

lines.en: I had some fruit and vegetables.
What did you eat today?
lines.zh: 妈妈问你今天吃了什么。选出合适的回答，再说出来。

lines.en: Yes, I did.
Good! Fruit and vegetables are healthy.
lines.zh: 真棒！水果和蔬菜都很健康。

lines.en: Hmm? I asked what you ate! You can say: I had some fruit and vegetables.
lines.zh: 嗯？妈妈问的是你吃了什么！可以说：我吃了一些水果和蔬菜。

lines.en: Eat well and keep fit, OK? And say hi to {rival} for me. Bye!
lines.zh: 好好吃饭，好好锻炼，知道吗？替我向 {rival} 问好。拜拜！

lines.en: Oh, {name}... Ouch... My tummy hurts...
lines.zh: 哦，{name}……哎哟……我肚子好疼……

lines.en: I ate ten hamburgers and five ice creams at the Food Festival...
lines.zh: 我在美食节吃了十个汉堡和五个冰淇淋……

lines.en: Oh dear! {rival} needs some healthy food. {name}, can you help?
lines.zh: 天哪！{rival} 需要吃点健康的东西。{name}，你能帮帮忙吗？

lines.en: More hamburgers and ice cream.
Some chips and cola.
Some fruit and vegetables.
What should I eat?
lines.zh: {rival} 问你该吃什么。选出健康的建议，再说出来。

lines.en: No, no! Junk food makes it worse. Think again!
lines.zh: 不行不行！垃圾食品只会更难受。再想想！

lines.en: OK... I will eat an apple and some vegetables.
lines.zh: 好吧……我吃个苹果和一些蔬菜。

lines.en: A little later...
lines.zh: 过了一会儿……

lines.en: Wow! I feel much better now! Thank you, {name}!
lines.zh: 哇！我感觉好多了！谢谢你，{name}！

lines.en: Now I'm full of energy! Let's have a relay race on the track!
lines.zh: 现在我浑身是劲！我们去跑道上比接力赛吧！

lines.en: A race? Great! Go to the start line!
lines.zh: 赛跑？太好了！到起跑线上来！

lines.en: On your marks... Say the magic words to start!
lines.zh: 各就各位……大声喊口令开始比赛！

lines.en: For two hours.
On the playground.
Pass the baton! Answer me first: How often do you exercise?
lines.zh: 交接力棒啦！教练问你多久锻炼一次，选出合适的回答再说出来。

lines.en: Oops, you dropped the baton! {rival} wins the race.
lines.zh: 哎呀，接力棒掉了！{rival} 赢了这场比赛。

lines.en: You passed the baton perfectly! You win the race!
lines.zh: 你完美地交出了接力棒！你赢了这场比赛！

lines.en: I won the race! Now, a monster battle!
lines.zh: 我赢了赛跑！现在来一场怪兽对战吧！

lines.en: You are so fast! OK, but a monster battle is different!
lines.zh: 你跑得真快！不过怪兽对战可不一样！

lines.en: That was a great battle!
lines.zh: 这场对战真精彩！

lines.en: You beat me again! You really are strong.
lines.zh: 又输给你了！你真的很强。

lines.en: Oh no, look! Team Hush is at the market! They are giving away free junk food!
lines.zh: 哎呀，你看！嘘声团在集市上免费发垃圾食品！

lines.en: Everyone is eating chips and lying on the grass. Nobody wants to move!
lines.zh: 大家都在吃薯条、躺在草地上，谁都不想动了！

lines.en: I'll tell Coach Seal. Please stop them, {name}!
lines.zh: 我去告诉海狮教练。{name}，快去阻止他们！

lines.en: Free hamburgers! Free chips! Eat and sleep. Don't move!
lines.zh: 免费汉堡！免费薯条！吃完就睡，别动！

lines.en: Hamburgers are not healthy!
lines.zh: 大声说：汉堡不健康！

lines.en: Who cares? Healthy food is boring! Shh!
lines.zh: 谁在乎？健康食物最无聊了！嘘！

lines.en: You want the Health Crystal? Then answer me!
lines.zh: 你想要健康水晶？那先回答我！

lines.en: Is ice cream healthy?
lines.zh: 她问你冰淇淋健不健康。选出合适的回答，再说出来。

lines.en: No, not really.
Ha! You don't even know! Battle!
lines.zh: 哈！你连这都不知道！来对战吧！

lines.en: Hmph! You know too much!
lines.zh: 哼！你懂得太多了！

lines.en: Eat junk food and stay in bed forever!
lines.zh: 吃垃圾食品，永远躺在床上吧！

lines.en: Shh... A quiet, lazy island is a happy island!
lines.zh: 嘘……安静又懒洋洋的岛才快乐！

lines.en: One more Hush Crew is at the market!
lines.zh: 集市上还有一个嘘声团团员！

lines.en: Everyone stands up and starts to exercise!
lines.zh: 大家都站了起来，开始锻炼身体！

lines.en: Eat more vegetables and fruit!
lines.zh: 劝劝他：多吃蔬菜和水果！

lines.en: I don't want to move... Chips are so yummy...
lines.zh: 我不想动……薯条真好吃……

lines.en: Maybe... after I stop those Hush people...
lines.zh: 也许吧……等你赶走那些嘘声团的人……

lines.en: Team Hush is making everyone eat junk food! I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 嘘声团让大家都去吃垃圾食品！我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: North: Route 12, the Waterfall River.
lines.zh: 往北：12 号路，瀑布河。

lines.en: Weather Island. How's the weather today?
lines.zh: 天气岛。今天天气怎么样？

lines.en: South: Route 11. Take an umbrella with you!
lines.zh: 往南：11 号路。记得带上雨伞！

lines.en: A snowman. It says: "It's snowy and cold!"
lines.zh: 一个雪人。它好像在说：“又下雪又冷！”

lines.en: A weather telescope. You can see the clouds.
lines.zh: 一台气象望远镜，能看清天上的云。

lines.en: The sky is grey. "It's cloudy and cold today."
lines.zh: 天空灰蒙蒙的。“今天多云，很冷。”

lines.en: A happy snowman. "I like snowy days!"
lines.zh: 一个开心的雪人：“我喜欢下雪天！”

lines.en: A snowman with an umbrella. "Take an umbrella with you."
lines.zh: 一个打着伞的雪人：“带上雨伞吧。”

lines.en: An old weather bell. When it rings, a storm is coming.
lines.zh: 一口旧的天气钟。钟一响，就是暴风雪要来了。

lines.en: I love the ice lake! When you slide, you only stop at a rock or at the shore.
lines.zh: 我最爱冰湖了！在冰上滑的时候，只有撞到石头或者到了岸边才会停。

lines.en: Stop at the rock!
There is something shiny on the far side. Can you get it?
lines.zh: 湖的另一边有个亮晶晶的东西，你拿得到吗？

lines.en: And here? It's snowing, of course!
lines.zh: 那这里呢？当然是在下雪啦！

lines.en: I'm reading the newspaper. It says: 'It's raining in Beijing.'
lines.zh: 我在看报纸。上面说：“北京正在下雨。”

lines.en: It's raining in Beijing.
My feet are cold...
lines.zh: 我的脚好冷……

lines.en: Shh! Snow is quiet. Quiet is good!
lines.zh: 嘘！雪是安静的，安静就是好！

lines.en: The machine is upstairs. But the door is locked!
lines.zh: 机器在楼上。不过楼梯的门是锁着的！

lines.en: Brr... You are strong.
lines.zh: 呜……你好强。

lines.en: It's snowing, it's snowing! Nobody goes out!
lines.zh: 下雪啦下雪啦！谁都不许出门！

lines.en: The panel asks a weather question. Answer it, and the door opens.
lines.zh: 控制台会问一个天气问题。答对了门就开了。

lines.en: I watch the weather on the screens every day.
lines.zh: 我每天都盯着屏幕看天气。

lines.en: What's the weather like in Harbin?
What's the weather like in Harbin? Cold! In Hainan? Hot!
lines.zh: 哈尔滨天气怎么样？冷！海南呢？热！

lines.en: Good evening! Here is the weather. It's windy in the gym!
lines.zh: 晚上好！现在播报天气：挑战馆里正在刮风！

lines.en: Listen to the radio. The order is important!
lines.zh: 好好听收音机，顺序很重要！

lines.en: That was a storm of English!
lines.zh: 这真是一场英语风暴！

lines.en: I am all wet now!
lines.zh: 我全身都湿透了！

lines.en: It's raining! I love rainy days!
lines.zh: 下雨啦！我最喜欢下雨天！

lines.en: Rainy comes after sunny. Remember?
lines.zh: 晴天后面是雨天，记得吗？

lines.en: On the ice, you only stop at a rock or a wall.
lines.zh: 在冰上，只有撞到石头或墙才会停下。

lines.en: Slide, slide! It's cold, but I'm warm!
lines.zh: 滑呀滑！天很冷，但我很暖和！

lines.en: You slid past me!
lines.zh: 你从我身边滑过去了！

lines.en: Memory Island is just north. Can you see the old stones in the fog?
lines.zh: 回忆岛就在北边。看见雾里那些古老的石头了吗？

lines.en: The Waterfall River. Ride to the waterfall and climb it with Water Way 3!
lines.zh: 瀑布河。在水上走到瀑布下面，用「水路 3 级」爬上去！

lines.en: Route 12. It's cold here. Wear a warm coat!
lines.zh: 12 号路。这里很冷，穿上暖和的外套！

lines.en: An old stone gate: "Welcome, traveller. What did you see on your trip?"
lines.zh: 古老的石门：“欢迎你，旅行者。你在旅途中看到了什么？”

lines.en: An old stone gate: "Long ago, people came here to tell stories."
lines.zh: 古老的石门：“很久以前，人们来这里讲故事。”

lines.en: A stone: "I went to the sea."
lines.zh: 一块石头：“我去了大海。”

lines.en: A stone: "I saw a dragon."
lines.zh: 一块石头：“我看见了一条龙。”

lines.en: A stone: "I heard many voices."
lines.zh: 一块石头：“我听见了很多声音。”

lines.en: A stone: "We spoke together."
lines.zh: 一块石头：“我们一起说话。”

lines.en: A stone: "The dragon woke up!"
lines.zh: 一块石头：“龙醒过来了！”

lines.en: A stone on the island: "I found a treasure here!"
lines.zh: 小岛上的石头：“我在这里找到了宝物！”

lines.en: A snowman in the rocks. "Brr! How's the weather up there?"
lines.zh: 岩石中间的雪人：“呼……上面天气怎么样？”

lines.en: Brr! It's cold, but I love swimming!
lines.zh: 呼……好冷，但是我最爱游泳了！

lines.en: I need a hot drink...
lines.zh: 我得喝杯热饮……

lines.en: Surf to the waterfall. Then climb up!
lines.zh: 踏浪到瀑布下面，然后爬上去！

lines.en: I climbed the waterfall yesterday!
lines.zh: 我昨天爬上了瀑布！

lines.en: Memory Island is north. It is always foggy there.
lines.zh: 回忆岛在北边，那里总是有雾。

lines.en: You are a strong climber, too!
lines.zh: 你也是个厉害的攀登者！

lines.en: "Went", "saw", "spoke"... The stones talk about the past.
lines.zh: “went、saw、spoke”……石头上说的都是过去的事。

lines.en: These stones are very old. Did you read them?
lines.zh: 这些石头很古老。你读过上面的字吗？

lines.en: You read well, and you battle well!
lines.zh: 你读得好，打得也好！

lines.en: I fell in the snow!
lines.zh: 我摔进雪堆里了！

lines.en: It's snowy and windy. Great weather for skiing!
lines.zh: 又下雪又刮风，最适合滑雪了！

lines.en: What's the weather like? Cold, cold, cold!
lines.zh: 天气怎么样？冷、冷、冷！

lines.en: It's cloudy today. The fish like cloudy days!
lines.zh: 今天多云，鱼儿喜欢多云的天气！

lines.en: My fish got away!
lines.zh: 我的鱼跑掉了！

lines.en: Take an umbrella. It may rain soon.
lines.zh: 带把伞吧，可能快下雨了。

lines.en: How's the weather in your town? Here, it's snowing!
lines.zh: 你们那边天气怎么样？这里在下雪！

lines.en: I'm going home to watch TV. It's too cold!
lines.zh: 我要回家看电视了，太冷了！

lines.en: Snow in my boots!
lines.zh: 雪都灌进靴子里了！

lines.en: Memory Island. The Memory Temple is north.
lines.zh: 回忆岛。回忆神殿在北边。

lines.en: South: Route 12. East: Brave Road.
lines.zh: 往南：12 号路。往东：勇气之路。

lines.en: A stone guard: "I waited here for a thousand years."
lines.zh: 石头守卫：“我在这里等了一千年。”

lines.en: A stone guard: "Many people visited this temple long ago."
lines.zh: 石头守卫：“很久以前，很多人来参观过这座神殿。”

lines.en: An old stone: "We played here when we were young."
lines.zh: 一块古老的石头：“我们小时候在这里玩过。”

lines.en: An old stone: "The Hush King came from the sea."
lines.zh: 一块古老的石头：“寂静之王是从海里来的。”

lines.en: An old stone: "Yesterday it was foggy. Today it is foggy, too!"
lines.zh: 一块古老的石头：“昨天有雾，今天也有雾！”

lines.en: A stone in the pond: "I saw a big dragon in the sky."
lines.zh: 池塘里的石头：“我看见天上有一条大龙。”

lines.en: An old wall: "Last weekend, I visited my grandparents."
lines.zh: 一面旧墙：“上周末，我去看望了我的祖父母。”

lines.en: A stone: "Welcome to Memory Island. What did you do yesterday?"
lines.zh: 一块石头：“欢迎来到回忆岛。你昨天做了什么？”

lines.en: This is the Brave Road. Only trainers with thirteen badges can go.
lines.zh: 这里是勇气之路，只有 13 枚徽章的训练师才能通过。

lines.en: Win the badge of Memory Island first!
lines.zh: 先拿到回忆岛的徽章吧！

lines.en: Did you see it, too?
lines.zh: 你也看见了吗？

lines.en: I saw a dragon in the sky.
Last night I had a dream. I saw a big dragon in the sky!
lines.zh: 昨晚我做了个梦，梦见天上有一条大龙！

lines.en: We took a lot of photos.
We took a lot of photos. It was great!
lines.zh: 我们拍了好多照片，棒极了！

lines.en: When I was young, I climbed the waterfall with my monster.
lines.zh: 我年轻的时候，和我的怪兽一起爬过那道瀑布。

lines.en: Tablet 1: "Long ago, the Hush King ate all the sounds."
lines.zh: 石板一：“很久以前，寂静之王吞掉了所有的声音。”

lines.en: Tablet 2: "The world was very quiet. People were sad."
lines.zh: 石板二：“世界变得非常安静，人们很难过。”

lines.en: Tablet 3: "Then the people spoke together. They were loud and happy."
lines.zh: 石板三：“后来，人们一起大声说话，又响亮又快乐。”

lines.en: Tablet 4: "Echodrake heard them. It woke up and flew to the sea."
lines.zh: 石板四：“回声龙听见了，它醒过来，飞向了大海。”

lines.en: Tablet 5: "Echodrake closed the sea door with thirteen crystals."
lines.zh: 石板五：“回声龙用十三颗水晶关上了海底的门。”

lines.en: Tablet 6: "Remember! Words can make friends."
lines.zh: 石板六：“记住！话语能交到朋友。”

lines.en: Tablet 7: "We remembered the old words, and we were not afraid."
lines.zh: 石板七：“我们记住了古老的词语，就不再害怕了。”

lines.en: Read the tablets. The door asks about them.
lines.zh: 读读石板吧。那扇门会问上面的事。

lines.en: Shh! Mr. Mute doesn't want visitors!
lines.zh: 嘘！默先生不想见客人！

lines.en: Shh... that was loud.
lines.zh: 嘘……你也太响了。

lines.en: I forgot all my words... and I was happy!
lines.zh: 我把话全忘了……我可开心了！

lines.en: I remember a word now: "sorry".
lines.zh: 我现在想起一个词了：“sorry”。

lines.en: Maybe words are not so bad...
lines.zh: 也许说话也没那么糟……

lines.en: Go up. The boss is waiting at the sea door.
lines.zh: 上去吧，老大就在海底之门那里等着。

lines.en: I'm not quiet now. I'm sad!
lines.zh: 我现在不安静了，我难过！

lines.en: Yesterday I was a quiet boy. Today I'm a quiet man!
lines.zh: 昨天我是个安静的男孩，今天我是个安静的男人！

lines.en: The Color Crystal. Red, yellow, blue and green!
lines.zh: 颜色水晶。红、黄、蓝、绿！

lines.en: The Family Crystal. It feels warm, like a home.
lines.zh: 家庭水晶。暖暖的，像一个家。

lines.en: The School Crystal. You can hear a school bell inside.
lines.zh: 校园水晶。里面好像有上课铃声。

lines.en: The Subject Crystal. Math, English, science...
lines.zh: 学科水晶。数学、英语、科学……

lines.en: The Club Crystal. Somebody is singing inside!
lines.zh: 社团水晶。里面有人在唱歌！

lines.en: The Clock Crystal. Tick, tock, tick, tock.
lines.zh: 时钟水晶。滴答，滴答。

lines.en: The Party Crystal. Happy birthday!
lines.zh: 派对水晶。生日快乐！

lines.en: The Animal Crystal. It has a long tail and big ears.
lines.zh: 动物水晶。它有长长的尾巴和大耳朵。

lines.en: The Rule Crystal. Don't run! Be quiet in the library!
lines.zh: 规则水晶。不要跑！在图书馆要安静！

lines.en: ate
lines.zh: 吃了

lines.en: beach
lines.zh: 海滩

lines.en: bought
lines.zh: 买了

lines.en: saw
lines.zh: 看见了

lines.en: trip
lines.zh: 旅行

lines.en: went
lines.zh: 去了

lines.en: I saw a strong trainer today!
lines.zh: 我今天看见了一个很强的训练师！

lines.en: I went to the beach last summer. Did you?
lines.zh: 去年夏天我去了海滩。你去了吗？

lines.en: Step on a card to turn it over. Find the pairs!
lines.zh: 踩在牌上就能翻开它。把一对对找出来！

lines.en: "Ate" is the past of "eat". "Bought" is the past of "buy".
lines.zh: “ate”是“eat”的过去式，“bought”是“buy”的过去式。

lines.en: I ate too much candy and lost!
lines.zh: 我糖吃多了，输了！

lines.en: What did you do last weekend? I bought a new book!
lines.zh: 你上周末做了什么？我买了一本新书！

lines.en: Remember your trip. Remember every word.
lines.zh: 记住你的旅程，记住每一个词。

lines.en: The Memory Dragon is waiting. Tell it about your past!
lines.zh: 回忆巨龙在等你。跟它讲讲你的过去吧！

lines.en: Your memory is very good.
lines.zh: 你的记性真好。

lines.en: Brave Road. Only the strongest trainers go this way!
lines.zh: 勇气之路。只有最强的训练师才走这条路！

lines.en: A stone lion. "Speak clearly, and you will win."
lines.zh: 一座石狮子：“说得清楚，你就会赢。”

lines.en: A stone lion. "Thirteen islands, thirteen badges."
lines.zh: 一座石狮子：“十三座岛，十三枚徽章。”

lines.en: Hello! Nice to meet you! What's your name? Let's battle!
lines.zh: 你好！很高兴认识你！你叫什么名字？来对战吧！

lines.en: On Hello Island, we all said "Hello!" first.
lines.zh: 在你好岛，我们每个人最先说的都是“Hello！”

lines.en: You remember the first words you learned!
lines.zh: 你还记得你学的第一句英语！

lines.en: Clubs, birthdays, animals... we learned so much.
lines.zh: 社团、生日、动物……我们学了好多。

lines.en: I can swim, and I can sing. Can you beat me?
lines.zh: 我会游泳，也会唱歌。你能打败我吗？

lines.en: You can do it! You did it!
lines.zh: 你能做到！你真的做到了！

lines.en: Don't break the rules... and don't give up!
lines.zh: 不要破坏规则……也不要放弃！

lines.en: Eat well, keep fit, and speak English every day!
lines.zh: 好好吃饭，锻炼身体，每天说英语！

lines.en: It's seven o'clock. Time to battle!
lines.zh: 七点了，该对战了！

lines.en: I get up at five o'clock and train every day!
lines.zh: 我每天五点起床训练！

lines.en: My daily plan needs more English!
lines.zh: 我的作息表里得加点英语了！

lines.en: Smash the cracked rocks. Push the big ones.
lines.zh: 有裂缝的石头打碎，大石头推开。

lines.en: It's dark and cold here. How's the weather outside?
lines.zh: 这里又黑又冷。外面天气怎么样？

lines.en: Surf across the lake. The stairs are in the north.
lines.zh: 踏浪过湖，楼梯在北边。

lines.en: You're as bright as the sun!
lines.zh: 你像太阳一样耀眼！

lines.en: A giant made of iron sleeps in the west.
lines.zh: 西边睡着一个铁做的巨人。

lines.en: I can see your past. You helped many people!
lines.zh: 我能看见你的过去。你帮助过很多人！

lines.en: I didn't see that coming!
lines.zh: 这个我可没算到！

lines.en: Go up the stairs. Someone is waiting for you.
lines.zh: 上楼去吧，有人在等你。

lines.en: My favourite subject is P.E. And English!
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是体育，还有英语！

lines.en: You are the best student!
lines.zh: 你是最棒的学生！

lines.en: My family came to see me! My mom, my dad and my sister!
lines.zh: 我的家人都来看我了！妈妈、爸爸还有妹妹！

lines.en: My family is still proud of me.
lines.zh: 我的家人还是为我骄傲。

lines.en: The exit is north. The light is so bright!
lines.zh: 出口在北边，外面的光好亮！

lines.en: Some paths go nowhere. Try another way.
lines.zh: 有些路是死路，换条路试试。

lines.en: Where is the library? Just kidding! Let's battle!
lines.zh: 图书馆在哪里？开玩笑的！来对战吧！

lines.en: You know your way!
lines.zh: 你很会认路嘛！

lines.en: A boy with green hair is waiting at the exit.
lines.zh: 一个绿头发的男孩在出口等着。

lines.en: Happy birthday? No, happy battle day!
lines.zh: 生日快乐？不，是对战快乐！

lines.en: What a gift! A great battle!
lines.zh: 真是一份好礼物——一场精彩的对战！

lines.en: The English Cup. Four masters and the Champion are waiting!
lines.zh: 英语冠军赛。四位擂主和冠军在里面等你！

lines.en: A golden trophy. "Speak, and be heard!"
lines.zh: 一座金奖杯：“开口说，就会被听见！”

lines.en: A golden trophy. "Every word is a step."
lines.zh: 一座金奖杯：“每一个词都是一步。”

lines.en: A fountain. The water sings in the wind.
lines.zh: 一座喷泉，水声在风里像在唱歌。

lines.en: I want to be the Champion!
The Champion was amazing. I want to be like her one day!
lines.zh: 冠军太厉害了，我以后也想像她一样！

lines.en: Wow! You came up the Brave Road! I watched the English Cup on TV last year.
lines.zh: 哇！你是从勇气之路上来的！去年我在电视上看了冠军赛。

lines.en: After you win a room, the next door opens. Your progress is saved.
lines.zh: 赢下一个房间，下一扇门就会打开，进度会保存。

lines.en: Four Masters and the Champion are waiting. Each of them has a special rule.
lines.zh: 四位擂主和冠军在等你，每个人都有自己的特别规则。

lines.en: Heal your team here, and buy what you need. Good luck!
lines.zh: 在这里恢复队伍、买好需要的东西。祝你好运！

lines.en: I am ready for the English Cup!
Welcome to the English Cup!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到英语冠军赛！

lines.en: Cloudy
lines.zh: 多云

lines.en: Rainy
lines.zh: 下雨

lines.en: Snowy
lines.zh: 下雪

lines.en: Sunny
lines.zh: 晴天

lines.en: Windy
lines.zh: 刮风

lines.en: Whoooosh! A big snowstorm is blowing.
lines.zh: 呼——！暴风雪刮得正猛。

lines.en: It is very cold. There is nobody in the street.
lines.zh: 好冷啊，街上一个人也没有。

lines.en: Brr! Hello! Are you a trainer? You came in this snow?
lines.zh: 呼……你好！你是训练师吗？这么大的雪你也来了？

lines.en: I'm watching TV.
lines.zh: 跟他说一遍

lines.en: It's snowy and cold.
It's sunny and hot.
What's the weather like today?
lines.zh: 他问你今天天气怎么样。看看四周，选出正确的回答，再大声说出来。

lines.en: Look around! It's snowy and cold.
lines.zh: 你看看四周！又下雪又冷呀。

lines.en: Yes, it's snowy and cold. It's snowing every day. It never stops!
lines.zh: 对，又下雪又冷。天天都在下雪，一直不停！

lines.en: Team Hush built a weather machine on top of the Weather Tower.
lines.zh: 嘘声团在气象塔顶上造了一台天气机。

lines.en: They want everyone to stay at home and be quiet.
lines.zh: 他们想让大家都待在家里，不出门、不说话。

lines.en: Dr. Skye at the Weather Station knows all about weather. Please go and see her!
lines.zh: 气象台的斯凯博士最懂天气了，快去找她吧！

lines.en: The Weather Station is the round building with the glass roof.
lines.zh: 气象台就是那栋玻璃圆顶的房子。

lines.en: Please take this Echo Shell. Now Water Way can climb waterfalls!
lines.zh: 这个回声贝送给你。「水路」升到 3 级，能爬上瀑布了！

lines.en: With twelve badges, a water monster can climb up a waterfall.
lines.zh: 有了 12 枚徽章，水系怪兽就能爬上瀑布。

lines.en: The Waterfall River is north of town. Memory Island is above the waterfall.
lines.zh: 瀑布河就在镇子北边，瀑布上面就是回忆岛。

lines.en: Thank you, Dr. Skye!
lines.zh: 向斯凯博士道谢

lines.en: Oh! A visitor in this storm! I'm Dr. Skye. I study the weather.
lines.zh: 哎呀，这么大的风雪还有人来！我是斯凯博士，研究天气的。

lines.en: The weather machine is on the top of the Weather Tower.
lines.zh: 天气机就在气象塔的顶上。

lines.en: It has weather buttons. To turn it off, press them in the order of the real forecast.
lines.zh: 机器上有天气按钮。要关掉它，得按「真正的天气预报」的顺序去按。

lines.en: Let's ask my radio for tomorrow's forecast. Can you ask it?
lines.zh: 我们问问收音机明天的天气预报吧。你来问好吗？

lines.en: What's the weather like tomorrow?
lines.zh: 对着收音机大声问：明天天气怎么样？

lines.en: Good morning! Here is the weather report. Tomorrow will be sunny, then rainy, then windy.
lines.zh: （仔细听收音机里的天气预报！点右上角的喇叭可以再听一遍）

lines.en: Rainy, then sunny, then windy.
Sunny, then rainy, then windy.
lines.zh: （仔细听！只听不看。点右上角的喇叭可以再听一遍）

lines.en: What did the radio say? What is the order?
lines.zh: 收音机说了什么？选出天气的顺序，再说出来。

lines.en: Windy, then snowy, then sunny.
Listen again. It's sunny, then rainy, then windy.
lines.zh: 再听一遍：先晴天，再下雨，然后刮风。

lines.en: Right! Sunny, then rainy, then windy. Remember the order!
lines.zh: 对！先晴天，再下雨，然后刮风。记住这个顺序！

lines.en: A Hush Crew is standing at the tower door. Please be careful!
lines.zh: 塔门口站着一个嘘声团员，千万小心！

lines.en: Thank you so much! The snow stopped, and the sun is out!
lines.zh: 太感谢你了！雪停了，太阳出来了！

lines.en: Remember the forecast: sunny, then rainy, then windy.
lines.zh: 记住天气预报：先晴天，再下雨，然后刮风。

lines.en: The weather machine is on the top of the tower. Good luck!
lines.zh: 天气机在塔顶上。祝你好运！

lines.en: Look at the sky! It's sunny and warm today.
lines.zh: 看看天空！今天晴朗又暖和。

lines.en: How's the weather today?
lines.zh: 斯凯博士问你今天天气怎么样。

lines.en: I'm reading.
It's snowing.
It's sunny and warm.
lines.zh: 跟奶奶说一遍

lines.en: Climb the waterfall on Route 12. Memory Island is waiting for you.
lines.zh: 去爬 12 号路的瀑布吧，回忆岛在等你。

lines.en: Shh! The tower is closed. Go home and stay inside!
lines.zh: 嘘！塔关门了。回家去，待在屋里！

lines.en: Nobody can stop the snow. Nobody knows the right order! Ha!
lines.zh: 谁也停不了这场雪，谁都不知道正确的顺序！哈！

lines.en: The right order...? Maybe Dr. Skye at the Weather Station knows.
lines.zh: 正确的顺序……？也许气象台的斯凯博士知道。

lines.en: What? You know the forecast? You can't go in!
lines.zh: 什么？你知道天气预报了？不许进去！

lines.en: Shh... Fine, go up. Whisper and Rumble are waiting at the top!
lines.zh: 嘘……好吧，上去吧。低语和闷雷在塔顶等着你！

lines.en: The door to the stairs is open.
lines.zh: 通往楼梯的门已经开了。

lines.en: Beep! Security question. Please answer in English.
lines.zh: 哔！安全问题，请用英语回答。

lines.en: It's my coat.
Look out of the window. Is it cold outside?
lines.zh: 控制台问：看看窗外，外面冷吗？选出正确的回答再说出来。

lines.en: Yes, it's snowing.
Wrong answer. Look out of the window and try again!
lines.zh: 回答错了。看看窗外，再试一次！

lines.en: Shh... Welcome to the top of the tower, little trainer.
lines.zh: 嘘……欢迎来到塔顶，小训练师。

lines.en: Our weather machine uses the Weather Crystal. Snow, snow, all day long.
lines.zh: 我们的天气机用的是天气水晶。雪呀雪，下一整天。

lines.en: Nobody goes out. Nobody talks. Lovely, right?
lines.zh: 谁也不出门，谁也不说话。很美妙吧？

lines.en: Hah! Everyone is hiding at home!
lines.zh: 哈！大家都躲在家里啦！

lines.en: Shh... Let's battle. Quietly.
lines.zh: 嘘……来对战吧，安安静静地。

lines.en: Shh... You are too loud for me.
lines.zh: 嘘……你对我来说太吵了。

lines.en: Cough, cough! My whistle...!
lines.zh: 咳咳！我的口哨……！

lines.en: My turn! I don't talk, I fight!
lines.zh: 轮到我了！我不说话，我只对战！

lines.en: Rumble, rumble! Here comes the storm!
lines.zh: 轰隆隆！暴风雪来啦！

lines.en: Grr! Whisper, let's go!
lines.zh: 可恶！低语，我们走！

lines.en: Whisper and Rumble ran down the stairs.
lines.zh: 低语和闷雷顺着楼梯逃走了。

lines.en: BZZZT! Wrong order! The machine starts again.
lines.zh: 滋滋——！顺序不对！机器重新开始。

lines.en: Remember the radio: sunny, then rainy, then windy.
lines.zh: 想想收音机里的天气预报：先晴天，再下雨，然后刮风。

lines.en: This is the weather machine. The Weather Crystal is inside!
lines.zh: 这就是天气机。天气水晶就在里面！

lines.en: Beep. Snow mode is ON. Press three buttons to turn it off.
lines.zh: 哔。下雪模式开启中。按对三个按钮才能关掉。

lines.en: Sunny, then rainy, then windy!
lines.zh: 大声说出天气预报，把机器关掉！

lines.en: Snow mode... OFF.
lines.zh: 下雪模式……关闭。

lines.en: The machine stopped. The snow is stopping... The sun is coming out!
lines.zh: 机器停了。雪慢慢停了……太阳出来了！

lines.en: {name}! You did it! Look out of the window. The sky is blue!
lines.zh: {name}！你做到了！看看窗外，天空是蓝的！

lines.en: The weather machine is off. It is quiet and sunny now.
lines.zh: 天气机关掉了。现在外面安静又晴朗。

lines.en: Ding dong! Here is the weather report for the Weather Hall.
lines.zh: 叮咚！天气挑战馆的天气预报来了。

lines.en: Turn on the weather switches in the same order. If you are wrong, everything starts again!
lines.zh: 按同样的顺序打开天气开关。按错了就全部重来！

lines.en: All the weather lights are on. Go and see the Isle Master!
lines.zh: 天气灯全亮了，快去见岛主吧！

lines.en: This switch is already on.
lines.zh: 这个开关已经打开了。

lines.en: Sunny, then rainy, then windy. The way to the Isle Master is open!
lines.zh: 晴、雨、风，顺序全对！通往岛主的路打开了！

lines.en: All the switches turned off. Back to the start!
lines.zh: 所有开关都关掉了，回到起点！

lines.en: BZZZT! That is not the order of the forecast!
lines.zh: 滋滋——！这不是天气预报的顺序！

lines.en: Let's make a snowman!
lines.zh: 跟他一起说

lines.en: The sun is out! It's sunny and warm. Let's make a snowman!
lines.zh: 太阳出来了！又晴朗又暖和，我们去堆雪人吧！

lines.en: I'm watching TV at home. It's boring!
lines.zh: 我只能在家看电视，好无聊！

lines.en: It's snowing all day. My mom says I can't play outside.
lines.zh: 雪下了一整天。妈妈说我不能出去玩。

lines.en: Thank you, dear! It's sunny now. I'm going for a walk.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，孩子！现在出太阳了，我要出去散散步。

lines.en: Oh, what a cold day! Come here, dear.
lines.zh: 哎呀，今天真冷！过来呀，孩子。

lines.en: Is it cold outside?
lines.zh: 奶奶问你外面冷不冷。

lines.en: Yes. Take an umbrella with you, and wear a warm coat!
lines.zh: 是呀。带上雨伞，穿件暖和的外套！

lines.en: The snowstorm is too strong! I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 暴风雪太大了！我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: The door is locked. Use the control panel.
lines.zh: 门锁着。去控制台试试。

lines.en: A thick fog covers the old island...
lines.zh: 浓浓的雾笼罩着这座古老的小岛……

lines.en: {name}! You climbed the waterfall! I knew you could do it.
lines.zh: {name}！你爬上瀑布了！我就知道你能行。

lines.en: Listen. I saw Mr. Mute. He went into the Memory Temple with twelve crystals!
lines.zh: 听我说，我看见默先生了。他带着十二颗水晶进了回忆神殿！

lines.en: But first... do you remember our first battle?
lines.zh: 不过先等等……你还记得我们的第一场对战吗？

lines.en: It is Route 1.
We battle on Route 1.
We battled on Route 1.
What did we do on Route 1?
lines.zh: {rival} 问你：我们在 1 号路上做了什么？（用过去时回答）

lines.en: We battled! "Battled" is the past of "battle".
lines.zh: 我们对战了！“battled”是“battle”的过去式。

lines.en: Yes! Let's have one more battle. Then we stop Team Hush together!
lines.zh: 对！我们再比一场，然后一起去阻止嘘声团！

lines.en: I won this time! But today we're a team.
lines.zh: 这次我赢了！不过今天我们是一队的。

lines.en: You're so strong now... I'm happy you are my rival.
lines.zh: 你现在好强……能当你的对手，我很开心。

lines.en: Orion is waiting at the temple door, north of town. Let's go!
lines.zh: 欧瑞在镇子北边的神殿门口等我们。走吧！

lines.en: Let's go together!
lines.zh: 对 {rival} 说：我们一起去吧！

lines.en: {name}, you came. This is the Memory Temple.
lines.zh: {name}，你来了。这里就是回忆神殿。

lines.en: Long ago, people told stories here. They used words about the past.
lines.zh: 很久以前，人们在这里讲故事，用的都是讲过去的词。

lines.en: Mr. Mute is inside. He wants to open the sea door and wake the Hush King.
lines.zh: 默先生就在里面。他想打开海底之门，唤醒寂静之王。

lines.en: This temple only opens for people who remember. So tell me...
lines.zh: 这座神殿只为记得过去的人打开。那么告诉我……

lines.en: I stop the snow machine.
I stopped the snow machine.
It is snowy and cold.
What did you do on Weather Island?
lines.zh: 欧瑞问你在天气岛做了什么。选出用过去时说的句子。

lines.en: We say "I stopped". "Stopped" is the past of "stop".
lines.zh: 要说 “I stopped”。“stopped” 是 “stop” 的过去式。

lines.en: Good. On this island, we talk about the past: went, saw, stopped, learned.
lines.zh: 很好。在这座岛上，我们讲的是过去：went、saw、stopped、learned。

lines.en: Read the old tablets inside. The Memory Door will ask about them.
lines.zh: 好好读里面的古老石板，记忆之门会问上面的内容。

lines.en: Go! {rival} and I will be right behind you.
lines.zh: 去吧！我和 {rival} 马上就跟上。

lines.en: Remember: long ago, people spoke together, and Echodrake woke up.
lines.zh: 记住：很久以前，人们一起说话，回声龙就醒了。

lines.en: The tablets tell an old story. Read all of them.
lines.zh: 石板上讲的是一个古老的故事，每一块都要读。

lines.en: No... Read the tablets again.
lines.zh: 不对……再去读读石板吧。

lines.en: I am the Memory Door. Only people who remember can pass.
lines.zh: 我是记忆之门。只有记得过去的人才能通过。

lines.en: It ate all the sounds.
It eats all the sounds.
It was very happy.
Long ago, what did the Hush King do?
lines.zh: 很久以前，寂静之王做了什么？

lines.en: Then, what did the people do?
lines.zh: 后来，人们做了什么？

lines.en: They speak together.
They spoke together.
They were quiet.
You remember well. You may pass.
lines.zh: 你记得很清楚。请过吧。

lines.en: ...So you came. {name}. {rival}. And Orion.
lines.zh: ……你们来了。{name}，{rival}，还有欧瑞。

lines.en: Look. Twelve crystals. When I drop them into the sea door, the seal will break.
lines.zh: 看，十二颗水晶。只要把它们丢进海底之门，封印就会破掉。

lines.en: Then the Hush King will wake up and eat every sound in the world.
lines.zh: 然后寂静之王就会醒来，吃掉世界上所有的声音。

lines.en: No more shouting. No more laughing at people. A quiet world is a kind world.
lines.zh: 再也没有吵闹，再也没有人嘲笑别人。安静的世界才是温柔的世界。

lines.en: Mute! Words can hurt people. But words can also help people!
lines.zh: 默！话语会伤人，可话语也能帮助人！

lines.en: That's right! We came here to help!
lines.zh: 没错！我们是来帮忙的！

lines.en: Then show me. Show me the power of your words.
lines.zh: 那就让我看看。让我看看你们话语的力量。

lines.en: How... How can words be so strong?
lines.zh: 怎么……话语怎么会这么有力量？

lines.en: Suddenly the water in the sea door starts to shake!
lines.zh: 突然，海底之门里的水剧烈地摇晃起来！

lines.en: The crystals are losing their light...
lines.zh: 水晶的光越来越暗了……

lines.en: The seal is breaking! Echodrake wakes up when many people speak together.
lines.zh: 封印要破了！只要很多人一起说话，回声龙就会醒来。

lines.en: Tell your story! What did you do on your journey? Say it in the past!
lines.zh: 讲讲你的故事！这一路上你做了什么？用过去时说出来！

lines.en: I met Professor Echo.
lines.zh: 讲讲你的旅程：我遇见了回声博士。

lines.en: I battled with {name} on Route 1!
lines.zh: 我在 1 号路上和 {name} 对战过！

lines.en: I helped the lost boy.
lines.zh: 我帮助了走丢的小男孩。

lines.en: I studied old words on many islands.
lines.zh: 我在很多岛上研究过古老的词语。

lines.en: I learned a lot of English.
lines.zh: 我学会了很多英语。

lines.en: Far away, many voices answer. The Isle Masters, Mom, Professor Echo, Kai...
lines.zh: 远方传来许多声音在回应：各岛的岛主、妈妈、回声博士、小凯……

lines.en: The people of thirteen islands are talking together!
lines.zh: 十三座岛的人们都在一起说话！

lines.en: Now, all together!
lines.zh: 现在，大家一起喊！

lines.en: ROOOAAAR!
Echodrake sang a loud, happy song. The crystals are shining again. The sea door is closed!
lines.zh: 回声龙唱起一支响亮又快乐的歌。水晶重新亮了起来，海底之门关上了！

lines.en: We did it! We did it together!
lines.zh: 我们做到了！我们一起做到了！

lines.en: Mr. Mute looks at the crystals. He is quiet for a long time.
lines.zh: 默先生看着水晶，很久很久都没有说话。

lines.en: When I was a boy, I said a wrong word in class.
lines.zh: 我小时候，在课堂上说错了一个词。

lines.en: Everybody laughed at me. So I stopped talking.
lines.zh: 全班都笑我。从那以后，我就不再说话了。

lines.en: I thought: no words, no pain. A quiet world is a kind world.
lines.zh: 我以为：不说话，就不会受伤。安静的世界就是温柔的世界。

lines.en: Be quiet!
It's OK. Everyone makes mistakes.
What do you want to say to Mr. Mute?
lines.zh: 你想对默先生说什么？选一句，大声说出来。

lines.en: You're wrong. Go away!
Hmm. Maybe say something kind: "It's OK. Everyone makes mistakes."
lines.zh: 嗯……也许可以说句温暖的话：“没关系，每个人都会犯错。”

lines.en: ...Everyone makes mistakes...
lines.zh: ……每个人……都会犯错……

lines.en: I... I'm sorry.
lines.zh: 我……对不起。

lines.en: Mr. Mute spoke to people for the first time in many years.
lines.zh: 这是默先生很多年来第一次对别人开口说话。

lines.en: Here are the twelve crystals. Please take them home to every island.
lines.zh: 这是十二颗水晶。请把它们送回每一座岛。

lines.en: And... thank you for talking to me.
lines.zh: 还有……谢谢你们愿意跟我说话。

lines.en: Words can hurt, but kind words can heal. You showed him that, {name}.
lines.zh: 话语会伤人，但温暖的话能治愈人。{name}，是你让他明白了这一点。

lines.en: I'll go to the Brave Road first. See you there. I'll be stronger!
lines.zh: 我先去勇气之路了。那里见，我会变得更强！

lines.en: Echodrake is looking at you. It wants to test your voice. Talk to it when you are ready.
lines.zh: 回声龙在看着你，它想试试你的声音。准备好了就去和它说话吧。

lines.en: And the Memory Hall is open now. The Memory Dragon is waiting.
lines.zh: 回忆挑战馆现在也开门了，回忆巨龙在等你。

lines.en: Rumble... The stone wall above the cards is gone!
lines.zh: 轰隆隆……这组牌上面的石墙消失了！

lines.en: All the pairs are found! The way to the Isle Master is open.
lines.zh: 所有的牌都配对了！通往岛主的路打开了。

lines.en: Not a pair. The cards turn over again.
lines.zh: 不是一对，两张牌又翻回去了。

lines.en: A stone pillar: "Yesterday I went to the farm. I saw many cows."
lines.zh: 石柱：“昨天我去了农场，看见了很多奶牛。”

lines.en: A stone pillar: "Last weekend we went to the beach. It was fun!"
lines.zh: 石柱：“上周末我们去了海滩，真好玩！”

lines.en: {name}! I knew you would come this way.
lines.zh: {name}！我就知道你会走这条路。

lines.en: Do you remember Crayon Island? I was the shy boy. I could not even say hello.
lines.zh: 还记得彩色文具岛吗？我就是那个害羞的男孩，连“你好”都说不出口。

lines.en: You helped me catch my first monster. And you told me something.
lines.zh: 你帮我抓到了第一只怪兽，还对我说了一句话。

lines.en: Do you remember? What did you say to me?
lines.zh: 小凯问你：还记得你当时对他说了什么吗？

lines.en: I am Kai.
I said, "Speak loudly!"
I say, "Speak loudly!"
You said, "Speak loudly! Your monster will hear you."
lines.zh: 你说：“大声说！你的怪兽会听见的。”

lines.en: Yes! "Speak loudly. Your monster will hear you." I never forgot it.
lines.zh: 对！“大声说，你的怪兽会听见的。”我一直都记得。

lines.en: Now I speak loudly every day. My monsters and I got very strong.
lines.zh: 现在我每天都大声说话。我和我的怪兽都变得很强了。

lines.en: This is our last battle before the English Cup. Please give me everything you have!
lines.zh: 这是冠军赛前我们最后一战。请拿出你全部的本事吧！

lines.en: I won? Wow... But don't give up! Let me heal your team. Try again!
lines.zh: 我赢了？哇……不过别放弃！我帮你的队伍恢复一下，再来！

lines.en: ...I lost. But I am not sad at all.
lines.zh: ……我输了。可我一点也不难过。

lines.en: When I met you, I was a boy with no friends and no voice.
lines.zh: 遇见你的时候，我是个没有朋友、也不敢出声的男孩。

lines.en: Now I have friends. I have monsters. And I have my voice.
lines.zh: 现在我有朋友，有怪兽，也有了自己的声音。

lines.en: Thank you, {name}. You changed my life.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，{name}。是你改变了我。

lines.en: Goodbye forever.
I am the best trainer.
Thank you, Kai. You are my best friend.
What do you want to say to Kai?
lines.zh: 你想对小凯说什么？

lines.en: Best friends... I like that. Now go! Become the English Champion!
lines.zh: 最好的朋友……我喜欢这句话。去吧！去当英语冠军！

lines.en: I'll be cheering for you. Speak loudly!
lines.zh: 我会为你加油的。大声说出来！

lines.en: I will do my best!
lines.zh: 对小凯说：我会全力以赴的！

lines.en: Welcome, traveller. On Memory Island, we remember every day.
lines.zh: 欢迎你，旅行者。在回忆岛，我们记住每一天。

lines.en: I go to the museum.
I went to the museum.
It was yesterday.
What did you do yesterday?
lines.zh: 僧人问你昨天做了什么。选出用过去时说的句子。

lines.en: Good. Every day is a day to remember.
lines.zh: 很好。每一天都值得记住。

lines.en: Mr. Mute is at the Memory Temple! I cannot battle now.
lines.zh: 默先生就在回忆神殿里！我现在没心思对战。

lines.en: Aurorakit's tail glows green and purple at night. It loves cold, clear skies.
lines.zh: 极光小兔的尾巴在夜里发出绿色和紫色的光，它喜欢寒冷晴朗的天空。

lines.en: Bigtooth has two very strong front teeth. It can cut wood.
lines.zh: 巨齿鼠有两颗很结实的门牙，能咬断木头。

lines.en: Boltkite flies before a storm comes. Its feathers make little sparks.
lines.zh: 电风筝总在暴风雨来之前飞起来，它的羽毛会冒出小火花。

lines.en: Brookrunner runs along rivers. It digs homes in the soft mud.
lines.zh: 溪流螈沿着河边奔跑。它在软泥里挖洞做家。

lines.en: Bulbling glows when it is happy. It sleeps in lamps during the day.
lines.zh: 灯泡仔开心时会发光，白天就睡在灯里。

lines.en: Cometdragon can fly from Earth to the moon. Its wings shine like stars.
lines.zh: 彗星巨龙能从地球飞到月亮。它的翅膀像星星一样闪耀。

lines.en: Cometdrake flies around mountains in circles. It trains every day to reach space.
lines.zh: 彗星龙绕着山峰转圈飞。它每天训练，想要飞上太空。

lines.en: Echobat shouts in dark caves. It listens to the echo to find its way.
lines.zh: 回声蝠在黑暗的山洞里大喊，靠听回声来找路。

lines.en: Echowing can copy any voice it hears. It repeats your words back to you.
lines.zh: 回响翼能模仿听到的任何声音，它会把你的话再说一遍给你听。

lines.en: Flamewolf howls on the mountain top. Its voice is very loud.
lines.zh: 炎狼王在山顶上嚎叫，声音非常响亮。

lines.en: Its coat changes color with every season. A special stone helps it grow.
lines.zh: 小季鹿的毛色随季节变化。一块特别的石头能帮它长大。

lines.en: Kelplet dances slowly with the waves. Small fish hide in its leaves.
lines.zh: 海藻宝随着海浪慢慢跳舞，小鱼会躲在它的叶子里。

lines.en: Lampkit's tail glows like a little lamp. It lights the way home at night.
lines.zh: 灯笼崽的尾巴像一盏小灯，晚上为人照亮回家的路。

lines.en: Magmaheart sleeps deep inside a volcano. When it wakes, new islands appear.
lines.zh: 熔岩之心睡在火山深处。它醒来时，就会出现新的小岛。

lines.en: Museumowl lives in old museums. It knows the story of every object.
lines.zh: 博物馆鸮住在古老的博物馆里。它知道每件展品的故事。

lines.en: Peeplet says peep peep every morning. It wakes up the town.
lines.zh: 啾啾雀每天早上啾啾叫，把全镇都叫醒。

lines.en: Plugpup likes to sleep next to phone chargers. Its tail is a plug.
lines.zh: 插头狗喜欢睡在手机充电器旁边，它的尾巴是一个插头。

lines.en: Polarcub rolls down snowy hills for fun. Cold wind never bothers it.
lines.zh: 极地熊仔喜欢从雪坡上滚下来玩。冷风从来不会让它难受。

lines.en: Proudshell is not shy anymore. It shows its shiny shell to everyone.
lines.zh: 自信贝不再害羞了，它把闪亮的壳展示给每个人看。

lines.en: Radarwing finds lost ships at sea. Pilots are happy to see it.
lines.zh: 雷达翼能找到海上迷路的船。飞行员看到它都很高兴。

lines.en: Radiohound can hear radio signals. It barks when a storm is coming.
lines.zh: 无线电犬能听到无线电信号。暴风雨快来时它会叫。

lines.en: Raincrane dances in the rain. The cloud on its head tells the weather.
lines.zh: 雨鹤喜欢在雨里跳舞，它头上的云朵能预报天气。

lines.en: Rivershark swims fast in deep rivers. Its teeth are very sharp.
lines.zh: 河鲨在深深的河里游得很快，牙齿非常锋利。

lines.en: Snowhoot sleeps in a snow cave all winter. It hoots softly when snow falls.
lines.zh: 雪咕咕整个冬天都睡在雪洞里，下雪的时候会轻轻地咕咕叫。

lines.en: Songwing sings beautiful songs. Other birds follow it.
lines.zh: 歌翅鸟会唱好听的歌，别的鸟都跟着它。

lines.en: Sunfan opens its round tail like a fan. It loves warm, sunny mornings.
lines.zh: 日扇雀会像扇子一样打开圆圆的尾巴，它最喜欢暖洋洋的早晨。

lines.en: Sunpainter paints with warm light. Its pictures make people smile.
lines.zh: 日光画师用温暖的阳光画画。它的画让人们微笑。

lines.en: Thunderwing flies very fast. Its wings shine in storms.
lines.zh: 雷翼飞得很快，暴风雨里它的翅膀会发光。

lines.en: When Aurorahare jumps, lights fill the night sky. People travel far to see it.
lines.zh: 极光兔一跳，夜空就布满光芒。人们从很远的地方赶来看它。

lines.en: Bookworm lives in libraries. It reads a book every day.
lines.zh: 书虫虫住在图书馆里，每天读一本书。

lines.en: Cindercat sleeps near warm fires. Its tail is a small flame.
lines.zh: 火花猫喜欢蜷在暖暖的火边睡觉，尾巴是一小团火。

lines.en: Pyrolynx runs over hot rocks. Fire comes out of its paws.
lines.zh: 炎山猫在滚烫的岩石上奔跑，爪子里会冒出火焰。

lines.en: Drizzle comes out on rainy days. It dances in the puddles.
lines.zh: 雨滴精下雨天才出来，在水坑里跳舞。

lines.en: Torrent flies over rivers with water wings. It brings heavy rain.
lines.zh: 激流精扇着水做的翅膀飞过河面，会带来大雨。

lines.en: Dustmole digs little holes in the grass. It cannot see well.
lines.zh: 尘土鼹在草地上挖小洞，它的视力不太好。

lines.en: Tunneler digs long tunnels under hills. Its hands are very strong.
lines.zh: 挖洞鼹在山丘底下挖长长的隧道，双手非常有力。

lines.en: Hissy says hiss when it is scared. It hides under leaves.
lines.zh: 嘶嘶蛇害怕时会发出嘶嘶声，它藏在叶子下面。

lines.en: Fangsnake watches you from the trees. It moves without a sound.
lines.zh: 毒牙蛇在树上盯着你，走动时一点声音也没有。

lines.en: Kitefish jumps out of the sea and rides the wind. It flies like a kite.
lines.zh: 风筝鱼跳出海面乘着风飞，像风筝一样。

lines.en: Stormkite flies in strong winds. It brings rain to dry places.
lines.zh: 暴风筝鱼在大风里飞翔，它会给干旱的地方带来雨水。

lines.en: Lampy lights up dark rooms. Kids read books with its light.
lines.zh: 小台灯能照亮黑黑的房间，孩子们借着它的光看书。

lines.en: Streetlamp stands on dark roads. It helps people walk home safely.
lines.zh: 路灯卫士站在黑黑的马路边，帮大家安全走回家。

lines.en: Lavalet is a hot little ball of lava. Do not touch it!
lines.zh: 小熔岩是一团热热的岩浆，千万别摸它！

lines.en: Lavarock walks slowly out of volcanoes. The ground gets hot under it.
lines.zh: 熔岩石从火山里慢慢走出来，脚下的地面都变烫了。

lines.en: Magmaking sleeps inside a volcano. When it wakes up, the mountain shakes.
lines.zh: 岩浆王睡在火山里，它一醒来，整座山都在摇。

lines.en: Mistlet floats on foggy mornings. It likes to play hide-and-seek.
lines.zh: 雾灵灵在有雾的早上飘来飘去，喜欢玩捉迷藏。

lines.en: Fogshade makes thick fog. Then it laughs and disappears.
lines.zh: 迷雾影会造出浓浓的雾，然后笑着消失不见。

lines.en: Mosstone sits still for years. Soft green moss grows on it.
lines.zh: 青苔石一动不动地坐好多年，身上长满了软软的绿苔藓。

lines.en: Stonegarden has a garden on its back. Bees come to visit every day.
lines.zh: 石头花园背上有一座花园，蜜蜂每天都来拜访。

lines.en: Pebblet looks like a round stone. It likes to roll down hills.
lines.zh: 小石子看起来像一块圆石头，喜欢从山坡上滚下来。

lines.en: Gemrock has shiny gems on its back. It eats small stones.
