lines.zh: 宝石岩背上有闪亮的宝石，它吃小石子。

lines.en: Gemgiant is as tall as a house. Its gems can read your mind.
lines.zh: 宝石巨人和房子一样高，它的宝石能读懂你的心思。

lines.en: Pillbug rolls into a ball. Then nothing can hurt it.
lines.zh: 滚球虫会缩成一个球，这样谁也伤不到它。

lines.en: Puffball lets out purple smoke. The smoke makes you sleepy.
lines.zh: 噗噗菇会喷出紫色的烟，闻了就想睡觉。

lines.en: Shellbit lives in an old shell. It looks for a bigger one.
lines.zh: 小壳蟹住在旧贝壳里，它一直在找更大的贝壳。

lines.en: Pearlclaw keeps a pearl in its big claw. It never drops it.
lines.zh: 珍珠钳把一颗珍珠夹在大钳子里，从来不会弄掉。

lines.en: Coralcastle carries a coral castle on its back. Small fish live inside.
lines.zh: 珊瑚城堡背着一座珊瑚城堡，小鱼们住在里面。

lines.en: Songlet sings every morning. Its song wakes up the town.
lines.zh: 歌歌鸟每天早上唱歌，它的歌声会叫醒整个小镇。

lines.en: Songhawk sings loudly as it flies. Other birds follow its song.
lines.zh: 高歌鹰一边飞一边大声唱歌，别的鸟都跟着它的歌声飞。

lines.en: Splashy jumps out of the river. It loves to play.
lines.zh: 水花鱼会跳出河面，它很爱玩。

lines.en: Stonebud rolls down hills for fun. It sleeps in small holes.
lines.zh: 小石团喜欢从山坡上滚下来玩，睡在小洞里。

lines.en: Stonefist punches big rocks. Its hands are very hard.
lines.zh: 石拳侠会用拳头打大石头，它的手非常硬。

lines.en: Cliffgiant is as tall as a house. It walks very slowly.
lines.zh: 峭壁巨人和房子一样高，走路非常慢。

lines.en: Waggy wags its tail all the time. It loves new friends.
lines.zh: 摇摇狗总是摇尾巴，它最喜欢交新朋友。

lines.en: Watchdog guards houses at night. It barks at strangers.
lines.zh: 看门犬晚上守着房子，看到陌生人就叫。

lines.en: Duskbat wakes up when the sun goes down. It sleeps upside down.
lines.zh: 黄昏蝠在太阳下山时醒来，它倒挂着睡觉。

lines.en: Nightglider flies without a sound. You cannot see it at night.
lines.zh: 夜翔蝠飞起来一点声音都没有，夜里根本看不见它。

lines.en: Firefly lights up the forest at night. Its tail glows orange.
lines.zh: 萤火虫夜里把森林照亮，它的尾巴发出橙色的光。

lines.en: Inkfish shoots black ink and swims away. Then it hides in rocks.
lines.zh: 墨墨鱼喷出黑墨水就游走，然后躲进石头里。

lines.en: Nightsquid swims in the deep sea. Its spots glow like stars.
lines.zh: 夜光乌贼在深海里游，身上的斑点像星星一样发光。

lines.en: Nibbler eats seeds and bread. It is never full.
lines.zh: 啃啃鼠吃种子和面包，它永远吃不饱。

lines.en: Owlet stays up all night. Its big eyes can see in the dark.
lines.zh: 小智枭整夜不睡，大眼睛在黑暗中也能看见。

lines.en: Wiseowl knows many words. It helps lost children find their way home.
lines.zh: 智慧枭懂得很多词，会帮迷路的孩子找到回家的路。

lines.en: Pinchy walks sideways on the beach. Be careful of its claws!
lines.zh: 夹夹蟹在沙滩上横着走，小心它的钳子！

lines.en: Pricklet lives in dry places. It drinks very little water.
lines.zh: 小仙刺住在干燥的地方，只喝一点点水。

lines.en: Punchy is a young kangaroo. It practices punching every day.
lines.zh: 出拳仔是一只小袋鼠，每天都练习出拳。

lines.en: Boxer wears big red gloves. It never gives up.
lines.zh: 拳击手戴着大大的红手套，它从不放弃。

lines.en: Blackbelt trains on high mountains. It can break big rocks.
lines.zh: 黑带王在高山上修炼，能打碎大石头。

lines.en: Snowbun hops in the snow. Its thick fur keeps it warm.
lines.zh: 雪兔兔在雪地里蹦蹦跳跳，厚厚的毛让它很暖和。

lines.en: Icehare runs over frozen lakes. Its feet never slip.
lines.zh: 冰原兔在结冰的湖上奔跑，脚从来不打滑。

lines.en: Zappy keeps a tiny light bulb on its tail. It stuffs seeds into its cheeks.
lines.zh: 亮亮仓鼠的尾巴上挂着一个小灯泡，它爱把种子塞满两个腮帮子。

lines.en: Bulbster wears a fluffy white collar. Its bulb tail lights up dark rooms.
lines.zh: 大灯仓鼠围着一圈毛茸茸的白领子，灯泡尾巴能照亮黑黑的房间。

lines.en: Coralslug has very bright colors. The colors tell fish to stay away.
lines.zh: 珊瑚虫颜色非常鲜艳，这些颜色在告诉鱼儿离它远点。

lines.en: Reefqueen swims like a long ribbon. Other sea monsters make way for her.
lines.zh: 珊瑚女王游起来像一条长丝带，别的海怪都给她让路。

lines.en: Nightkit walks on roofs without a sound. Its yellow eyes shine.
lines.zh: 夜小猫在屋顶上走路一点声音都没有，它的黄眼睛闪闪发亮。

lines.en: Nightpanther runs faster than a car. You only see its eyes.
lines.zh: 夜影豹跑得比汽车还快，你只能看到它的眼睛。

lines.en: Rulersnake lies down straight to measure things. It is always right.
lines.zh: 尺子蛇直直地躺下来帮你量东西，它从来不会量错。

lines.en: Starbug has a yellow star on its back. It glows in the dark.
lines.zh: 星星虫背上有一颗黄色的星星，在黑暗中会发光。

lines.en: Nightmoth flies to bright lights. Its wings shine like the night sky.
lines.zh: 夜光蛾会飞向明亮的灯光，它的翅膀像夜空一样闪亮。

lines.en: Stinkbug makes a bad smell when it is scared. Everyone runs away!
lines.zh: 臭臭虫害怕时会放出臭味，大家都跑开了！

lines.en: Swampfrog sits in mud all day. Its purple spots are poison.
lines.zh: 沼泽蛙整天坐在泥巴里，它身上的紫色斑点有毒。

lines.en: Twigling looks like a small stick. Birds cannot find it.
lines.zh: 小枝虫看起来像一根小树枝，鸟儿都找不到它。

lines.en: Barkbug hides inside hard bark. It sleeps all day and grows.
lines.zh: 树皮虫躲在硬硬的树皮里，整天睡觉，慢慢长大。

lines.en: Leafmoth has wings like big green leaves. It flies at night.
lines.zh: 叶翅蛾的翅膀像大大的绿叶子，它在夜里飞。

lines.en: Anchorjaw holds boats still with its strong jaw. It is very heavy.
lines.zh: 铁锚鲨用有力的嘴巴把船稳稳拉住，它非常重。

lines.en: Buzzbee makes a loud buzzing sound. Its body has a little electricity.
lines.zh: 雷蜂会发出很响的嗡嗡声，身体里有一点点电。

lines.en: Cloudsheep floats in the sky. Its wool is soft like a cloud.
lines.zh: 云朵羊飘在天上，它的毛像云一样软。

lines.en: Mirrorghost lives in old mirrors. It copies your face and smiles.
lines.zh: 镜子幽灵住在旧镜子里，它会学你的样子然后笑。

lines.en: Moonbunny jumps very high on moon nights. It loves rice cakes.
lines.zh: 月亮兔在有月亮的晚上跳得特别高，它最爱吃年糕。

lines.en: Nightpaw has a black mask on its face. It takes food from bins.
lines.zh: 夜爪狸脸上像戴着黑面具，会从垃圾桶里拿吃的。

lines.en: Wirewolf runs along power lines at night. Its eyes flash blue.
lines.zh: 电线狼晚上沿着电线奔跑，它的眼睛会闪蓝光。

lines.en: Seedlet sleeps in the soil. It wakes up when the sun comes out.
lines.zh: 小种子睡在土里，太阳出来它就醒了。

lines.en: Petalpal shares its sweet smell with friends. Bees love it.
lines.zh: 花瓣仔把香香的味道分给朋友，蜜蜂很喜欢它。

lines.en: Rosequeen dances in the garden. Her roses can calm angry people.
lines.zh: 玫瑰女王在花园里跳舞，她的玫瑰能让生气的人平静下来。

lines.en: Thornknight protects the forest. Its arms have sharp thorns.
lines.zh: 荆棘骑士保护着森林，它的手臂上长着尖刺。

lines.en: Sparkjelly glows in the dark sea. Its long arms give small shocks.
lines.zh: 电水母在黑暗的海里发光，长长的触手会放出小电流。

lines.en: Stingray hides under the sand. Do not step on its tail!
lines.zh: 毒刺魟藏在沙子下面，别踩到它的尾巴！

lines.en: Dreamlet sleeps all day. It can see your dreams.
lines.zh: 梦梦团整天都在睡觉，它能看到你的梦。

lines.en: Mindfox moves small things with its mind. It likes puzzles.
lines.zh: 心灵狐能用意念移动小东西，它喜欢玩拼图。

lines.en: Moonfox only comes out on full moon nights. Its tail shines like silver.
lines.zh: 月光狐只在满月的夜晚出来，它的尾巴像银子一样发亮。

lines.en: Ironpup is made of hard metal. It likes to guard houses.
lines.zh: 小铁狗是用坚硬的金属做的，它喜欢看家。

lines.en: Ironguard stands at gates all night. Nothing gets past it.
lines.zh: 铁卫犬整夜守在大门口，什么都别想溜过去。

lines.en: Mossbear naps in the forest. Soft moss grows on its back.
lines.zh: 苔藓熊在森林里打盹，软软的苔藓长在它背上。

lines.en: Oakbear is as strong as an old tree. It is kind to small monsters.
lines.zh: 橡树熊像老橡树一样强壮，对小怪兽很温柔。

lines.en: Scaly is a baby dragon. It chews on everything it finds.
lines.zh: 小鳞龙是一只龙宝宝，找到什么都要咬一咬。

lines.en: Spikescale has sharp spikes on its back. It trains in deep caves.
lines.zh: 刺鳞龙背上长满尖刺，在深深的洞穴里修炼。

lines.en: Skydragon can fly around the world in one day. People rarely see it.
lines.zh: 天空龙一天就能绕世界飞一圈，人们很少见到它。

lines.en: Shadowlet hides in your shadow. It jumps out and says boo!
lines.zh: 影团子躲在你的影子里，会突然跳出来说“嘣！”

lines.en: Nightcloak looks like a flying cape. It floats over roofs at night.
lines.zh: 夜斗篷看起来像一件会飞的披风，晚上在屋顶上飘来飘去。

lines.en: Grinmask is a mask with two horns. It has a very big grin. It plays tricks at night.
lines.zh: 笑面王是一张长着两只角的面具，总是咧着大嘴笑，喜欢在夜里恶作剧。

lines.en: Tadpole swims with its long tail. One day it grows legs.
lines.zh: 小蝌蚪甩着长尾巴游泳，有一天它会长出腿。

lines.en: Hopfrog can jump very high. It sings after the rain.
lines.zh: 跳跳蛙能跳得很高，下过雨它就唱歌。

lines.en: Chilly is a little penguin. It slides on its belly for fun.
lines.zh: 滑冰鹅是一只小企鹅，喜欢用肚皮滑着玩。

lines.en: Glacier is the king of cold seas. It swims under the ice.
lines.zh: 冰川皇是寒冷大海的王者，能在冰下游泳。

lines.en: Drumpaw hits its belly like a drum. Boom, boom, boom!
lines.zh: 鼓鼓掌把肚子当鼓来敲，咚、咚、咚！

lines.en: Drumbear plays drums on trees. You can hear it far away.
lines.zh: 战鼓熊在树上敲鼓，很远都能听到。

lines.en: Gemmy has a small gem on its head. A special stone changes its color.
lines.zh: 宝石团头上有一颗小宝石，特别的石头能改变它的颜色。

lines.en: Crystalhorn has a clear ice horn. It never melts.
lines.zh: 冰晶角有一只透明的冰角，永远不会融化。

lines.en: Jadehorn has a green jade horn. Flowers grow where it sleeps.
lines.zh: 翠玉角有一只绿玉角，它睡过的地方会开出花来。

lines.en: Rubyhorn has a red gem horn. The horn is warm like fire.
lines.zh: 红宝角有一只红宝石角，摸起来像火一样暖。

lines.en: Harpfin plays music with its long fins. Sailors love its songs.
lines.zh: 竖琴鱼用长长的鳍弹奏音乐，水手们都爱听它的歌。

lines.en: Mudpie looks like a cake made of mud. Please do not eat it!
lines.zh: 泥饼饼看起来像泥做的蛋糕，千万别吃它！

lines.en: Clayknight guards old towns. It fixes its body with fresh mud.
lines.zh: 陶土骑士守护着古老的小镇，它用新鲜的泥巴修补身体。

lines.en: Stormhawk flies above the clouds. It is not afraid of strong wind.
lines.zh: 风暴鹰在云上飞，它一点也不怕大风。

lines.en: Ironshell has a shell of hard metal. It walks very slowly.
lines.zh: 铁壳龟有一层坚硬的金属壳，走得非常慢。

lines.en: Seadragon looks like floating seaweed. It dances slowly in the water.
lines.zh: 海藻龙看起来像漂浮的海草，在水里慢慢地跳舞。

lines.en: Fossilet lived in the sea long ago. People found it in an old stone.
lines.zh: 化石虫很久以前住在海里，人们在一块古老的石头里发现了它。

lines.en: Fossilclaw is millions of years old. Its claws can cut through rock.
lines.zh: 化石巨钳已经有几百万岁了，它的钳子能切开岩石。

lines.en: Frostdeer walks on snowy mountains. Snow falls when it sings.
lines.zh: 霜雪鹿在雪山上行走，它一唱歌就下雪。

lines.en: Ghostship sails on foggy nights. It looks for its lost captain.
lines.zh: 幽灵船在起雾的夜晚航行，寻找它走丢的船长。

lines.en: Kickball loves football games. It kicks itself into the goal!
lines.zh: 踢踢球最爱踢足球，它会把自己踢进球门！

lines.en: Dreamwhale sings at night. Sailors who hear it have sweet dreams.
lines.zh: 梦境鲸在夜里唱歌，听到歌声的水手都会做美梦。

lines.en: Tinbug makes a small ding when it walks. It eats old nails.
lines.zh: 小铁虫走路时会发出叮叮声，它吃旧铁钉。

lines.en: Tinbeetle has a hard metal back. Rain does not hurt it.
lines.zh: 铁皮甲虫的背是坚硬的金属，雨水伤不了它。

lines.en: Ironhorn can lift a car with its horn. It helps build bridges.
lines.zh: 钢角王能用角举起一辆汽车，它会帮忙造桥。

lines.en: Moonraven collects shiny things. It hides them in its nest.
lines.zh: 月夜鸦喜欢收集亮晶晶的东西，把它们藏在窝里。

lines.en: Schoolbell rings when class begins. Students run to their seats.
lines.zh: 校铃铛在上课时响起，同学们都跑回座位。

lines.en: Swordfish has a long nose like a sword. It is the fastest fish.
lines.zh: 剑鱼的鼻子像一把长剑，它是游得最快的鱼。

lines.en: Echobell rings in old ruins. Its sound comes back again and again.
lines.zh: 回声铃在古老的遗迹里响，声音一遍又一遍地回荡。

lines.en: Emberpup has a little fire on its tail. It is warm to hug.
lines.zh: 火苗狗的尾巴上有一小团火。抱起来暖暖的。

lines.en: Blazehound runs very fast. Its mane burns like the sun.
lines.zh: 烈焰犬跑得飞快，它的鬃毛像太阳一样燃烧。

lines.en: Sunlizard lies on hot rocks all day. The sun gives it power.
lines.zh: 太阳蜥整天趴在热石头上，太阳给它力量。

lines.en: Bubbly blows bubbles when it is happy. It sings in the rain.
lines.zh: 泡泡鱼开心的时候会吹泡泡，下雨时还会唱歌。

lines.en: Tidalfin swims with the tide. It can jump over big waves.
lines.zh: 潮汐鳍跟着潮水游泳，能跳过很大的浪。

lines.en: Waveking rules the deep sea. Ships stop when it sings.
lines.zh: 浪涛王统治着深海。它一唱歌，船都会停下来。

lines.en: Sprouty loves sunny days. The leaf on its head grows a little every day.
lines.zh: 小芽芽最喜欢晴天。它头上的叶子每天都会长大一点点。

lines.en: A flower blooms on its tail. It smells sweet in spring.
lines.zh: 它的尾巴上开着一朵花，春天的时候香香的。

lines.en: Groveguard protects the old forest. Trees grow where it walks.
lines.zh: 林守兽守护着古老的森林。它走过的地方会长出大树。

lines.en: Crystalowl watches the snow at night. Its eyes see very far.
lines.zh: 冰晶鸟晚上看着雪地，它的眼睛能看得很远。

lines.en: Snowball rolls in the snow and gets bigger. Kids love to play with it.
lines.zh: 雪球球在雪地里滚来滚去就会变大，孩子们都爱和它玩。

lines.en: Iceskater spins on frozen lakes. It never falls down.
lines.zh: 滑冰舞者在结冰的湖上转圈，从来不会摔倒。

lines.en: Shuttlebird flies over the net very fast. It loves badminton games.
lines.zh: 羽球鸟飞过球网非常快，它最爱打羽毛球。

lines.en: Moonrabbit comes out when the moon is full. It loves mooncakes.
lines.zh: 月亮兔在月圆之夜出现，最爱吃月饼。

lines.en: Starstone fell from the sky long ago. It shines on clear nights.
lines.zh: 星星石很久以前从天上掉下来，晴朗的夜晚会发光。

lines.en: Scalepup is very rare. Its blue scales are as hard as stone.
lines.zh: 鳞鳞龙非常少见，它蓝色的鳞片像石头一样硬。

lines.en: Scalehorn trains on high mountains. It dreams of flying one day.
lines.zh: 鳞角龙在高山上训练，梦想着有一天能飞起来。

lines.en: Stardragon flies higher than the clouds. Its wings shine like stars.
lines.zh: 星辰龙飞得比云还高，它的翅膀像星星一样闪亮。

lines.en: Steelhorn has a horn of hard steel. It can push over a wall.
lines.zh: 钢角犀有一只坚硬的钢角，能把墙推倒。

lines.en: Lullaby jumps over the moon every night. Count its jumps, and you fall asleep.
lines.zh: 摇篮灵每天夜里从月亮上跳过去。数着它跳了几下，你就睡着了。

lines.en: Lotuscat naps on a soft cloud above the lotus pond. It floats wherever the wind goes.
lines.zh: 莲花猫躺在荷花池上空的软云朵里睡午觉，风吹到哪儿，它就飘到哪儿。

lines.en: Cakelet smells like sweet cake. It appears at birthday parties.
lines.zh: 蛋糕宝闻起来像甜甜的蛋糕，常在生日派对上出现。

lines.en: Creamcake makes people smile. Its cream tastes different every day.
lines.zh: 奶油糕能让人开心。它的奶油每天都是不同的味道。

lines.en: Cakecastle is as big as a house. Small cake monsters live inside it.
lines.zh: 蛋糕城堡像房子一样大，小蛋糕怪兽们都住在里面。

lines.en: Citycat knows every street in town. Ask it the way when you are lost.
lines.zh: 街巷猫认得城里每一条街。迷路时可以问它怎么走。

lines.en: Crumbmouse eats bread crumbs in the park. It is small but very fast.
lines.zh: 碎屑鼠在公园里吃面包屑。它个子小，跑得却很快。

lines.en: Picnicmouse carries a basket of food. It shares lunch with its friends.
lines.zh: 野餐鼠提着一篮子食物，会和朋友们分享午餐。

lines.en: Milkcalf drinks lots of milk. It likes to play in green fields.
lines.zh: 奶牛犊喝很多牛奶，喜欢在绿油油的田野里玩。

lines.en: Barnbull pulls heavy carts on the farm. It works hard all year.
lines.zh: 谷仓牛在农场上拉很重的车，一年到头都很勤劳。

lines.en: Autumndeer looks at the full moon in autumn. Its eyes can see the future.
lines.zh: 秋月鹿在秋天看着满月，它的眼睛能看见未来。

lines.en: Flowers open wherever Springdeer walks. It brings spring to cold forests.
lines.zh: 春芽鹿走到哪里，哪里就开花。它把春天带进寒冷的森林。

lines.en: Summerdeer runs across hot fields. Its antlers are warm like summer sun.
lines.zh: 夏阳鹿在炎热的田野上奔跑，它的鹿角像夏天的太阳一样暖。

lines.en: Snow falls quietly when Winterdeer walks by. It sleeps in snowy forests.
lines.zh: 冬雪鹿经过时，雪花静静地飘落。它睡在积雪的森林里。

lines.en: Woolpuff is soft like a cloud. Farm kids hug it on cold days.
lines.zh: 羊毛球像云朵一样软，农场的孩子冷天会抱着它。

lines.en: Woolhorn has big round horns. Its warm wool makes nice winter hats.
lines.zh: 卷角羊长着又大又圆的角，它的羊毛能织成暖和的冬帽。

lines.en: Dancelion dances at the Spring Festival. It brings good luck for the new year.
lines.zh: 舞狮兽在春节表演舞蹈，给新的一年带来好运。

lines.en: Hotpot is always warm and bubbly. Friends sit around it in winter.
lines.zh: 火锅怪总是热乎乎、咕嘟咕嘟冒泡，冬天朋友们会围着它坐。

lines.en: Lanternfox carries a red lantern at festivals. Children follow it in the street.
lines.zh: 灯笼狐在节日里提着红灯笼，孩子们在街上跟着它走。

lines.en: Fireworkfox jumps into the sky and bursts into colors. Everyone cheers at New Year.
lines.zh: 烟花狐跳上天空，炸开满天色彩。过新年时大家都为它欢呼。

lines.en: Pepperpop is very hot. Do not put it in your mouth!
lines.zh: 辣椒爆辣得不得了，千万别放进嘴里！

lines.en: Skyballoon carries travelers over mountains. Hot air keeps it up in the sky.
lines.zh: 热气球怪载着旅客飞过群山，热空气让它一直飘在空中。

lines.en: Dewdrop rests on grass in the morning. It hides when the sun gets hot.
lines.zh: 露珠仔早上停在草叶上，太阳变热时就躲起来。

lines.en: Dewfairy gives water to thirsty flowers. Its wings shine like rainbows.
lines.zh: 露仙子给口渴的花儿喂水，它的翅膀像彩虹一样闪亮。

lines.en: Ferryshell carries people across the river on its back. It swims very slowly.
lines.zh: 渡船龟用背驮着人们过河，它游得很慢很慢。

lines.en: Pondlet swims under lotus leaves. It blows little bubbles for fun.
lines.zh: 池塘仔在荷叶下游来游去，喜欢吹小泡泡玩。

lines.en: A pink lotus grows on Lotusfin's head. It opens in summer.
lines.zh: 荷鳍鱼头上长着一朵粉色的荷花，夏天就会开放。

lines.en: Puddleling loves rainy days. It jumps in every puddle on the road.
lines.zh: 水洼仔最爱下雨天，路上每个水坑它都要跳一跳。

lines.en: Rainotter can call a small rain cloud. It waters the farms in summer.
lines.zh: 雨水獭能叫来一小朵雨云，夏天帮农田浇水。

lines.en: When Stormotter is angry, the sky turns dark. Its tail shoots bright lightning.
lines.zh: 风暴獭一生气，天空就变黑。它的尾巴能射出明亮的闪电。

lines.en: Maplefrog's leaf turns red in autumn. It sings by the pond after rain.
lines.zh: 枫叶蛙头上的叶子秋天会变红，下过雨后它在池塘边唱歌。

lines.en: Pollenpuff floats in the spring air. Bees like to follow it.
lines.zh: 花粉团在春天的空气里飘，蜜蜂喜欢跟着它。

lines.en: Blossomkite drops pink petals from the sky. Every town it visits turns pink.
lines.zh: 花瓣鸢从天上撒下粉色花瓣，它飞过的小镇都会变成粉色。

lines.en: Strawhat stands in rice fields all summer. It waves to keep birds away.
lines.zh: 草帽人整个夏天都站在稻田里，挥手把鸟儿赶走。

lines.en: Sunseed sits in the sun all day. Sunshine is its lunch.
lines.zh: 阳光籽整天坐在太阳底下，阳光就是它的午饭。

lines.en: Sunbloom always turns its face to the sun. It feels sad on rainy days.
lines.zh: 向阳朵总是把脸朝着太阳，下雨天就会不开心。

lines.en: Sunharvest brings a big harvest to farms. Its face is as bright as the sun.
lines.zh: 丰收日葵给农场带来大丰收，它的脸像太阳一样明亮。

lines.en: Teabud has a tea leaf on its head. It smells fresh in spring.
lines.zh: 茶芽宝头上长着一片茶叶，春天闻起来清清香香。

lines.en: Teabush grows new leaves every morning. Farmers pick them to make tea.
lines.zh: 茶丛兽每天早上都长出新叶子，农民摘下来做茶。

lines.en: A small tea garden grows on its back. Birds rest in its leaves.
lines.zh: 它背上长着一小片茶园，鸟儿在叶子里休息。

lines.en: Thunderkite flies inside storm clouds. It is never afraid of thunder.
lines.zh: 雷暴鸢在暴风云里飞，它从来不怕打雷。

lines.en: Lamppost stands by the road all night. It keeps city streets safe and bright.
lines.zh: 路灯怪整晚站在路边，让城市的街道又安全又明亮。

lines.en: Thunderdrum beats the drum on its belly. The sound is as loud as thunder.
lines.zh: 雷鼓兽敲打肚子上的鼓，声音像打雷一样响。

lines.en: Hailwing brings hail when it flies over farms. Farmers ring bells to warn everyone.
lines.zh: 冰雹龙飞过农场时会下冰雹，农民会敲钟提醒大家。

lines.en: Snowbell rings softly when snow falls. Its song means winter is here.
lines.zh: 下雪时雪铃花会轻轻地响，它的歌声告诉大家冬天来了。

lines.en: Snowchick cannot fly yet. It slides on the ice on its belly.
lines.zh: 雪绒雏还不会飞，它用肚子在冰上滑来滑去。

lines.en: Winterbeak dives into icy water for fish. It never feels cold.
lines.zh: 冬喙鸟钻进冰冷的海水里抓鱼，它从来不觉得冷。

lines.en: Snowpaw leaves tiny prints in the snow. It loves snowball fights.
lines.zh: 雪爪崽在雪地上留下小小的脚印，最爱打雪仗。

lines.en: Snowtiger walks quietly through winter forests. Its white coat keeps it hidden.
lines.zh: 雪原虎在冬天的森林里静静地走，白色的皮毛让它很难被发现。

lines.en: Jumprope jumps a thousand times a day. Its long tail works like a rope.
lines.zh: 跳绳仔一天能跳一千下，它的长尾巴就像一根跳绳。

lines.en: Ropechamp wins every game at the sports festival. It never gets tired.
lines.zh: 跳绳王在运动会上每场比赛都赢，它从来不会累。

lines.en: Punchbun is soft but strong. It trains in the kitchen every morning.
lines.zh: 拳包子软软的，力气却很大。它每天早上都在厨房里练拳。

lines.en: Bunboxer wears red gloves. Its punch is as hot as fresh buns.
lines.zh: 包子拳手戴着红手套，出拳像刚出锅的包子一样烫。

lines.en: Bubblegum blows big pink bubbles. They stick to shoes and hair.
lines.zh: 泡泡糖怪吹出大大的粉色泡泡，会粘在鞋子和头发上。

lines.en: Plumbat hangs in plum trees at night. It eats fruit that is too old.
lines.zh: 紫李蝠夜里倒挂在李子树上，专吃放坏了的水果。

lines.en: Sourberry tastes very sour. Birds never eat it twice.
lines.zh: 酸莓球的味道酸极了，鸟儿吃过一次就不敢再吃。

lines.en: Sourvine climbs up old walls. Its purple berries make you sneeze.
lines.zh: 酸藤怪顺着老墙往上爬，它的紫莓果会让人打喷嚏。

lines.en: Fieldmole digs under farm fields. It helps the soil stay soft.
lines.zh: 田野鼹在农田下面挖洞，让泥土保持松软。

lines.en: Mudcake looks like a pie but it is made of mud. Do not eat it!
lines.zh: 泥巴饼看起来像馅饼，其实是泥做的。可别吃它！

lines.en: Barnhoot lives on top of old barns. It hoots softly all night.
lines.zh: 谷仓鸮住在老谷仓的屋顶上，整夜轻轻地咕咕叫。

lines.en: Breezelet rides the spring breeze. It sings when the wind is warm.
lines.zh: 微风雀乘着春风飞。风暖和的时候它就唱歌。

lines.en: Kitewing flies high like a kite. Its long tail dances in the wind.
lines.zh: 风筝翼像风筝一样高高飞起，长尾巴在风里跳舞。

lines.en: Mooncake appears at the Mid-Autumn Festival. It watches the full moon with families.
lines.zh: 月饼宝在中秋节出现，它和一家人一起赏月。

lines.en: Moonhop hops higher on full moon nights. It dreams of living on the moon.
lines.zh: 月跳兔在满月的夜晚跳得更高，它梦想住到月亮上。

lines.en: Jaderabbit makes medicine under the moon. Its song helps people sleep well.
lines.zh: 玉月兔在月光下做药，它的歌声能让人睡个好觉。

lines.en: Berrybug looks like a red berry. It hides on farm bushes.
lines.zh: 莓果虫看起来像一颗红莓果，喜欢躲在农场的灌木上。

lines.en: Berrybeetle guards the berry fields. It pushes away hungry birds with its horn.
lines.zh: 莓果甲虫守护着莓果田，用角把饿肚子的鸟推开。

lines.en: Rollbug rolls down the road like a ball. It loves long hills.
lines.zh: 滚轮虫像球一样沿着马路滚下去，它最爱长长的坡。

lines.en: Wheelbug has wheels instead of feet. It races cars on big roads.
lines.zh: 车轮虫没有脚，只有轮子，它会在大路上和汽车赛跑。

lines.en: Trainbeetle pulls ten carts behind it. Whole families travel on its back.
lines.zh: 列车甲虫身后能拉十节车厢，一家人都可以坐在它背上旅行。

lines.en: Silkling eats green leaves all day. It grows bigger every week.
lines.zh: 丝丝虫整天吃绿叶子，每个星期都长大一点。

lines.en: Silkball sleeps inside a soft white ball. Please do not wake it up.
lines.zh: 丝茧球睡在软软的白球里。请不要把它吵醒。

lines.en: Silkwing's wings shine like silk. People in old times made clothes from its thread.
lines.zh: 丝翼蛾的翅膀像丝绸一样闪亮。古时候人们用它的丝做衣服。

lines.en: Songbug sings in the fields on summer nights. Kids keep it as a pet.
lines.zh: 夏天的夜里，鸣歌虫在田野里唱歌，孩子们会把它当宠物养。

lines.en: Brickbit is a small brick with legs. It helps builders in the city.
lines.zh: 砖块仔是一块长了腿的小砖头，在城里给建筑工人帮忙。

lines.en: Brickwall stands in front of towns. Strong winds cannot push it.
lines.zh: 砖墙怪站在小镇前面，大风也推不动它。

lines.en: Brickgiant can build a bridge in one night. Travelers thank it every day.
lines.zh: 砖石巨人一夜就能搭好一座桥，旅行的人每天都感谢它。

lines.en: Rockcandy looks sweet but it is very hard. Please do not bite it.
lines.zh: 冰糖石看起来很甜，其实硬得很，千万别咬它。

lines.en: Stonecub eats small rocks in deep caves. It is very rare.
lines.zh: 石幼崽在深深的山洞里吃小石头，非常少见。

lines.en: Duskrock wakes up at dusk. Its hard body can break big rocks.
lines.zh: 暮岩兽在黄昏时醒来，它坚硬的身体能撞碎大石头。

lines.en: Duskdragon flies over mountains at dusk. Its wings cover the evening sky.
lines.zh: 暮岩龙黄昏时飞过群山，它的翅膀能遮住傍晚的天空。

lines.en: Foglet comes out on foggy mornings. It likes to play hide-and-seek.
lines.zh: 雾灵灵在起雾的早上出来，最喜欢玩捉迷藏。

lines.en: Nightfog covers the whole town at night. Keep your lamp on.
lines.zh: 夜雾灵晚上会把整个小镇盖住。记得把灯开着。

lines.en: Paperkite was a kite lost in the wind. Now it flies alone at night.
lines.zh: 纸鸢灵原本是一只被风吹走的风筝，现在它在夜里独自飞行。

lines.en: Ribbonlet dances like a red ribbon. It appears near festival boats.
lines.zh: 彩带龙宝像红丝带一样跳舞，常在节日龙舟附近出现。

lines.en: Ribbontail leads the dragon boat race. Drums play when it swims by.
lines.zh: 彩带舞龙带领龙舟比赛，它游过时鼓声就响起来。

lines.en: Festivalwing flies over towns on holidays. Fireworks follow its long tail.
lines.zh: 节庆飞龙在节日里飞过小镇，烟花跟着它的长尾巴绽放。

lines.en: Crowlet loves shiny things. It takes keys and coins from windows.
lines.zh: 小黑鸦喜欢亮晶晶的东西，会从窗边叼走钥匙和硬币。

lines.en: Nightcrow leads many crows across the city at night. Its eyes shine gold.
lines.zh: 夜幕鸦夜里带着一群乌鸦飞过城市，它的眼睛闪着金光。

lines.en: Shadowpaw walks without a sound. It hides in the shadows of city walls.
lines.zh: 影爪兽走路一点声音都没有，它躲在城墙的影子里。

lines.en: Railsnake runs along train tracks. It takes travelers to faraway cities.
lines.zh: 铁轨蛇沿着火车轨道飞奔，把旅客送到遥远的城市。

lines.en: Towerbell rings every hour in the city. People set their clocks by it.
lines.zh: 钟楼铃在城市里每小时响一次，人们按它的钟声对表。

lines.en: Moodplume changes the color of its tail with its mood. Pink means it is happy.
lines.zh: 心情孔雀的尾巴会跟着心情变颜色，变成粉红色就是它很开心。

lines.en: Drumlion dances to loud drums at every festival. Its happy roar wakes up the whole town.
lines.zh: 醒狮在每个节日里跟着鼓声跳舞，它开心地一吼，全镇都醒了。

lines.en: Foamlion loves bubble baths. Its soft mane is made of foam.
lines.zh: 泡泡狮最爱泡泡浴，它软软的鬃毛是泡沫做的。

lines.en: Tidewing glides low over the waves. Tired seabirds rest on its wide back.
lines.zh: 潮翼贴着海浪滑翔，飞累的海鸟会停在它宽宽的背上休息。

lines.en: Daysprout grows a new leaf on every day you practice. The sand inside it keeps the count.
lines.zh: 你每练习一天，日日芽就长出一片新叶子。它身体里的沙子帮你记着天数。

lines.en: Plugmane lives next to the city power station. Its plug tail lights up the street lamps.
lines.zh: 插头狮住在城市的发电站旁边，它用插头尾巴把路灯点亮。

lines.en: Brushkit paints with the tip of its tail. Every picture is different.
lines.zh: 画笔仔用尾巴尖画画。它的每一幅画都不一样。

lines.en: Moonpainter paints dreams in the night sky. Look up and you can see them.
lines.zh: 月光画师在夜空中画梦。抬头看，你就能看到它们。

lines.en: Cheerpuff shouts happy words at every match. It helps its team feel strong.
lines.zh: 加油球在每场比赛都喊着开心的话，让队友觉得自己很强。

lines.en: Gloryhorn appears when a new champion wins. Its golden horn shines like the sun.
lines.zh: 新的冠军诞生时，荣耀角就会出现，它金色的角像太阳一样闪耀。

lines.en: Mapfinch never gets lost. It remembers every road it sees.
lines.zh: 地图雀从不迷路。它记得见过的每一条路。

lines.en: Pilotswift wears a scarf like a pilot. It flies in a straight line.
lines.zh: 飞行员燕像飞行员一样戴着围巾。它总是笔直地飞。

lines.en: Skycaptain leads big groups of birds. It knows every wind in the sky.
lines.zh: 天空机长带领大群的鸟儿。它认识天空中的每一阵风。

lines.en: Moodlet changes color with its feelings. Pink means it is happy.
lines.zh: 心情团的颜色会随着心情变化，粉色表示它很开心。

lines.en: Grumpcloud gets angry when it is hungry. Then it makes little storms.
lines.zh: 气鼓云一饿就生气，然后会造出小小的暴风雨。

lines.en: Joyburst laughs, and warm sparks fly into the sky. Its smile can end a sad day.
lines.zh: 欢乐焰一笑，温暖的火星就飞上天空。它的笑容能赶走难过的一天。

lines.en: Spoonmouse carries a tiny spoon. It tastes every soup in town.
lines.zh: 勺子鼠带着一把小勺子。它会尝遍镇上所有的汤。

lines.en: Chefrat cooks tasty meals for tired trainers. Its hat is always clean.
lines.zh: 大厨鼠为疲惫的训练师做好吃的饭。它的帽子总是干干净净。

lines.en: Ashtoad sits in warm ashes near volcanoes. It blows small rings of smoke.
lines.zh: 灰烬蟾坐在火山附近温暖的灰里。它会吹出小小的烟圈。

lines.en: Volcanotoad has a small volcano on its back. It sleeps in hot lava.
lines.zh: 火山蟾王背上有一座小火山。它睡在滚烫的岩浆里。

lines.en: Cinderchick has a warm body. It sleeps next to the stove.
lines.zh: 余烬雏的身体暖暖的。它喜欢睡在炉子旁边。

lines.en: Sunrooster sings when the sun comes up. Its song wakes the whole farm.
lines.zh: 朝阳鸡在太阳升起时唱歌。它的歌声叫醒整个农场。

lines.en: Solarknight carries a shiny sun shield. It crows to start every sports day.
lines.zh: 烈阳骑士举着一面亮闪闪的太阳盾，每次运动会都由它打鸣开场。

lines.en: Hopeflame burns at the gate of the champion league. Its fire never goes out.
lines.zh: 希望火在冠军联盟的大门前燃烧，它的火焰永远不会熄灭。

lines.en: Lampshell carries a small lamp on its back. It helps lost ships at night.
lines.zh: 灯壳蟹背上背着一盏小灯，夜里会帮助迷路的船。

lines.en: Lighthouse stands by the harbor all night. Its bright light keeps sailors safe.
lines.zh: 灯塔蟹整夜守在港口边，它明亮的光让水手们平平安安。

lines.en: Twirlflame spins on one foot all day. It leaves circles of fire.
lines.zh: 旋转火苗整天用一只脚转圈，身后留下一圈圈火焰。

lines.en: Firedancer dances in the air like a bright flame. Crowds clap for its shows.
lines.zh: 火焰舞者像明亮的火焰一样在空中跳舞，观众都为它的表演鼓掌。

lines.en: Anchorpup lives on ships in the harbor. Sailors love its happy bark.
lines.zh: 锚锚犬住在港口的船上，水手们都喜欢它开心的叫声。

lines.en: Anchorhound can pull a boat to the shore. It works all day and never feels tired.
lines.zh: 锚链犬能把小船拉到岸边，它整天干活也不觉得累。

lines.en: Seawolf leads ships across the stormy sea. It never gets lost.
lines.zh: 海狼船长带领船只穿过风暴中的大海，它从来不会迷路。

lines.en: Galaxywhale swims through the night sky. Stars sparkle on its back.
lines.zh: 银河鲸在夜空中游泳。它的背上闪着星光。

lines.en: Harppup sings to the moon on the ice. Its voice sounds like a harp.
lines.zh: 竖琴仔在冰面上对着月亮唱歌，它的声音像竖琴一样好听。

lines.en: Harpseal plays music with its long whiskers. Sailors hear its songs in the north.
lines.zh: 竖琴海豹用长长的胡须弹奏音乐，水手们在北方能听到它的歌。

lines.en: Jellysail uses its body like a sail. The wind carries it across the sea.
lines.zh: 帆水母把身体当成船帆，风会带着它漂过大海。

lines.en: Knightcrab uses its claws like a sword and shield. It is very brave.
lines.zh: 骑士蟹把大钳子当作剑和盾。它非常勇敢。

lines.en: Sailors tell stories about Mythserpent. Few people have seen it in real life.
lines.zh: 水手们讲述着神话海蛇的故事，真正见过它的人却很少。

lines.en: Puddlenewt plays in puddles after rain. It can breathe under water.
lines.zh: 水洼螈下雨后在水坑里玩。它能在水下呼吸。

lines.en: Canyonguard builds stone dams in the river. Small fish swim in its quiet pools.
lines.zh: 峡谷卫士在河里垒起石头坝，小鱼在它造的安静水潭里游来游去。

lines.en: Sailray jumps out of the sea and glides like a boat. It races ships for fun.
lines.zh: 帆鳐跳出海面，像小船一样滑行。它喜欢和大船比赛。

lines.en: Shyshell closes its shell when people look at it. It opens only for friends.
lines.zh: 有人看它时，害羞贝就会合上壳。它只为朋友打开。

lines.en: Snorkelfish swims near the top of the sea. It watches the coral.
lines.zh: 通气管鱼在海面附近游泳。它喜欢看珊瑚。

lines.en: Deepdiver has a metal helmet. It explores the deepest parts of the sea.
lines.zh: 深潜鱼戴着金属头盔。它探索大海最深的地方。

lines.en: Cactuskid lives in the hot desert. It drinks water once a month.
lines.zh: 仙人掌仔住在炎热的沙漠里。它一个月只喝一次水。

lines.en: Cactusking stands tall in the sun. Travelers rest in its shade.
lines.zh: 仙人掌王在阳光下站得高高的。旅行者在它的影子里休息。

lines.en: Junglefrog has bright colors on its skin. The colors say: do not touch!
lines.zh: 丛林蛙的皮肤颜色很鲜艳。这些颜色在说：别碰我！

lines.en: Kelpdrifter goes on long trips with the waves. It visits islands all over the world.
lines.zh: 海藻漂客跟着海浪去远方旅行，它拜访过世界各地的小岛。

lines.en: Leafgecko climbs trees with its sticky feet. It loves the rain.
lines.zh: 叶壁虎用黏黏的脚爬树。它最喜欢下雨天。

lines.en: Vinelizard swings from vine to vine. It is very fast in the jungle.
lines.zh: 藤蜥蜴在藤蔓之间荡来荡去。它在丛林里跑得非常快。

lines.en: Jungleking guards the old jungle. Trees grow where it walks.
lines.zh: 丛林王守护着古老的丛林。它走过的地方会长出大树。

lines.en: Luckleaf has four leaves on its head. Finding one brings good luck.
lines.zh: 幸运叶头上有四片叶子。找到它会带来好运。

lines.en: Clovercrown wears a crown of lucky leaves. It shares its luck with kind people.
lines.zh: 四叶冠戴着幸运叶做的王冠，它会把好运分给善良的人。

lines.en: Peakbloom opens its flower only on the highest peaks. It is not afraid of snow.
lines.zh: 山巅花只在最高的山峰上开花，它一点也不怕雪。

lines.en: Drumfrog hits its round belly like a drum. The sound makes small sparks.
lines.zh: 鼓鼓蛙像敲鼓一样拍打圆肚子，声音会冒出小电火花。

lines.en: Drumking plays a thunder song before every battle. Its beat shakes the ground.
lines.zh: 雷鼓王每次战斗前都会演奏雷鸣之歌，鼓点让大地都在摇晃。

lines.en: Radarbat sends out tiny signals. It can fly in total darkness.
lines.zh: 雷达蝠会发出小小的信号。它在一片漆黑中也能飞。

lines.en: Wirepup likes to chew old wires. Its fur makes small sparks.
lines.zh: 电线狗喜欢啃旧电线。它的毛会冒出小火花。

lines.en: Polarguard protects the snow reserve. It helps lost explorers get home.
lines.zh: 极地卫士守护着雪原保护区。它帮助迷路的探险家回家。

lines.en: Snowseal slides on the ice like a sled. It loves cold fish.
lines.zh: 雪海豹像雪橇一样在冰上滑行。它最爱吃冰冷的鱼。

lines.en: Glacierseal can freeze the sea around it. It makes ice bridges for travelers.
lines.zh: 冰川海豹能让身边的海水结冰。它为旅行者造冰桥。

lines.en: Snowyak carries travelers over snowy mountains. Its thick hair keeps it warm.
lines.zh: 雪牦牛驮着旅行者翻过雪山，厚厚的毛让它很暖和。

lines.en: Bravekit never runs away from a fight. It protects smaller friends.
lines.zh: 勇气小狮从不逃跑，它会保护比自己小的朋友。

lines.en: Bravepaw trains on the mountain every morning. Its paws are very strong.
lines.zh: 勇爪狮每天早上都在山上训练，它的爪子非常有力。

lines.en: Bravemane's red mane shines when it feels brave. Trainers call it the hero of the league.
lines.zh: 勇鬃狮王感到勇敢时，红色的鬃毛会发光。训练师们叫它联盟的英雄。

lines.en: Judopanda practices judo every morning. It always bows before a battle.
lines.zh: 柔道熊猫每天早上练柔道。每次比赛前它都会鞠躬。

lines.en: Beakerblob came from a science lab. Its body bubbles when it is happy.
lines.zh: 烧杯团来自一间科学实验室。它开心的时候身体会冒泡泡。

lines.en: Flaskgiant mixes strange drinks in its glass body. Please do not drink them!
lines.zh: 烧瓶巨人在玻璃身体里调奇怪的饮料。千万别喝！

lines.en: Paintdrop leaves colorful spots on walls. Never put its paint in your mouth.
lines.zh: 颜料滴会在墙上留下彩色的斑点。千万别把它的颜料放进嘴里。

lines.en: Paintsplash throws paint to make big pictures. Every picture shows how it feels.
lines.zh: 泼彩怪泼颜料画出大大的画，每幅画都表现出它的心情。

lines.en: Claypup was made from clay long ago. It still guards old places.
lines.zh: 陶土犬是很久以前用陶土做成的，它至今还守护着古老的地方。

lines.en: Clayguard stands still for many years. It moves when someone is in danger.
lines.zh: 陶俑卫士一动不动地站了很多年，有人遇到危险时它才会行动。

lines.en: Claygeneral leads an army of clay friends. Old stories say it is a thousand years old.
lines.zh: 陶俑将军带领着一支陶土朋友组成的军队。古老的故事说它已经一千岁了。

lines.en: Minermole wears a light on its head. It digs for shiny stones.
lines.zh: 矿工鼹鼠头上戴着一盏灯。它挖地找闪亮的石头。

lines.en: Cloudchick hides in soft white clouds. It sleeps there on windy days.
lines.zh: 云朵雏躲在软软的白云里，刮风的日子就在那里睡觉。

lines.en: Cloudhawk flies above the mountain peaks. Its eyes can see very far.
lines.zh: 云鹰在山峰上空飞翔，它的眼睛能看得很远。

lines.en: Stormeagle flies into big storms for fun. Lightning follows its wings.
lines.zh: 风暴雕喜欢飞进大风暴里玩，闪电跟着它的翅膀走。

lines.en: Jetfalcon flies faster than a plane. You can hear it before you see it.
lines.zh: 喷气隼飞得比飞机还快。你先听到它的声音，才看到它。

lines.en: Calmlet floats quietly by the lake. Its soft song helps people relax.
lines.zh: 静静球安静地飘在湖边，它轻柔的歌声能让人放松。

lines.en: Calmsage never gets angry. It helps friends talk about their feelings.
lines.zh: 静心贤者从不生气，它会帮助朋友们说出自己的感受。

lines.en: Stargazer looks at the stars every night. It can name every planet.
lines.zh: 观星者每天晚上都看星星。它能叫出每颗行星的名字。

lines.en: Canyonant can carry rocks ten times its size. It works all day.
lines.zh: 峡谷蚁能搬起比自己大十倍的石头。它整天都在工作。

lines.en: Antfortress has a whole ant city on its back. Thousands of ants live there.
lines.zh: 蚁城堡背上有一整座蚂蚁城市。成千上万只蚂蚁住在那里。

lines.en: Jitterbug cannot stop dancing. Its wings buzz with little sparks.
lines.zh: 跳跳电虫一刻也停不下来地跳舞，翅膀嗡嗡作响，还冒着小电火花。

lines.en: Pagegrub lives in old books. It eats only the empty pages.
lines.zh: 书页虫住在旧书里，它只吃空白的书页。

lines.en: Inside its cocoon, it dreams old stories. Please be quiet near it.
lines.zh: 它在茧里梦见古老的故事。在它身边请保持安静。

lines.en: Legendmoth's wings show pictures from old legends. People read them like a book.
lines.zh: 传说蛾的翅膀上有古老传说的图画，人们像读书一样读它们。

lines.en: Starworm has yellow stars on its back. They glow at night.
lines.zh: 星星虫背上有黄色的星星，晚上会发光。

lines.en: Orbitpod spins slowly in its hard shell. It dreams about space.
lines.zh: 轨道茧在硬壳里慢慢转圈。它梦想着飞向太空。

lines.en: Rocketmoth flies very high at night. Some say it visits the moon.
lines.zh: 火箭蛾晚上飞得非常高。有人说它去过月亮。

lines.en: Bricklet looks like a red brick. Kids sometimes build walls with it.
lines.zh: 小砖块长得像一块红砖。孩子们有时会拿它搭墙。

lines.en: Castlewall stands still for many years. Birds make nests on its head.
lines.zh: 城墙兽一站就是好多年。鸟儿在它头上筑巢。

lines.en: Castlelord is as big as a castle. Small monsters live inside it.
lines.zh: 城堡领主和一座城堡一样大。小怪兽们住在它身体里。

lines.en: Cliffkid jumps from rock to rock without fear. A kid is a baby goat.
lines.zh: 崖羊仔毫不害怕地在岩石间跳来跳去。英语里 kid 也指小山羊。

lines.en: Cliffram hits rocks with its big horns. It guards the mountain path.
lines.zh: 崖角羊用大角撞击岩石，它守护着山间小路。

lines.en: Meteorhawk dives from the sky like a falling star. Its body is hard rock.
lines.zh: 流星鹰像流星一样从天上俯冲下来。它的身体是坚硬的岩石。

lines.en: Runelet has old letters on its body. Nobody can read them yet.
lines.zh: 符文石身上刻着古老的文字，现在还没有人能读懂。

lines.en: Runegolem's letters glow when it tells a legend. Scientists try to learn its language.
lines.zh: 符文巨像讲传说时，身上的文字会发光。科学家们在努力学习它的语言。

lines.en: Armorghost is an empty suit of armor. It walks the castle halls at night.
lines.zh: 盔甲幽灵是一套空空的盔甲。晚上它在城堡的走廊里走来走去。

lines.en: Ghostsail looks like an old white sail. It sails on foggy nights and helps lost boats.
lines.zh: 幽灵帆看起来像一面旧的白帆，它在起雾的夜里航行，帮助迷路的船。

lines.en: Inkpot lives on old writers' desks. It writes secret stories at night.
lines.zh: 墨水罐住在老作家的书桌上，它会在夜里写下秘密的故事。

lines.en: Scrollwisp lives in old scrolls. It reads history books all night.
lines.zh: 卷轴灵住在古老的卷轴里。它整夜都在读历史书。

lines.en: Cometlet fell from the sky long ago. Its tail shines like a comet.
lines.zh: 小彗星很久以前从天上掉下来。它的尾巴像彗星一样闪亮。

lines.en: Peakling climbs to the top of high mountains. It dreams of flying one day.
lines.zh: 山峰小龙会爬到高山顶上，它梦想有一天能飞起来。

lines.en: Peakdrake's small wings are not strong yet. It practices flying from cliffs every day.
lines.zh: 山峰翼龙的小翅膀还不够有力，它每天都从悬崖上练习飞行。

lines.en: Summitdragon flies above the highest summit in the world. Only true champions ever see it.
lines.zh: 巅峰龙王在世界最高的山顶上空飞翔，只有真正的冠军才见过它。

lines.en: Spacedragon lives far above the clouds. It watches over every planet.
lines.zh: 太空神龙住在云层上方很远的地方。它守护着每一颗行星。

lines.en: Mythowl knows every myth in the world. It tells them to children at night.
lines.zh: 神话鸮知道世界上所有的神话，它会在夜里讲给孩子们听。

lines.en: Piratekit hides shiny coins under its bed. It loves treasure maps.
lines.zh: 海盗猫把闪亮的硬币藏在床下。它最爱藏宝图。

lines.en: Captainclaw leads a crew of cats on a small ship. It never steals from friends.
lines.zh: 船长爪带着一群猫坐小船航行。它从不偷朋友的东西。

lines.en: Gearbeetle has gears on its back. They turn when it walks.
lines.zh: 齿轮甲虫背上长着齿轮，走路时齿轮会转。

lines.en: Medalcub wears a shiny medal on its neck. It wants to win every race.
lines.zh: 奖牌小虎脖子上挂着闪亮的奖牌，它想赢得每一场比赛。

lines.en: Trophytiger has beaten many strong trainers. Its golden body shines like a trophy.
lines.zh: 奖杯虎王打败过很多强大的训练师，它金色的身体像奖杯一样闪亮。

lines.en: Moonrover once explored the moon. Now it collects rocks for scientists.
lines.zh: 月球车曾经探索过月亮。现在它为科学家收集石头。

lines.en: Swordfin's nose is sharp like a sword. It swims faster than a boat.
lines.zh: 剑鳍鱼的鼻子像剑一样尖，它游得比船还快。

lines.en: Tinbot was built by a young scientist. It beeps when it is happy.
lines.zh: 锡罐宝是一位年轻科学家造的。它开心时会哔哔叫。

lines.en: Steelbot works in big factories. It can lift a car with one hand.
lines.zh: 钢铁宝在大工厂里工作。它一只手就能举起一辆车。

lines.en: Skyecho repeats every word it hears. Say something kind, and it tells the whole sky.
lines.zh: 天响会重复它听到的每一个词。说一句好听的话，它就讲给整片天空听。

lines.en: Reefwhale carries a coral reef on its back. Little fish live there.
lines.zh: 珊瑚鲸背上驮着一片珊瑚礁，小鱼们就住在那里。

lines.en: Mossgiant keeps a warm amber stone in its chest. Flowers grow where it sleeps.
lines.zh: 苔藓巨人胸口有一块暖暖的琥珀，它睡过的地方会开满鲜花。

lines.en: Frostkeeper keeps the snow town's food cold all summer. Kids visit it for ice cream.
lines.zh: 冰窖守卫整个夏天都帮雪镇把食物冰着，孩子们常去找它要冰激凌。

lines.en: Skysong is a long ribbon of cloud. When it sings, a soft rain falls.
lines.zh: 天歌像一条长长的云丝带，它一唱歌，天上就下起小雨。

lines.en: Starcore is a crystal that drinks sunlight all day. At night it glows like a lamp.
lines.zh: 星核是一块整天吸收阳光的水晶，到了晚上它会像灯一样发光。

lines.en: Hushking swallows every sound. It is afraid of loud noises.
lines.zh: 寂静之王会吞掉所有的声音，其实它很怕吵闹。

lines.en: Echodrake is made of echoes. It keeps the kind words people say.
lines.zh: 回声龙是由回声变成的，它把人们说过的好话都收藏起来。

lines.en: Bellgiant rings the hour for the old village. Knock on its chest to say hello.
lines.zh: 钟楼巨人每到整点就为老村子报时。敲敲它胸口的门环，跟它打个招呼吧。

lines.en: Tickturtle turns its key once for every lesson you finish. Finish a whole book, and it wakes up.
lines.zh: 你每学完一课，发条龟背上的钥匙就转一圈。学完一整本书，它就醒过来了。
